Title: Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
Ingredients:
2/3 C light brown sugar
4 T butter, cut into small pieces
1 can (20 oz) pineapple rings drained
7-10 marchino cherries
1 pkg (18.25 oz) yellow cake mix
1 c water
1/4 c vegetable oil
3 eggs
Instructions:
1. Sprinkle brown sugar over bottom of microwave safe 10-in round cake pan or 9x13in baking dish; dot with butter. Microwave at power level 10 for 1.5 minutes. Evenly distribute mixture. Arrange pineapple rings in a single layer. Place a cherry in each ring.
2. Combine cake mix, water (or pineapple juice), oil and eggs. Beat well. Spoon batter into pan and microwave at power level 7 for 14-16 minutes.
3. Let stand for 5 minutes. Loosen with knife and carefully invert onto a platter.

Title: White Chocolate Creme Brulee
Ingredients:
1 1/2 c heavy cream
1/2 vanilla bean, split and seeds removed
4 oz. white chocolate, chopped
3 egg yolks
4 T plus 1 t sugar
Instructions:
Position rack in center of an oven and preheat to 325 F. Line a baking pan with a kitchen towel. Have a pot of boiling water ready.
In a saucepan over medium heat, warm cream, vanilla bean and seeds until small bubbles form around the edges of the pan, 2-3 minutes. Remove from the heat and stir in the white chocolate until melted and blended. Let cool slightly.
In a bowl wisk together the egg yolks and 3 T of the sugar until pale yellow and thick ribbons fall from the wisk, about 5 minutes. Slowly stir in warm chocolate mixture. Place four 4 oz. ramekins in the prepared baking pan. Strain the chocolate mixture through a fine mesh sieve set over a bowl and divide among the ramekins. Add boiling water to fill the pan halfwayup the sides of the ramekins. Cover the pan loosley with aluminum foil and bake until the custards are just set around the edges, 25-30 minutes.
Remove ramekins from the pan and transfer to a wire rack. Cool to room teperature, the cove and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Just before serving, sprinkle 1 t sugar evenly over the surface of each custard. Using a kitchen torch, melt the sugar according to the manufacturer's instrutions. Serve immediately.

Title: Vanilla Pudding
Ingredients:
2 T plus 2 t cornstarch
1/2 c sugar
Pinch of course salt
2 large eggs
2 cups milk
1 vanilla bean, split and scraped, seeds reserved
1 T unsalted butter, cut into small peices
2 t pure vanilla extract
1 oz milk chocolate shavings, for garnish
Instructions:
Prepare an ice bath; set aside. In a small bowl, combine cornstarch, 2 T sugar, and salt. Whisk eggs in a seperate bowl until smooth; whisk in cornstarch mixture.
Combine milk, remaining sugar, and vanilla bean scrapings in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Slowly pour milk into egg mixture, whisking constantly.
Return mixture to saucepan set over a medium-high heat. Bring to a boil, whisking constantly, until thickened, about 2 minutes. Remove pan from heat, and transfer mixture to a medium heat-proof bowl.
Whisk in butter and vanilla extract. Set bowl in bath, stirring occasionally, until chilled. Serve pudding with chocolate shavings on top, if desired.

Title: Flank Steak

1/4 c. water

Title: Chicken Parmesan
Ingredients:
2/3 c. Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs
2/3 c. grated parmesan cheese, divided
8 skinned and boned chicken breast halves
2 large eggs, lightly beaten
1/4-1/3 cup olive oil
1 (26 oz.) spaghetti or marinara sauce. She used Borillos-something like that!!
1 t. dried oregano, crushed
1 (6 oz.) package mozzarella cheese slices
16 oz. rotini, cooked
1/4 cup butter 
2 T. minced fresh Italian parsley
Instructions:
Combine breadcrumbs and 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese.
Dip chicken in egg, dredge in breadcrumb mixture.
Brown half of chicken in hot oil in large skillet over medium high heat, turning once.
Remove chicken from skillet and repeat with remaining chicken.
Stir together spaghetti sauce and oregano. Pour into a lightly greased 9x13" baking dish. Arrange chicken over sauce. Bake, covered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes.
Top chicken with mozzarella cheese slices.
Sprinkle with remaining parmesan.
Bake uncovered 8 more minutes or until mozzarella is slightly browned.
Toss hot pasta with butter and parsley.
Serve with chicken.

Title: Chicken Divan

1/2 c. mayonaisse
1/2 t. lemon juice
2 T. melted butter

1/2 c. soft bread crumbs.
Instructions:
preheat oven to 350 degrees.
arrange broccoli in shallow 1 and 1/2 quart baking dish.
place cooked chicken (boil 35 minutes or until tender) on broccoli.
mix soup, lemon juice, mayonaisse and curry powder.
pour over chicken.

Sprinkle over casserole.
bake 25 minutes.

Title: Chicken Fajitas
Ingredients:
Marinated Chicken:
4 lbs. boneless, skinless chicken breast
1 cup vegetable oil
2 T. ground cayenne
2 cloves garlic
1 T. lime juice
1 t. white pepper
1 t. salt
Generous dash A-1 sauce
3 T. butter, or more as needed
Vegetable Topping:
1 bell pepper
1 to 2 large onions, sliced into strips
2 medium tomatoes, cut into wedges
1 dozen medium mushrooms, sliced thin
flour torillas 2 to 3 per person
salsa, pico de gallo and guacamole as accompaniments.
Instructions:
Slice the chicken into thin strips and place strips in large bowl or pan. Combine the rest of the marinade ingredients, except for the butter, and pour them over the chicken, tossing to coat. Marinate the chicken, refrigerated, for at least 5 hours or overnight.
Drain the chicken and discard the marinade. Melt some of the butter in a heavy skillet. Cook the chicken strips until browned, and until juice runs clear. Add the onions, pepper and mushrooms, and more butter if necessary to prevent sticking, and saute until tender. Add the tomatoes and saute another 2 munutes, until tomatoes are warmed.
Spoon the filling onto warmed tortillas and fold, garnishing with salsa and guacamole as desired.

Bake for 45 minutes or until chicken and rice are done.

Title: Incredible Pimiento Cheese Spread

1 1/3 c. oil
3 c. flour
1 can evap. milk
1 t. vanilla
1 1/2 t. baking soda
1 t. salt
4 T. poppy seeds
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 degrees
combine all ingredients
in a large mixing bowl using mixer to blend after each addition.
Grease well and flour 2 regular loaf pans or 3 small pans
Bake 1 hr.- 3 pans
1 hour 15 minutes - 2 pans
till top cooks dry and edges pull away from sides.

Title: Hidden Valley Ranch Oyster Crackers
Ingredients:
12 - 16 oz. Plain oyster crackers
1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch Buttermilk Recipe
Original Ranch Salad Dressing Mix
1/4 t. lemon pepper
1/2 - 1 t. dill weed
1/4 t. garlic powder
3/4 - 1 cup salad oil
Instructions: Combine Hidden Valley Ranch mix and oil; add dill weed, garlic powder and lemon pepper. Pour over crackers, stir to coat. Place in warm oven for 15-20 minutes.

Title: Easy Sticky Buns
Ingredients:
2 cans refrig. biscuits - cut into quarters
1 stick margerine
1 c. br. sugar
2 T. water
1 c. chopped pecans
1 t. cinnamon
Instructions:
preheat oven to 400 degrees.
combine and heat to boil - stir in biscuits and pour all into well greasede bundt pan.
Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes

Title: Pecan Rolls
Ingredients:
1 package frozen rolls
1/2 c. chopped pecans
1/2 c. brown sugar
1 t. cinnamon
1 box regular (not instant) vanilla pudding
1 stick butter, melted
Instructions:
Spray bundt pan. Sprinkle with half of nuts and half of dry ingredients.
preheat oven to 325 degrees
Place frozen rolls in pan. Top with rest of topping.
Top with melted butter
cover loosely with saran
Leave on kitchen counter overnight.
Bake at 325 degrees 20-25 minutes.
let sit 2-5 minutes
turn onto serving platter

Title: Fantastic Focaccia Bread
Ingredients:
1 package (10 oz.) refrigerated pizza crust
2 pressed garlic cloves
2 cups (8 ounces) shredded mozzarella cheese, divided
2 ounces (approx. 2/3 cup) Romano cheese, grated, divided
2 t. dried oregano leaves, divided
2 firm, thinly sliced plum tomatoes
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 degrees. 
Roll crust onto flat Baking Stone; spread with garlic. Grate 1/2 of Romano cheese (1/3 cup) over crust with Delux Cheese Grater. Sprinkle with 1 cup mozzarella cheese and 1 t. oregano. Top with tomatoes, remaining mozzarella, and oregano. Grate remaining Romano cheese over top. Bake 30-35 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly. Cut with Pizza Cutter.

Title: Date & Nut Bread
Ingredients:
3/4 c. chopped nuts
1 c. cut up dates or 1 package chopped dates
1 1/2 t. soda
1/2 t. salt
3 T. Crisco
3/4 c. boiling water
2 eggs
1 t. vanilla
1 c sugar
1 1/2 c. flour
Instructions:
Heat oven to 350 degrees
With a fork mis first 4 ingredients.
Add shortening (crisco) and water. Let stand about 20 minutes. Beat eggs with fork. Add vanilla, then sugar and flour beating with fork (do not use mixer for this recipe) Add date mixture, mixing just to blend. pour into greased loaf pan. Bake 350 degrees for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until done.

Title: Grammie's Hot Fudge Sauce
Ingredients:
1/2 c. real butter (1 stick)
2 oz baking chocolate
1 c. light cream or half and half
1/2 c. cocoa
1 1/2 c. sugar
pinch of salt
2 t. vanilla
Instructions:
Melt together:
1/2 c. real butter (1 stick), 
2 oz baking chocolate. 

Add 1 c. light cream, 1/2 c. cocoa, 1 1/2 c. sugar, pinch of salt. 

Blend.

Bring to a full boil.
Remove from heat.

Add:
2 t. vanilla

Refrigerate until needed.
Heat to serve.
Author: Ruth Carter
Notes: This will keep in refrigeratorand can be reheated.

Title: Congo Bars
Ingredients:
2/3 c. margerine
1 # package brown sugar - 2 1/2 c. 
3 eggs
1 t. vanilla
2 3/4 c. flour
2 1/2 t. baking powder
1/2 t. salt
1 c. chocolate chips (small package)
3/4 c. chopped nuts (if desired)
Instructions:
Directions:
heat oven to 350 degrees.
Melt 2/3 c. margerine in 3 qt. revere pan.
Add 1 # package brown sugar - 2 1/2 c. (beat in 3 eggs) - 1 t. vanilla
Add 2 3/4 c. flour, 2 1/2 t. baking powder, 1/2 t. salt
(I put the BP and Salt into the 3/4 c. flour and stir)
Then add the 2 c. flour, one at a time.
1 c. chocolate chips (small package)
3/4 c. chopped nuts if desired.
bake in ungreased pan (30-35 minutes)
(I use glass 11 1/2 x 7 3/4 pan)

Title: Traditional Pumpkin Pie
Ingredients:
1 (9in) unbaked pastery shell
1 (16oz) can pumpkin (about 2 c)
1 (140z) can low-fat sweetened condensed milk
2 eggs
1t cinnamon
1/2 t ginger
1/2 t nutmeg
1/2 t salt
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 425.
In large bowl, combine all ingredients, mix well.
Pour mixture into pastry shell and bake for 15 minutes.
Reduce oven tempurature to 350 and bake 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted 1" from edge comes out clean.
Let cool, garnish and serve.

Title: Pie crust
Ingredients:
1 1/2 c flour
1/2 t salt
1/4 t baking powder
1/2 c crisco
2 T cold milk
2 T cold water
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 425.
Mix flour, salt and baking powder together, blend in crisco.
Add milk and water.
Roll out dough, place in pan and prick with fork.
Bake for 8 minutes.

Title: Blueberry slump
Ingredients:
2 c. blueberries
1 c. sugar
1 1/2 c. water
biscuit dough (use bisquick dumpling recipe)
Instructions:
Boil berries, water, and sugar in sauce pan until plenty of juice. Drop on biscuit dough uncovered for 5 minutes. Then cover and cook for 10 minutes.

INDIVIDUAL SLUMPS
In pyrex cups, place 1 teaspoon butter, 1/4-1/2 cup blueberries, and 1-3 teaspoons sugar. Top with dumplings. 
Put in saucepan with a tight lid. Bring to a boil and simmer tightly covered for about 10 minutes.

Title: Nonnie's Fruit Crisp
Ingredients:
4 # fruit (peaches, apples)
1 c. sugar
1/2 t. cinnamon
1 1/2 c. sifted flour
1/2 c. butter
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 degrees
peel fruit and cut into quarters
combine 1/2 cup sugar, cinnamon, and 3 T flour, mix with fruit.
Turn into buttered 10x6x2 dish. Combine remaining sugar and flour. Mix with butter until mix is crumbly.
Sprinkle evenly over fruit. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour, or until fruit is tender and crumbs are brown.
Author: Nonnie

Title: Easy Cobbler
Ingredients:
1 can pie filling
1 stick margarine
1 c. sugar
1 c. flour
2 t. baking powder
1/2 t. salt
3/4 c. milk
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 degrees
melt margarine in 9x9 dish.
Mix sugar, flour, baking powder, salt, and milk.
Pour over melted butter. Do not stir.
Pour pie filling onto mixture do not stir.
Bake for 50 to 60 minutes.

Title: Ice Cream Pie
Ingredients:
18 oreos
1/4 c. melted margarine
1 qt. softened ice cream (coffee, peppermint stick or vanilla suggested)
1 small can evaporated milk
1/2 cup sugar
2 squares unsweetened chocolate
1 t. vanilla
(Whipped cream optional)
(chopped nuts optional)
Instructions:
Crust: Crush 18 oreos between 2 sheets of waxed paper.
Add 1/4 c. melted margarine
Mix with fork
Line 9 in. pie plate with foil and butter. Pat crumbs into pie plate and freeze crust
Fill crust with about 1 qt. softened ice cream (suggest coffee, peppermint stick or vanilla) and return to freezer.
Freeze solid. Top with the following sauce (when cooked):
combine in small sauce pan - 
1 small can evaporated milk
1/2 cup sugar
2 squares unsweetened chocolate
1 t. vanilla
cook over low heat till it is of a spreadable thickness. Cool and spread over ice cream and return to freezer. A layer of whipped cream and chopped nuts may also be added.
Remove about 15 to 20 minutes before serving.

Title: Black Bottom Cupcakes
Ingredients:
8 oz cream cheese
1 egg
1/3 c sugar
1/8 t salt
6 oz chocolate chips
1 c sugar
1T cocoa
1 C wter
1 1/2 c flour
1/3 c salad oil
1 T vinegar
1 t baking soda
1/2 t salt
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Beat the cream cheese, egg, sugar and salt, then add the chocolate chips.
In a seperate bowl combine the rest of the ingredients.
Fill cupcake cups about 1/2 full of chocolate then spoon about a teaspoon of cream cheese on top. bake for 30 minutes.

Title: Apple Pan Doughty
Ingredients:
3 medium green apples picked and cut
1 1/2 c. sugar
2 c. water
1 batch bisquick biscuits
Instructions:
450 12-15
Cook sugar and water over slow heat (medium)
Make bisquick dough
Roll dough 1/2" thick, spread with apples, slice
dump syrup into pan, add slice
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar. small slice of butter on each
Author: Scott

Title: Raspberry Oatmeal Bars
Ingredients:
1 package yellow cake mix
2 1/2 c. quick-cooking oats
3/4 c. margarine or butter, melted
1 (12 oz.) jar raspberry jam
1 T. water
Instructions:
Heat oven to 375 degrees
Combine cake mix and oats. Stir in melted margarine until mixture is crumbly. Put about 3 cups of mixture in a 9" by 13" pan and press firmly. Combine jam and water and spoon over crumb mixture; spread evenly. Cover with remaining crumb mixture; make top even by patting firmly.
 Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes. Cool before cutting into bars.

Title: Carrot Cake
Ingredients:
*4 eggs beaten
*3 c. carrots grated
*2 c. sugar (-6 T high altitude)
*1 1/2 c. oil
2 c. flour
2 t. soda
1/2 t. salt
2 t. cinnamon
1 - 8 oz. pkg cream cheese
1 stick butter softened
1 t. vanilla
1/4 t. salt
1 box pow. Sugar
Instructions:
Heat oven to 325 degrees
Mix * ingredients in a large bowl. Beat x 4 min. on medium.
Add 2 c. flour, 1/2 t. salt, 2 t. soda, 2 t. cinnamon
Grease/flour pans
cook for 35 to 40 minutes.
Icing: 
1 8 oz. package cream cheese
1 t. vanilla
1/4 t. salt
1 stick butter softened
1 box powdered sugar

Title: Five Minute Chocolate Frosting
Ingredients:
6 T. butter or margarine
1/2 c. Hershey's cocoa
2 2/3 cups confectioners' sugar
4 to 5 T. milk
1 T. vanilla
Instructions:
1. Cream butter or margarine until softened in small mixing bowl.
2. Add cocoa; blend well.
3. Gradually add confectioners' sugar alternately with milk and vanilla; beat to spreading consistency
4. Spread frosting onto dessert with spatula. Makes about 2 cups frosting, enough to frost 2 1/2 dozencupcakes or an 8" or 9" layer cake.

Title: Oatmeal Cake
Ingredients:
1 1/4 c. boil water
1 c. quick oatmeal
1/2 c. butter or margarine
1 c. white sugar
1 c. brown sugar
2 eggs
1 t. cinnamon
1 t. vanilla
1 1/2 c. soft flour
1 t. soda
Instructions:
heat oven to 350 degrees
pour boiling water over oatmeal and let stand x 20 minutes or while you cream butter and sugars together.
Add eggs, cinnamon, vanilla. Mix well. Then add oatmeal, flour, and soda. mix and pour in 9x13" pan. Bake 30 minutes.

Title: Mom's Carrot Cake
Ingredients:
2 c. sugar
1 1/2 c. oil (minus 2 T high altitude)
4 eggs
1 1/2 t. vanilla
2 1/2 c. (self-rising) flour
1 t. baking soda
2 t. cinnamon
3 c. grated carrots
1 soft package of cream cheese.
4 T. butter.
1 t. vanilla.
dash salt
2 1/2 cup powdered sugar
nuts
Cheese Frosting:
1 soft package cream cheese. 4 T. butter. 1 t. vanilla. Dash salt. 2 1/2 c. powdered sugar. Mix top with nuts.
Instructions:
Heat oven to 350 degrees.
Mix in large bowl sugar, oil, eggs and vanilla x 2 min. Add flour, soda, and cinnamon - fold in carrots last. You need 3-4 cake pans. Grease and flour pans. Bake 30 minutes.
Author: Sandy Seifert

Title: Wacky Cake
Ingredients:
*1 1/2 c. flour
*1 c. sugar
*3 T. cocoa
*1 t. soda
6 T. oil
1 t. vanilla
1 T. vinegar
1 c. cold water
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Into ungreased 12x12 pan sift and mix * ingredients
Make 3 hole and put oil, vanilla, and vinegar in them.
Pour cold water over them and stir with a fork until smooth.
bake for 30 min.

Title: Coffee Frosting
Ingredients:
2 c. powdered sugar
3 T. cocoa
1/2 c. melted margarine
1 t. vanilla
3 T. cold liquid coffee
Instructions: mix all together, leaving coffee for last and pour on hot cake

Title: Heart Cake Strawberry of Raspberry
Ingredients:
*1 Box white cake mix
*3 T. Flour
*1 3 oz. package red jello
-------------------
1/3 c. salad oil
4 eggs
1/2 c. cold water
1/2 small package straw or rasp. thawed less 4 T juice
-----------------------
4 T. butter
4 T. juice
2 c. conf. Sugar
Instructions:
Combine * ingredients
Reserve 5 T. juice from berries for frosting
Mix well. Put in prepared heart shaped pan or a square and a round
Follow directions on package for cooking
icing:
4 T. butter
4 T. juice
2 c. conf. sugar

Title: Nana's Nobby Apple Cake
Ingredients:
*1 c. sugar
*2 T. butter or margarine
*1 egg
*3 c. diced apples
*1 t. vanilla
-------------------
1 c. flour
1/4 t. salt
1/2 t. soda
1/2 T. Baking Powder
1/2 t. cinnamon
1/2 t. nutmeg
-----------------------
lemon sauce:
3/4 c. sugar
1 1/2 c. boiled water
1 1/2 T. cornstarch
3 T. butter
2 1/4 T lemon juice
nutmeg
Instructions:
Beat together * ingredients
Add dry ingredients - mixed together: 1 c. flour, 1/4 t. salt, 1/2 t. soda, 1/2 t. Baking Powder, 1/2 t. cinnamon, 1/2 t. nutmeg.
Double for big pan. Bake longer.
Serve on Lemon Sauce:
sugar, boiled water, cornstarch, butter, lemon juice, nutmeg
Mix sugar and cornstarch. Add water gradually. Stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Add rest of ingredients.
Author: Nana

Title: Mom's Frosting
Ingredients:
2/3 stick of butter
1/2 - 3/4 box confectioners sugar.
milk
(vanilla, or vanilla and almond, or coffee and dry cocoa)
Instructions: butter, confectioners suger add milk 1 T. at a time. While still stiff add flavor (1 t. vanilla) or 1/2 vanilla 1/2 almond) or (1/4 c. coffee with cocoa (dry)).
Author: Sandy Seifert

Title: Grammie's Blueberry Cake
Ingredients:
*2 c. flour
*2 t. Baking Powder
*1/2 t. salt
1/4 c. butter
3/4 c. sugar
1 egg
1/2 c. milk
2 c. blueberries
Topping:
1/2 c. sugar
1/2 c. flour
1/2 t. cinnamon
1/4 c. soft butter
Instructions:
Heat oven to 375 degrees.
Cream butter add sugar and egg. Put a little (few Tbsp) of * mixture in dish with blueberries. Stir in * (dry) mixture alternately with milk, beginining and ending with dry mixture.
Fold in Blueberries. Spread batter onto greased 8 or 9" square pan. Sprinkle with Topping. Bake @ 375 x 40-45 min
Author: Grammie

Title: Steamed Chocolate Pudding
Ingredients:
* 1 egg
*1 c. sugar
*2 T. soft butter
*2 squares melted baking chocolate
% 1 3/4 c. flour
% 1 t. salt
% 1/4 t. soda
% 1/4 t. cream of tarter
1 c. milk
1 t. vanilla
Hard Sauce Ingredients:
1/4 # soft butter
1 1/2 c. confectioners sugar
1 1/2 t. vanilla
pinch salt
Instructions:
Beat * ingredients well
Sift % ingredients together.
Beat % into * ingredients, alternately with 1 c. milk and 1 t. vanilla.
Pour into greased (and floured with bakers joy) 1 quart (steam pudding mold) and steam 2 hours.
Hard Sauce:
Beat well and chill sauce ingredients
Author: Grammie

Title: Coke Cake
Ingredients:
2 cups sugar
2 cups flour
1/2 cup crisco oil
1/2 cup butter (1 stick)
3 T. cocoa
1 c. coke
1/2 c. buttermilk
1 t. vanilla
1 1/2 c. small marshmellows
1 t. soda
2 eggs
Icing: cut in 1/2 if desired
1/2 cup butter
3 T. cocoa
6 T. coke
1 box confectioners sugar
1 t. vanilla
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees
Sift * ingredients in large bowl.
Mix % ingredients in sauce pan. Bring to boil and pour over dry mixture. It may look lumpy -- just beat well. Add 1/2 c. buttermilk, 1 t. vanilla, 1 1/2 c. small marshmellows, 1 t. soda, 2 eggs.
Mix all together vey well. Pour into greased 9x13x2 pan and bake 45 minutes. (batter will look thin)
Icing: (cut in half if desired)
Bring to a boil: 1/2 c. butter, 3 T. cocoa, and 6 T. coke.
Take from heat and add: 1 box confectioners sugar, 1 t. vanilla
Spread on Cake while hot and still in pan.
Author: Nonnie

Title: Graham Chocolate Cookies
Ingredients:
1 package (1 c) melted choc. bits
1 can of condensed milk
2 1/8 c. rolled grahamcracker crumbs
1 t. vanilla
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Add 1 package (1 c) melted choc. bits to a can of condensed milk. Then 2 1/8 c. rolled grahamcracker crumbs. 1 t. vanilla. Mix well. Drop by teaspoon on parchment pan and cook for 10 minutes.
Author: Grammie

Title: Snickerdoodles
Ingredients:
1 c. shortening
1 1/2 c sugar
2 eggs
2 3/4 c sifted flour
2 t cream of tartar
1 t baking soda
1/2 t salt
2 t cinnamon
--------------------------
2 T sugar
2 T cinnamon
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 400.
Mix shortening, sugar and eggs throughly. 
Blend flour, cream of tartar, baking soda and salt. Stir into shortening mixture.
Shape dough into 1" balls. Roll in mixture of cinnamon and sugar and place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 8-10 min.

Title: Chocolate Cringles
Ingredients:
1/2 c oil
4 oz unsweetened chocolate, melted
2 1/3 c sugar
4 eggs
3 1/2 c flour
2 1/4 t baking powder
1 1/2 t vanilla
1 c chopped nuts
1 c chocolate chips
confectioners sugar
Instructions:
Cover bowl with plastic wrap and refridgerate for at leat 1 hr or over night.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
Combine oil and melted chocolate, add sugar, 4 eggs, one at a time, mix.
Blend in flour and baking powder. add vanilla, nuts and chocolate chips.
roll out dough into golf ball sized spheres, roll in confectioner's sugar.
place 3 in apart on parchement lined cookie sheets and bake for 17 minutes.
cool on cookie sheet for 2 minutes then transfer to rack.

Title: Pecan Sandies
Ingredients:
1 1/2 c margerine (not butter)
1 1/2 c sugar
1 1/2 t vanilla
3 c flour
1 t baking soda
1/4 t salt
1 c or more broken pecans
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Cream argerine and sugar until fluffy, add vanilla. Beat until blended.
Mix together and add flour, baking soda and salt. Mix until smooth.
Add pecans, mix well.
Form dough into 2 inch rolls on plastic wrap. incase in plastic wrap and refridgerate until firm. Slice 1/4" thick.
Bake on lightly greased cookie sheet for 12 minutes.
Makes 4 dozen.
Dough can be frozen.

Title: Snowball Cookies
Ingredients:
2 c flour
2 c fine chopped pecans
1/4 c sugar
1 c butter, softened
1 t vanilla
powdered sugar
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 325.
In a large mixer bowl combine all ingredients except powdered sugar. Beat at a low speed, scraping bowl often until well mixed, about 3-4 minutes. 
Shape rounded teaspoon fulls of dough into 1" balls. Place balls 1" apart on ungreased cookie sheets, bake for 18-25 minutes or until very lightly browned.
Roll in powdered sugar while still warm and again when cool.
Makes 3 dozen.

Title: Nieman Marcus Chocolate Chip Cookies
Ingredients:
2 C butter
2 c sugar
2 c brown sugar
4 eggs
2 t vanilla
4 c flour
5 c oatmeal
1 t salt
2 t baking powder
2 t baking soda
24 oz chocolate chips (4 c)
8 oz hershey bar grated
3 c chopped nuts
Instructions:
preheat oven to 375 degrees.
Cream butter and sugars. Add eggs and vanilla. Mix together with flour, oatmeal, salt, Baking Powder, and Soda.
Add chocolate chips, candy and nuts.
Roll into balls and place 2" apart on cookie sheet. Bake 13-15 minutes.
makes 120 cookies.

Title: Big Soft Ginger Cookies
Ingredients:
2 1/4 c flour
2 t ginger
1 t baking soda
3/4 t cinnamon
1/2 t cloves
1/4 t salt
3/4 c butter
1 c sugar
1 egg
1/4 c molasses
-----------------------------
2 T sugar
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Combine flour, ginger, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves and salt, set aside.
In large bowl mix butter and sugar until fluffy, add egg and molasses, beat.
Add dry ingredients, shape into 1 1/2 " balls, roll into sugar and place on cookie sheet, bake 10 min, let stand 2 minutes, transfer to cookie sheet.

Title: Cookie press cookies
Ingredients:
1 c butter
1 c powdered sugar
1 c sugar
2 eggs
1 c vegetable oil
1 t salt
1 t vanilla
4 1/2 c + 4 t flour
1 t soda
1 t cream of tartar
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Cream butter and sugars, add 2 eggs and mix.
Add rest of ingredients.
put in press and shape cookies.
bake for 8 - 10 minutes.

Title: Sugar Cookie
Ingredients:
1 c butter
2 c sugar
3 2/3 c flour
3/4 t baking soda
1/2 t salt
2 t baking powder
1 t vanilla
3 eggs beaten
Instructions:
Preheat coven to 350.
Cream butter, sugar, baking soda, salt and vanilla. Add eggs, beat and add the rest of the ingredients. chill
Bake for 8 minutes.

Title: Oatmeal Cookies
Ingredients:
3 eggs, beaten well
1 c rasins
1 t vanilla
1 c butter
1 c brown sugar
1 c white sugar
2 1/2 c flour
1 t salt
1 t cinnamon
2 t baking soda
2 c oatmeal
3/4 c chopped pecans
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Combine eggs, rasins and vanilla, let stand for 1 hour covered with plastic.
Crream together butter and sugars. Add flour, salt, cinnamon and baking soda to sugars. Mix well.
Blend in egg and rasin mixture, oatmeal and nuts. Dough will be stiff.
Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet and bake for 10 - 12 minutes.

Title: Hermits
Ingredients:
1 c sugar
1/2 c crisco
2 eggs
2 T molasses
1 c rasins, put through food chopper
2 1/4 c flour
1 t baking soda
1/2 t salt
1/2 t cinnamon
1/4 t cloves
1/4 t nutmeg
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Cream sugar and shortening, add eggs, beat well. Add molasses and rasins.
Combine dry ingredients and add to egg mixture.
Place on cookie sheet, about 2-2 1/2"inches wide, pat until length of cookie sheet.
Sprinkle with sugar and draw fork down length.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, turn half-way through.

Title: Rolled Christmas Cookies
Ingredients:
2 c flour
3/4 c sugar
1 1/2 t baking powder
1 egg
1/2 t salt
1 t vanilla
1/2 c butter, softened
1 T milk
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Mix flour, baking powder and salt. 
Cream together shortening and sugar. Add egg and beat until smooth and fluffy. Stir in vanilla, add flour and milk alternating 1/2 of flour, milk, rest of flour by hand. 
Chill and roll out to 1/4" inch thick.
Cut and bake for 7 minutes.

Title: Buckeye Ball
Ingredients:
1 c butter
1 box powdered sugar
1 c peanut butter
1 c crushed graham cracker crumbs
1 c ground nuts
--------------------------------------
1 1/2 c chocolate chips
1/3 bar parafin
Instructions:
Mix inside and chill.
Melt chocolate and parafin.
Shape chilled mix into balls and keep chilled.
Dip into chocolate using toothpick, leave a small circle uncovered, like a buckeye.

Title: Soft Caramels
Ingredients:
1 lb butter not margarine
2 # brown sugar
1 Bottle light Karo syrup (2 l)
2 cans Eagle Brand condensed milk
1 T. vanilla
Instructions:
Cook to 240 degrees on candy thermometer
Stirring constantly - use heavy pan.
Butter (well) a jelly roll pan.
Pour candy into pan. Let set a day in refrigerator until firm.
Remove from pan to cutting board or marble block (ironing bottom of pan helps to loosen it) Score befor cutting. cut. Wrap each piece individually and store in refrigerator. Lasts a year or more! use 3 1/2" x 4" paper.

Title: Quiche
Ingredients:
2 c. (6-8 oz.) shredded swiss cheese
1/4 - 1/2 c. shredded cheddar cheese
2 T. parmesan cheese
6 slices bacon
2 c. homo. or light cream
4 eggs slightly beaten
1/2 t. salt
1 T corn starch
1/4 t. nutmeg
dash of pepper
2 T. melted butter
9 in. unbaked pie shell
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375 degreees

Title: Pounded Chicken
Ingredients:
Chicken Breast
Bread crumbs with parsley and garlic salt
Olive oil and crushed garlic
Instructions:
Pound chicken to desired thickness. dredge through olive oil then press into bread crumbs.
place on foil lined broiler pan and broil (400 degrees) 7 minutes per side or until well browned aand chicken is cooked.

Title: Sandy's Chicken Burritos
Ingredients:
Lowry's Seasoned Salt
Chili Powder
Onion Powder
Chicken Broth (Bouillion)
2-3 Chichen Breats
Tortillas
Cheddar Cheese
Instructions:
Pound chicken. Cut in thirds. Sprinkle with seasonings. Make one cup broth (bouillion) in the microwave. Broil chicken until cooked through. 
Mix chicken juice with half of bouillon. Cut chicken into cubes and place in large bowl. Add liquid just enough to moisten chicken.
Place chicken and cheese in tortilla and wrap like burrito. Wrap in saran wrap. Place in microwave until hot (approx. 45 seconds on power level 8). 
Serve with salsa, sour cream, tomato, and lettuce.
Place a small amount of the chicken mixture and cheese in each tortilla.
Either bake for 15 min at 350 or saran wrap each burrito and microwave for 30 seconds each.
Garnish
Author: Sandy

Title: Greek Kabobs
Ingredients:
Lamb (or beef) chunks
small amount olive oil
red wine (lots)
thyme
oregano
garlic
salt
pepper
bell peppers
onions
tomatoes
mushrooms
Instructions:
mix meet and seasonings
marinate over night
cut up veggies and skewer with meat
cook over hot gril 3 min per side.

Title: Grilled Corn
Ingredients:
corn on the cob
butter
salt
butcher's twine
Instructions:
shuck corn except final layer
de silk
rub with butter and salt and recover with remaining husks
tie closed
grill 6 min each side.

Title: Beef & Broccoli
Ingredients:
1 can Campbell's® French Onion Soup 
1 tbsp. soy sauce 
1/4 tsp. ground ginger 
1 clove garlic, minced 
2 tbsp. cornstarch 
1 lb. boneless beef sirloin, steak, 3/4" thick* 
2 tbsp. vegetable oil 
4 cups broccoli flowerets 
1 medium red pepper, cut into strips 
0 Hot cooked rice
Instructions:
MIX soup, soy, ginger, garlic and cornstarch.
SLICE beef into very thin strips.
HEAT 1 tbsp. oil in skillet. Add beef and stir-fry until browned and juices evaporate. Remove beef.
HEAT remaining oil. Add broccoli and pepper and stir-fry until vegetables are tender-crisp. Return beef to skillet. Stir in soup mixture. Heat to a boil. Cook and stir until mixture boils and thickens. Serve over rice.

Title: 7-Layer Bars
Ingredients:
1 stick butter
1 cup each:
graham cracker crumbs
chocolate chips
butterscotch chips
chopped nuts
shredded sweetened coconut
1 can sweetened condensed milk
Instructions:
preheat oven to 350.
line 9x11 pan with aluminum foil
place stick of butter in pan and melt
layer in graham crackers and other ingredients with the can of sweetened condensed milk on top
bake for 1/2 hour.
allow to coll before cutting.

Title: Chicken with Onions and Garlic
Ingredients:
1 whole roaster (about 4 lbs) cut up
1 T butter, softened
2 t coarse salt
1 t ground pepper
2 onions, quartered and divided
10 garlic cloves, peeled
6 sprigs thyms plus more for garnish
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 475.
Rinse chicken pieces; pat dry. Brush chicken with butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper
Place chicken in small roastin pan. Arrange onions, garlic, and thyem sprigs over and under chicken. 
Roast; after 20 minutes baste with pan drippings. Continue roasting until chicken is golden and cooked through, 15 - 20 minutes more. transfer the chicken to platter and set aside.
Pour pan drippings through a sieve into a small bowl; discard solids. arrange onions and all but 3 garlic cloves around chicken. Whisk remaining garlic with pan juices. Strain juices again; discard solids. Pour Sauce over chicken; garnish with thyme sprigs.
Author: Martha

Title: Almond Macaroons
Ingredients:
4 oz almond paste
1/2 c powdered sugar; plus more for dusting
Pinch of salt
1 egg white
1/4 t pure vanilla extract
1/4 c sliced almonds
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 300. Line baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.
Place almond paste, sugar and salt in the bowl of an electric mixer (fitted with the paddle attatchment); beat on medium speed until mixture looks crumbly; about 3 minutes. Add egg white and vanilla. Continue beating until mixture is smooth anf thick; about 3 minutes more.
Drop 12 even tablespoons of batter about 2 inches apart on lined baking sheet; place 2 almond slices on each mound of dough. Bake cookies, rotating baking sheet half way through, until golden brown; 20 to25 minutes. Transfer cookies to a wire rack; let cool completely.
Just before serving, lightly dust powdered sugar over cookies.
Author: Martha

Title: PB&C Cookie Sandwiches (also PB&B)
Ingredients:
1/2 c butter, softened
1/2 c sugar
1/2 c brown sugar
1/2 t baking soda
1/2 t salt
1 egg
1 t vanilla
1 c flour
1/2 c unsweetened cocoa powder
1/2 11 oz pkg peanut butter or butterscotch pieces
1/2 11 oz pkg milk chocolate peices
---------
1/2 c chocolate frosting and 1/2 c peanut butter
or
1 c chocolate frosting
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 375.
in large mixing bowl beat butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds. Add granulated sugar, brown sugar, soda and salt. Beat until combined. Add egg and vanilla. Beat until combined. Beat in as much flour as you can with the mixer. Stir in any remaining flour and the cocoa powder. Stir in peices.
Roll dough into 1 inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets. Flatten cookie slightly with a glass dipped in sugar. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until tops are cracked and look dry. Let cool on cookie sheets for 1 minute before transfering to wire racks to cool completely.
in a small bowl stir together frosting a peanut butter. Spread 2 t of the mixture on the bottom half of the cookies. top with remaining cookies. Makes 24

Title: Chocolate-Hazelnut cookies
Ingredients:
3/4 c butter; softened
1 c sugar
1 c brown sugar
1 13oz jar chocolate-hazelnut spread
1 oz unsweetened chocolate; melted and cooled
1 t vanilla
2 eggs
2 1/2 c flour
1 t cinnamon
1/2 t baking powder
1/2 t baking soda
1/4 t salt
1 c semisweet chocolate peices
1 c coarsly chopped, toasted and skinned hazelnuts
5 oz white chocolate, melted
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
In a very large bowl beat butter with an electric mixer on medium or high speed for 30 seconds. Add sugars gradually. Beat until combined, scraping the sides of the bowl occasionally. Add chocolate-hazelnut spread, unsweetened chocolate and vanilla. Beat until combined. Add eggs,one at a time., beating until combined. Combine flour, cinnamon, bakingsoda, baking powder and salt. Beat as much of the powdered mixture into the creamed mixture as you can. Stir in any remaining folur mixture. Stir in chocolate peices and hazelnuts.
Drop dough by rounded tabelspoon 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake about 10 minutes or until the edges atre just set. Let cool on cookie sheets for about 2 minutes before transfering to wire racks to cool completely. Drizzle melted white chocolate over cooled cookies; let stand until set.

Title: Artichoke spread
Ingredients:
14 oz can artichokes, drained and cut up
1 c parmesan cheese
1 c mayo
4 oz can green chilies
garlic salt
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Mix all ingredients together and place in glass container.
Bake for 20 minutes.
Serve with crackers or tortilla chips.
Author: Grammie

Title: Greenbean casserole
Ingredients:
18 oz greenbeans - French cut drained
1 can mushroom soup
1 can onion rings - save a few to top the cassarole
1/8 t pepper
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350.
Mix ingredients and bake for 30 minutes.
Top with rest of onion rings and bake 5 minutes longer.
Author: Grammie

Title: Easy cheese fondue
Ingredients:
1 garlic clove cut to rub on fondue pot
1/2 c dry white wine
1 10 oz tub alfredo sauce
1 8 oz bag shredded swiss cheese
1/8 t ground nutmeg
1 T Kirsch or Brandy
Instructions:
Rub the garlic clove aroung the inside of the fondue pot (or saucepan), discard. Add the wine and heat to boiling. Reduce flame (or stovetop) to low and add the alfredo sauce, swiss cheese and nutmeg. stir constantly until the cheese is melted and very hot. add the Kirsch or Brandy.
Serve with cubes of bread, sliced pears or apples.

Title: Spaghetti with Clams
Ingredients:
Course salt
1 lb spaghetti
2 T olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 pinch red pepper flakes
1 1/2 lbs little-neck clams, scrubbed
1 c dry white wine
1 T parsley
Juice of 1 lemon
3 T butter
Black pepper
Instructions:
Bring large pot of water to boil; salt generously. Add spaghetti and cook until slightly underdone, about 7 minutes. Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid. Set aside.
Meanwhile, heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and chili pepper; cook until garlic is golden, about 2 minutes. Add clams and white wine, and raise heat to high. Bring to a boil, cover and cook, shaking occasionally, 2 to 3 minutes, until clams open. Stir in parsley. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.
Return skillet to medium-high heat. Add reserved pasta water and lemon juice; reduce until slightly thickened, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat; whisk in butter. Add clam mixture and spaghetti. Cook over medium-low heat until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper; garnish with more parsley.
Author: Martha

Title: Monkey Bread
Ingredients:
1/2 pkg. Rich's Frozen Dinner Rolls (full pkg overflows pan)
1 pkg. vanilla or butterscotch pudding mix (not instant)
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup chopped nuts
1 stick butter, melted
Instructions:
Mix dry ingredients. Grease Bundt pan and spinkle in half of the dry ingredients. Put in frozen rolls, and pour over the melted butter. Sprinkle on the rest of the dry ingredients. Let rise overnight.
Bake at 325 for 20-25 minutes.
Variation: Place all nuts in bottom of pan, then rolls, then rest of dry ingredients mixed with the butter. This creates a nice looking nut topping when flipped over.
Author: Sandy

Title: Hot Fudge Cake
Ingredients:
1 pkg. Devil's Food Cake mix (not pudding)
1 c. sugar
1/2 c. cocoa
2 c. hot water
1 t vanilla
Instructions: Prepare cake mix as directed. Pour into greased 9x13 pan. Stir together sugar, water, cocoa, and vanilla. Pour over batter. Do NOT stir. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes. Let stand 10 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.
Author: Sandy

Title: Beef Barbeque
Ingredients:
2 1/2-3# boneless chuck roast
1 large onion chopped
1/2 c. diced celery
2 T. brown sugar 
1 t. salt, 1/4 t. pepper
2 T. vinegar
4 T. lemon juice
1 c. tomato sauce
2 T. Worcestershire sauce
1 t. chili powder
1 1/2 c. water
Instructions:
Trim fat from meat. Put all ingredients in a dutch oven
or covered casserole. Bake at 325-350 degrees for about
6 hours--until meat falls apart. Check during cooking to
see if more water is needed.Use 2 forks and pull apart. 
Great served on buns with cole slaw.
Author: Grammie

Title: ENTRECOTE MARCHAND deVIN
Ingredients:
4 Rib or Club steaks
2 T. butter
1/2 c. dry red wine, 1/4 t. thyme, S & P
3 T. minced shallots or white portion
of scallions
6. T. butter
Minced parsley
Instructions:
Saute steaks in 2 T. butter turning once so
both sides are seared and meat is med. rare,
6-7 minutes per side. Remove from pan
and keep warm.
Pour fat from pan and add wine, shallots,
thyme, S & P.
Simmer until wine is almost evaporated and
becomes thickly syrupy.
Remove pan from heat and stir in butter,
a tablespoon at a time until sauce is smooth 
and thick. Adjust seasonings, stir in parsley,
and spoon over steaks.
Author: Grammie

Title: Flank Steak Marinade
Ingredients:
1 T. brown sugar
1 T. salt
2 T. salad oil
3 T. catsup
2 T. vinegar
1/2 teas. tobasco
1/4 c. water
1 small onion sliced
Flank Steak
Instructions:
Place flank steak in zip loc plastic bag.
Add sliced onion slices.
Mix rest of ingrdients, then pour in bag, and seal.
Enough for one flank steak. 
Might need to double for London Broil if larger than flank.
Or for two steaks, make 2 recipes and use 2 bags
I place bag in a pyrex baking dish in refrigerator so I can
flip the bag over a few times while marinating
in refrigerator 12-24 hours.
Cook on grille. Cut diagonally into thin slices.
Author: Grammie

Title: Ground Beef Barbecue
Ingredients:
1# ground beef browned
1 large chopped onion
1 c. chopped celery
1 green pepper chopped
3 T. brown sugar
1 T. dry mustard
1 t. salt
1 t. vinegar
1-14 oz. bottle catsup
1/2 c. water (rinse bottle)
Instructions:
Simmer 1-2 hours.
Serve on buns
Author: Grammie

Title: Margaret's Pork Tenderloin
Ingredients:
2 T. oil
¼ c. vinegar
½ t. Worcestershire Sauce
2 t. soy
¼ t. salt
1 T. chopped onion
2 T. brown sugar
pinch ginger
Instructions:
Mix above and marinate pork overnight. 
Can be baked for an hour at 325 degrees, basting while cooking
Or grilled and baste while grilling
Author: Grammie

Title: Orange Cranberry glazed Pork Tenderloin
Ingredients:
1 (16 oz.) can whole-berry cranberry sauce
1 t. grated orange rind
2/3 c. fresh orange juice
2 t. balsamic vinegar
1/8 t. salt
½ t. pepper
¼ t. ground allspice
1/8 t. ground cinnamon
1/8 t. ground cloves
1 ½ # pork tenderloins, trimmed
Garnishes, fresh rosemary sprigs, whole cranberries
Instructions:
Bring first 9 ingredients to a boil in a saucepan.
Reduce heat and simmer mixture for 20 minutes.
Place pork on tinfoil in shallow roasting pan.
Bake at 425 degrees or until meat thermometer
Inserted in thickest part registers 160 degrees,
Basting occasionally with half of the cranberry
Mixture. Slice pork and serve with rest of sauce.
Prepare cranberry basting sauce up to 8 hours ahead and chill.
Author: Grammie

Title: Pepper Steak
Ingredients:
1-1/2 # sirloin steak, 1/2x2x1/8
½ t. salt
1 c. diced onion
1 c. bouillon
3 T. soy sauce
1 clove garlic, minced
2 green peppers, cut into 1 inch pieces
2 T. cornstarch
¼ c. cold water
2 tomatoes, peeled and cut into eighths
3-4 c. hot cooked rice
Instructions:
Trim fat and bone from meat. Cut meat into 4 or 6 servings.
Grease skillet lightly with fat from meat. Brown thoroughly on one side.
Turn .Sprinkle with ¼ t. salt. Brown other side. Turn. Sprinkle with remaining
¼ t. salt. Add onion; cook and stir until tender. Add bouillon, soy sauce,
and garlic .Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until meat is tender.
Add green pepper cover and simmer 5 minutes. Blend cornstarch with water
Gradually stir into skillet. Cook, stirring constantly until mixture thickens
And boils. Boil and stir 1 minute. Add tomatoes and heat through. Serve immediately with hot rice.
Author: Grammie

Title: Pork at it's Peak
Ingredients:
1 5# pork loin roast, boned, rolled and tied
Marinadedouble to use as gravy too
½ cup dry white wine
¼ cup canola oil
6 T. Dijon mustard
¼ c. chopped mushrooms
2 T. soy sauce
2 T. fresh lemon juice
2 T. minced onion
2 T. butter
½ t. celery seed
½ t. salt
½ t. pepper
Instructions:
Mix together marinade ingredients. Place pork in rectangular pan and pour marinade over meat. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours, turning occasionally.
Drain and reserve marinade.
Cook marinade to use as gravy.. Bring to a boil.
Roast @ 350 degrees for 2 ½ hours till 155-160 degrees
Baste frequently with marinade last 30 minutes of roasting time
Serve with sautéed apples
Peel and chunk apples. Sprinkle with lemon juice.
Add chunk butter and chunk brown sugar
SauteN
Turn off the heat, then heat up to serve.
Mashed potatoes, corn and green beans
Tomato, mozzarella, basil salad
Author: Grammie

Title: Pork Loin with Peach Sauce
Ingredients:
¼ cup Dijon Mustard
¼ cup Mayonnaise
1 (2#) boneless center cut pork loin roast
1 cups Italian seasoned bread crumbs
1 Tab. butter
1 small onion, diced
2 garlic cloves, minced
3 cups white grape juice
1 Tab. chicken bouillon granules (or cube)
1 (16 oz) can peach slices, undrained and diced
Instructions:
Make sauce first. Can be reheated.
Combine mustard and mayonnaise. Brush over roast.
Coat in breadcrumbs and place roast on a rack in a roasting pan.
Bake at 400° for 20 minutes, reduce heat and bake 1 ½ hours or until a meat thermometer inserted into thickest portion registers 160°. Slice roast and keep warm.
Sauce
Melt butter in a heavy saucepan. Add onion and garlic and sauté until tender. Stir in grape juice, bouillon, and peach slices, diced and juice too. Bring to a boil. Cook until mixture reduces and thickens, stirring occasionally. Serve with pork.
Took me 1 1/2 hours to simmer sauce to reduce it enough
Author: Grammie

Title: Pork Tenderloin Diane
Ingredients:
1# pork tenderloin
2 T. butter
2 T lemon juice
1 T worcestershire
1 t. dijon mustard, 1 T. minced parsley or chives
Instructions:
Cut in 8 crosswise pieces, press to 1 or 1/2 inch
Sprinkle one side with lemon pepper
Heat butter---sautee medalions, 4-5 min per side (think it takes less time)
Remove from pan. Put on plates. Add rest of ingredients to make a sauce and pour over top of pork.
Good with parsleyed potatoes, fettuccini, rice or whatever.
Author: Grammie

Title: McCrate's Pork Tenderloin
Ingredients:
12 oz 1 # pork tenderloin
½ c. apricot preserve or orange marmalade
3 T. Dijon mustard
2 c. sliced fresh mushrooms
½ c. sliced scallions
2 T. Orange Juice
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Trim fat from meat.
Place on rack in shallow pan. Insert meat thermometer.
Roast uncovered for 10 minutes.
Stir together preserve and mustard. 
Spread half over meat, and roast 15-25 minutes to 155 degrees.
Transfer meat to platter and cover with foil. Let stand 10 minutes.
Spray medium saucepan.(& olive oil) Add mushrooms and scallions.
Cook and stir 2-3 minutes till mushrooms are tender. 
Stir in remaining mustard and OJ. Cook till heated through.
Slice meat thinly and spoon sauce over it
Makes 4 servings; 240 calories Good with rice.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cashew Pork Stir Fry
Ingredients:
1 pound pork tenderloin
1 T. grated orange rind
¾ c. orange juice
1 T. cornstarch
3 T. soy sauce
1/3 c. corn syrup
¼ t. ground ginger
2 T. cooking oil, divided
2 large carrots, peeled and sliced diagonally
2 stalks celery, diagonally sliced
½ c. cashews
Instructions: Cut pork tenderloin into thin strips. Set aside. Combine next 6 ingredients, stirring well. Heat one T. oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add carrots and celery, stir-frying about 3 minutes. Remove veg., set aside. Pour remaining T. oil into skillet. Aedd pork, stir-frying about 3 minutes. Return veg. To pan, add OJ mixture and cashews. Cook stirring constantly over medium heat, until thickened. Serve over hot rice if desired.
Author: Grammie

Title: Sesame butterfly Chops
Ingredients:
4 boneless pork chops, butterflied, about 1 pound
1 T. sesame oil
2 T. sesame seeds
1 t. dry ginger
2 T. soy sauce
¼ c. dry white wine
½ # fresh mushrooms, sliced
2 green onions and tops, sliced
1 t. butter
Instructions: Heat sesame oil in heavy skillet over medium heat. Add chops and brown, sprinkling with sesame seed and ginger. When both sides are browned, add soy sauce and white wine to skillet. Cover and cook over low for 10 minutes. Unclove skillet, add mushrooms and onions; stir gently to sauté, 1-2 minutes. Remove chops to serving platter. Add butter to pan, stir constantly to deglaze pan. Pour mushroom/onion sauce over chops and serve
Author: Grammie

Title: Apricot Pork Medallions
Ingredients:
1 pound pork tenderloin
2 T. butter divided
½ cup dried apricots, chopped
2 green onions sliced
¼ t. dry ginger
1 t. wine vinegar
2 t. brown sugar
dash hot pepper sauce
Instructions: Cut tenderloin crosswise into 1 inch pieces. Flatten each piece slightly with heel of hand. Heat 1 T butter in large skillet over medium-high heat. Brown medallions about 2 minutes on each side. Add remaining tablespoon of butter. Cover and simmer for 3-4 minutes. Remove medallions to serving platter, spoon sauce over.
Author: Grammie

Title: Three-way Chili
Ingredients:
1 qt. cold water
2 # ground beef
1 t. cinnamon
½ t. cumin
2 t. salt
½ t. black pepper
1-1/2 t. ground allspice
1 T. chili powder
¼ t. red pepper
2 large bay leaves
1 t. Worcestershire sauce
1-1/2 T. apple cider vinegar
1-6 oz. can tomato paste
1 garlic toe
2 large onions, chopped
Instructions:
Cook for three hours or more 
Refrigerate, and when cold take off fat that accumulates on top.
Add 1 can red kidney beans
Reheat and serve on spaghetti
with grated cheese, chopped onions, oyster crackers.
Author: Grammie

Title: Apple Pear Stuffing
Ingredients:
½ cup butter
2 large celery stalks, diced
1 medium onion, diced
2 medium sized pears
2 medium sized apples
½ cup golden raisins
1-8 oz. package herb-stuffing mix
½ cup pecans, chopped
1 t. dried sage leaves
½ t. cardamon
¾ t. salt
¼ c. water
Celery leaves and Thyme sprigs for garnish
Instructions:
Heat butter, cook celery and onion till tender.
Peel and coarsely chop 2 pears and 2 apples.
Add these and raisins to celery mixture.
Cook 5 minutes, stirring often until fruit is tender.
Remove from heat and add rest of ingredients.
Toss until well mixed.
Bake in casserole, covered at 325 degrees for 40 minutes
Author: Grammie

Title: Baked Bean Casserole
Ingredients:
1 or 2 large cans B & M Beans
1 or 2 cans Campbells Pork and Beans
Instructions:
Spray casserole with Pam
Make layers of:
Beans
Little brown sugar
Powdered dry Mustard
Little Molasses
Cut up cooked bacon 4-6 slices
Slices of Onion
Keep repeating layers till all is used.
Bake at 325 degrees for 2 hours, stirring occasionally.
Using 1 or 2 cans depends on size of crowd.
Author: Grammie

Title: Baked Spaghetti
Ingredients:
1 cup chopped onion
1 cup chopped green pepper
1 Tab. butter
1-28 oz. can tomatoes with liquid, cut up, or can diced tomatoes
1-4 oz. can mushroom stems and pieces, drained
1-2 ¼ oz. sliced ripe olives, drained
2 teas. dried oregano
1 # ground beef, browned and drained. Optional
12 oz. spaghetti, cooked and drained
2 cups (8 oz.) shredded cheddar cheese
1-10 ¾ oz. Can cream of mushroom soup, undiluted
¼ cup water
¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
Instructions:
In a large skillet, sauté onion and green pepper in butter.
Add tomatoes, mushrooms, olives and oregano.
Add ground beef. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.
Place half the spaghetti in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Top with half of the vegetable mixture.
Sprinkle with half of cheese. Repeat layers.
Mix the soup and water till smooth; pour over
casserole. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake uncovered at 350 for 30-35 minutes or until
Heated through. 12 servings
Author: Grammie

Title: Cheeseburger Casserole
Ingredients:
1 pound lean ground beef 
½ teaspoon salt 
¼ teaspoon pepper
½ teaspoon Worcestershire Sauce
¼ cup chopped onion 
¼ cup chopped green bell pepper-optional
I (8-ounce) can tomato sauce 
4 slices processAmerican cheese or cheddar 
1 (6-ounce) can refrigerated biscuits
Instructions:
Brown ground beef in a large skillet over medium heat, stirring until it crum¬bles; drain. 
Return beef to skillet. Stir in salt and next 3 ingredients; 
cook 1 minute. Add tomato sauce; reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes
Spoon into an 8-inch square bak¬ing dish; top with cheese.
Flatten biscuits into 3 ½ inch cir¬cles, and place over cheese.
 Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are browned.
Author: Grammie

Title: Company Casserole
Ingredients:
1/2 lb (4 cups cooked) curly egg noodles
1 tbsp butter
1 lb lean ground beef or bison
2 8-oz can tomato sauce
1 cup (8 oz) cottage cheese
1 8-oz package cream cheese, softened
1/4 cup sour cream
1/3 cup snipped green onions or chives
1 tbsp minced green pepper
2 tbsps melted butter
Instructions:
Cook noodles and drain. Brown meat in 1 tablespoon butter. Stir in tomato sauce. Remove from heat.
In a large bowl, combine cottage cheese, cream cheese, sour cream, onions and green pepper.
In a 2-quart casserole dish, spread half the noodles, cover with cheese mixture, then cover with rest of noodles. Pour on melted butter, the meat mixture. Bake at 375 degrees uncovered, 30 minutes.
NOTE: A Browning family favorite from waaaaay back. We now use ground bison instead of beef.
Author: Grammie

Title: Congressional Club Chile
Ingredients:
1 # ground beef
1 large onion, sliced
1 green pepper, chopped (optional)
1 or 2 (13 oz) cans diced or crushed tomatoes
1 T chili powder
1 ½ t. salt
1/8 t. paprika
Dash cayenne
3 cloves garlic 
1 bay leaf
1 (1# 14 oz) can kidney beans, drained
Instructions:
Brown meat, stirring to keep crumbly. Add onions, garlic,
and gr. pepper and cook till tender. Add tomatoes, salt,
paprika, cayenne, bay leaf and chili powder
Simmer UNCOVERED 2 hours, adding water if more liquid is needed.
Add beans and heat thoroughly.
Author: Grammie

Title: Edwardo's Chicago-Style Deep Dish Pizza
Ingredients:
Dough (Sicilian-style):
1 envelope active dry yeast
1 1/2 cups hotwater (120 degrees to 130 degress)
3 to 3 1/2 cups unsifted all-purpose unbleached flour
1/2 cup olive oil
1 tsp. salt
Stuffing & Topping:
1-2 pounds fresh spinach, washed, drained and coarsely chopped
3-4 clove garlic, finely chopped
1 small hot red or green pepper, halved and seeded
1 tsp. salt
1/2 tsp. pepper
1 tablespoon olive oil
cornmeal for pan
1 lb. mozzarella cheese, coarsely shredded
1 can (28 oz.) whole tomatoes, well drained and coarsely chopped (in food processor)
5 fresh basil leaves, chopped OR: 1 teaspoon leaf basil, crumbled (fresh best!)
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese
Instructions:
1. Prepare dough: Sprinkle yeast over hot water in large bowl. Stir gently with fork till yeast is dissolved and liquid is light brown. Add 1 cup flour, oil and salt. Mix thoroughly with wooden spoon. Add second cup flour; mix until dough begins to come away from side of bowl and forms soft sticky mass - Ruth adds a little more flour.
2. Scrape dough onto floured board. Knead 1/3 cup flour, or more, into dough, a little at a time until no longer sticky. Knead until smooth and elastic; whole process about 5-10 minutes.
3. Place dough in lightly oiled bowl; turn to coat with oil. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled in bulk - 30-45 minutes.
4. Meanwhile, saute spinach, garlic, pepper, salt and pepper in oil in skillet just til spinach wilts. (Discard hot pepper, if using that.) Turn spinach into colander, squeeze out liquid. Chop spinach, set aside. Chop tomatoes and basil, set aside.
5. Preheat oven to very hot (500 degrees). Grease 15 inch deep-dish pizza pan and sprinkle with cornmeal.
6. Punch dough down. Turn onto board. Knead 1 minute. Return 1/3 of dough to bowl; cover. Roll out other 2/3s of dough into 18 inch circle. Fit into prepared pan, pressing and shaping dough up side of pan.
7. Combine spinach and mozzarella. Turn into crust - spread evenly.
8. Roll out remaining dough into 14 inch circle. Place on top and pinch side and top together; crimp edges. Cut slits in top for steam vents.
9. Let rise in warm place 15 minutes before baking.
10. Bake in preheated very hot oven (500 degrees) for 8 minutes. Lower temperature to 400 degrees. Bake 8 more minutes. Spoon tomatoes over top crust; sprinkle with basil and Parmesan. Bake 8-10 minutes longer or until golden brown.
Need a deep-dish pizza pan for this adaptation.
Author: Sandy

Title: Golden Macaroni & Cheese
Ingredients:
7 oz. macaroni
¼ cup butter
¼ cup flour
3 cups milk
2 cups grated cheddar cheese
½ teas. salt
½ teas. dry mustard
¼ teas. pepper
1 teas. Worcestershire sauce
Instructions:
Melt butter in large saucepan; add flour, then gradually add milk stirring constantly. 
Add seasonings. Cook till thickened. Add 1 cup grated cheese. Stir till melted.
Cook macaroni, drain. Add to cheese sauce.
Turn into an 8 inch square baking pan. Sprinkle rest of cheese on top.
Bake at 375 degrees fir 125 minutes. Can be put under broiler for a minute to brown.
Watch it!!
Author: Grammie

Title: Kielbasa with cabbage and fruit
Ingredients:
1 small head cabbage - 2 #
1 T. butter
1 medium onion, finely chopped
½ cup dry white wine
1 pkg. (8 oz.) mixed dry fruit
½ cup chicken broth
¼ t. dried thyme
¼ t. salt
¼ t. black pepper
1 fully cooked kielbasa cut into 1 inch pieces
Instructions:
Cut cabbage into quarters, remove core. Thinly slice, discarding tough ribs.
In 8 qt. Dutch oven, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and cook 5 minutes or until tender. Add wine, dried fruit and heat till boiling over high heat. Stir in broth, spices and cabbage. Cover and cook over high heat 5 minutes. Stir in kielbasa and cook 15 minutes longer, or until cabbage is tender and kielbasa is heated through.
Author: Grammie

Title: Mock Cheese Souffle
Ingredients:
Softened butter for greasing dish
and spreading on bread
8 slices white sandwich bread, crusts removed
1 # sharp cheddar cheese, grated
4 large eggs beaten
½ t. salt
2 c. whole milk
2 t. Worcestershire sauce
Dash cayenne pepper
Instructions:
Butter an 8 inch soufflé dish
Butter each slice of bread on one
side and cut in 4 squares
Layer half of bread, buttered side up,
in bottom of dish. Cover with half of
Grated cheese. Repeat.
Place remaining ingredients in a bowl
and mix well. Pour over the bread and cheese.
Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Uncover and 
bake on center rack until the top is browned
and the soufflé is bubbling around the edges.
About 45 minutes.
Author: Grammie

Title: Puerto Rico Rice and Beans via Mary
Ingredients:
1/4 green pepper, diced
¼ onion, diced
clove of garlic, minced or pureed
1 big T. tomato paste
salt, pepper, oregano
1 can Luck's pinto beans
Instructions:
Saute in olive oil on medium heat: 
 1/4 green pepper, diced
 ¼ onion, diced
 clove of garlic, minced or pureed
Add and sauté on low:
1 big T. tomato paste
 salt, pepper, oregano
Add: can Luck's pinto beans 
 ½ "bean can" water
Simmer on low for 10 minutes, covered
Remove cover and reduce juice a little
While beans are simmering, make rice.
1 cup long grain rice to 2 cups water, salt and canola oil
cover and stir occasionally. When water is evaporated
and rice is tender, remove from heat. Place paper towel
on pan and return the cover on top of paper towel.
Left-overs are good.
If you want to serve meat with this dish, get thin steaks and
Pound thinner, mix salt, pepper, garlic powder, oregano, olive oil
and white vinegar. Put mixture on steaks for 1 hour.
In frying pan, place olive oil and thinly sliced onions.
Place steaks on top, cover and cook 10 - 15 minutes
Author: Grammie

Title: Welch Rarebit
Ingredients:
2¼ c. hot milk
2 eggs
¾ t. salt
¾ t. dry mustard
¾ t. worcestershire sauce
¾ # cheddar cheese, cubed
Paprika
Instructions:
Put all ingredients except paprika in blender.
Cover and run on high until smooth
Pur into top of double boiler; stir constantly
over hot water until thick. 
Serve on toasted English muffins or toast.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Author: Grammie

Title: Apple Blossom Punch
Ingredients:
3 12 oz. cans frozen Orange juice
3 quarts Apple Juice
3 quarts Ginger ale
Instructions:
Serve over ice block or bag of cubes
Place ice ring in punch bowl when serving
Make ice ring with half OJ and half water and cut up oranges and cherries
Author: Grammie

Title: Sea Breeze
Ingredients:
64 oz cranberry juice
32 oz pink grapefruit juice
2 c. vodka
Author: Grammie

Title: Fruited Mint Tea
Ingredients:
3 c. Boiling water
4 regular size tea bags (I use decaf)
12 fresh mint sprigs
3/4 c. sugar
1/4 c. fresh lemon juice
1 c. orange juice
cold water to fill 2 quart jar
Garnishes: fresh mint sprigs, orange slices
Instructions:
Pour boiling water over tea bags and mint;
cover and steep 5 minutes. Remove tea bags
and mint, squeezing gently. Stir in sugar till
melted, then add rest of ingredients. Serve
over ice. Yield: 2 quarts.
Author: Grammie

Title: Hot Punch
Ingredients:
2 large bottles Cranapple juice
1 large bottle gingerale
1 teas. cloves
1 cinnamon stick
Instructions: It is convenient to put it in a coffee pot to keep it warm.
Author: Grammie

Title: Pineapple Frosty Punch
Ingredients:
1 46 oz. can pineapple juice
1 can frozen lemonade mix
1 ½ quarts ginger ale
1 quart lemon sherbert
Instructions: Chill all ingredients, serve in punch bowl
Author: Grammie

Title: Hidden Valley Cucumber Sandwiches
Ingredients:
1 long cuke peeled and sliced
1 loaf party bread
dill
8 oz. cream cheese
3-4 T Hellmans
1 package Hidden Valley dressing mix (buttermilk)
Instructions:
Mix 8 oz. cream cheese with 3-4 T Hellmans and
1 package Hidden Valley dressing mix (buttermilk)
Spread bread with creamed mixture, top with cuke slice
or two, top with sprinkle of dill.
If made ahead of time, put on plate, cover with wax paper, 
Another layer etc. then refrigerate
Author: Grammie

Title: Nutty Cream Cheese Party Sandwiches
Ingredients:
½ c. coke
1 c. brown sugar
1 c. raisins
2 T. vegetable oil
2 c. flour
1 t. baking powder
1 t. soda
¼ t. salt
½ t. nutmeg
1 c. chopped walnuts
1 large egg, slightly beaten
1 t. vanilla
1 8 oz. container soft cream cheese
2 T/ honey
½ t. cinnamon
Instructions:
Bring cola to a boil in medium saucepan. Remove from heat.
Stir in sugar, raisins and oil.
Combine flour and next 4 ingred. Stir in cola mixture,
Walnuts, egg, and vanilla. Pour into a greased 9x5
Inch loaf pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes 
Out clean. Cool in pan on wire rack for 20 minutes.
Remove from pan and cook completely.
Cover and chill 8 hours. Slice into ¼ inch slices.
Stir tog. cream cheese, honey and cinnamon; spread on half of the slices.
Top with remaining slices. Cut into thirds. Yield 30 sandwiches
Author: Grammie

Title: Broccolli Rice Casserole
Ingredients:
1 small onion chopped
½ cup chopped celery
1-10 oz. pkg. frozen chopped broccoli, thawed
1 Tab. butter
1 jar (8 oz.) processed cheese spread
1-10 ¾ oz. can cr. of mushroom soup
1 can (5 oz.) evaporated milk
3 cups cooked rice
Instructions:
In a large skillet over medium heat, sauté onion,
Celery and broccoli in butter for 3-5 minutes. 
Stir in cheese, soup and milk until smooth. Place
Rice in a greased 8 inch square casserole. Pour
Cheese mixture over it. Do not stir. Bake uncovered
At 325 degrees for 25-30 minutes ;or until hot and 
Bubbly. Yield 8-10 servings.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cauliflower Buds
Ingredients:
1/4 cauliflower
1/8 water
2 T. oil
salt, pepper and fresh nutmeg
Instructions:
Make small buds-1/4 cauliflower
Place in fry pan on stove
1/8 inch water
2 T. oil
Saute 3ish minutes. Drain:
Place in bowl
Add salt, pepper and fresh nutmeg
Author: Grammie

Title: Cream Cheese Potatos
Ingredients:
10 potatoes, boiled
½ c. melted butter
1 t. salt
1 T. instant onion flakes
1- 8 oz. cream cheese
 ½ to 1 c. hot milk, depending on size of potatoes
Instructions:
Whip potatoes then add remaining ingredients.
Blend well.
Bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes covered.
Author: Joyce McCrate

Title: Creamy Chive Potatoes
Ingredients:
5 pounds russet potatoes, peeled and quartered
½ cup butter
8 oz sour cream (1 c.)
¼ - ½ c. whipping cream
3 T. minced fresh chives
1 ½ t. salt
1 t. onion powder
½ t. pepper
Instructions:
Cook potato in boiling water to cover, 25 min or till tender.
Drain
Add remaining ingredients to potato; mash till smooth
Can be made ahead and refrigerated. To reheat, cook over low 
Heat stirring in additional cream if needed. Microwave?
Author: Grammie

Title: Green Bean Cashew Shuffle
Ingredients:
1 pound fresh green beans
1 T. cooking oil
½ cup sliced onion
1/3 cup dry white wine or chicken broth
¼ to ½ t. salt
¼ t. ground white pepper
½ cup cashew halves
½ cup half and half
½ cup soft bread crumbs
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Cut beans into 1 inch pieces. Cook covered in a small amount of boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat oil over medium high heat. Cook onion, uncovered, in hot oil for 4-5 minutes or until golden brown. Slowly add wine or broth, salt, and pepper. Cook for 2 minutes or until liquid is nearly evaporated. Add ¼ c. cashews and cream. Bring to boiling. Reduce heat to medium. Cook uncovered for three minutes.
Stir in cooked beans. Spoon into 1 ½ quart casserole. Top with crumbs and remaining cashews. Bake, uncovered, for 25-30 minutes or until top browns and mixture is heated through. Makes 6 side-dish servings.
Author: Grammie

Title: Green Bean Casserole
Ingredients:
18 oz. green beans; French cut drained
1 can mushroom soup
1 can onion rings Save a few for top of casserole
1/8 t. pepper
Instructions:
Mix ingredients and bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees
Top with rest of onion rings. 
Bake 5 minutes longer
Author: Grammie

Title: Hashbrown Casserole
Ingredients:
1 (26-32 oz) frozen hash brown potatoes, thawed
1 can cream of chicken soup
1 cup sour cream
2 cups grated cheddar cheese (8 oz.)
½ cup butter, melted
1½ teas. salt
1 medium onion diced
Topping
Mix together
2 cups crushed corn flakes
¼ cup melted butter
Instructions:
Mix the first 7 items together and put in a 9 x 13 inch greased baking dish. I use Pam.Add topping and cover with foil. Bake 45-55 minutes in 350 degree oven. 
Casserole should arrive at church HOT and ready to serve 5:30 PM This is when dinner starts so please be prompt with casseroles.
Author: Grammie

Title: Lemon Carrot Bundles
Ingredients:
1-1/2 # carrots peeled
6 leek strips
2 T. sugar
1/3 c. lemon juice 
1/4 t. salt
Instructions:
Cut carrots into 3 julienne sticks. Arrange carrots on a
steaming rack and place over boiling water; cover & steam
8-10 minutes. Remove carrots and plunge into ice water to 
stop cooking process; drain. Separate into 6 bundles
Place leak strips in boiling water for 1 min. Drain. Carefully
tie a leek strip around each carrot bundle.
Combine LJ, S & S. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer
1 minute or until sugar dissolves. Carefully add carrot bundles
and cook over medium heat 3 minutes or till heated, spooning
lemon mixture over carrots frequently.
Author: Grammie

Title: Marinated Asparagus
Ingredients:
2 # fresh asparagus
¾ c. olive oil
1 T. sugar
½ c. white balsamic vinegar
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 t. red pepper flakes
Instructions:
Snap off tough ends of asparagus, and cook in boiling water to cover for 3 minutes or until crisp tender. Drain.
Plunge into ice water, drain. Arrange in a 13 x 9 dish.
Whisk together rest of ingred. Until well blended. Pour over asparagus. Cover, chill 8 hours. Drain before serving.
Author: Grammie

Title: Sweet onions stuffed with broccoli
Ingredients:
3 med. Vidalia onions
1-10 oz. pkg. chopped broccoli
2/3 c. parmesan cheese
1/4 c. mayonnaise
2 t. lemon juice
2 Tab. flour
2 Tab. margerine
1/4 t. salt
2/3 c. milk
1-3 oz pkg. cream cheese, softened
Instructions:
Peel and halve onions. Parboil in salted water twelve minutes;
drain. Remove centers leaving 3/4 inch edge. Chop center
portions to equal one cup. Cook broccoli according to package
directions; drain. Combine chopped onions, broccoli, parmesan
cheese, mayonnaise and lemon juice. Spoon into centers of
onion halves. Melt margerine. Blend in flour and salt. Add milk
and cook until thick, stirring constantly. Remove from heat and
blend in cream cheese. Spoon sauce over onion halves and
bake, uncovered at 375 degrees. Bake for 20 minutes. Makes
6 servings. Can be served with beef, poultry or fish. Delicious.
Author: Grammie

Title: Orange Glazed Carrots
Ingredients:
1 # carrots (5 or 6 or baby carrots)
2 Tbs. Butter
1/3 cup orange juice
¼ cup brown sugar
Instructions:
Peel carrots: cut in half crosswise then again lengthwise.
Cook in small amount of salted water until tender.
Drain..
Cook butter, oj and brown sugar until syrupy, about 8-10 min.
Pour over carrots.
Author: Grammie

Title: Peas Extraordinaire
Ingredients:
1 pound frozen baby peas, thawed and uncooked 
1/2 cup bacon, cooked and crumbled
1 8oz can water chestnuts, drained and chopped
1/4 cup onion, chopped
1 cup cream of celery soup
1 cup herb stuffing
2 Tablespoons melted butter
1/4 cup sherry (optional)
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees
Spread peas over the bottom of a greased, 1 quart casserole dish. Combine bacon, water chestnuts, onion and soup. Spoon over peas. Sprinkle stuffing over mixture. Drizzle butter over stuffing. Pour sherry over top. Bake for 30 minutes.
Author: Grammie

Title: Pilaf
Ingredients:
Butter
Handful broken vermicelli-brown. 
Long grain rice.
Onion soup or chicken broth
Salt
Instructions:
Melt 1/8# butter, handful broken vermicelli-brown. 
Add 1 cup long grain rice.
Stir and brown.
Make onion soup, using 2 ½ c. water.
Pour soup into rice. Cook on top of stove 25 min.
In oven, 40 min. Better 2nd day
Or
Melt ¼# butter, add handful crushed vermicelli.
1 c. long grain rice, Brown slightly. 
Add 2 ½ c. chicken broth.
Salt to taste. Cook as above.
Author: Grammie

Title: Pineapple Casserole
Ingredients:
5 slices white bread
2 1/2 cups crushed pineapple
2 well beaten eggs
1 c. sugar
3 T. flour
Instructions:
Remove crusts and cube 5 slices white bread
Saute on med. heat in ¼ c butter till crisp
Put in jar and store in refrig. till needed. Can do a day ahead.
Mix a 2 ½ c. crushed pineapple, slightly drained with
2 well beaten eggs, 1 c. sugar, 3 T. flour
Put in flat casserole, (may be refrigerated at this point) 
Put bread cubes on top just before baking
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes. Serves 4
May be doubled. And bake for 40 minutes
Author: Grammie

Title: Rice Baked in Chicken Stock
Ingredients:
½ chopped onion
2 cloves of garlic
¼ cup butter + 2T
1 cup long grain rice
2 cups chicken broth or stock
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 degrees
Saute ½ chopped onion and 2 cloves of garlic, diced
In ¼ cup butter until translucent. Add and stir until well coated:
1 cup long grain rice
Add: 2 cups boiling chicken broth or stock.
Cover and bake 25 minutes
Gently mix with rice, 2T. melted butter
Serve at once.
Can add pine nuts. Golden raisins, dried cranberries etc.
Author: Grammie

Title: Sweet Onion Casserole
Ingredients:
1 ½ # Vidalia onions (about 3 large)
sliced and separated into rings
1 c. whipping cream
1 large egg
¾ t. salt
½ t. pepper
½ cup (2 ounces) shredded sharp cheddar cheese
½ t. paprika
Instructions:
Cook onion in dutch oven in boiling water to cover for 1 minute. Drain
Place in lightly greased 8 inch baking pan
Whisk together cream and next three ingred. Pour over onion.
Sprinkle with cheese and paprika
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes.
Author: Grammie

Title: Three Cheese Mashed Potatoes
Ingredients:
2 large potatoes, peeled and cubed
½ c, sour cream
3 oz pkg cream cheese
2 T. butter, softened
1/3 c, milk
¼ c. shredded Cheddar Cheese
¼ c. shredded Muenster cheese
1 t. salt
½ t. pepper
1 T. butter, cut up
Instructions:
Cook potato in boiling water to cover for 15 min till tender.
Beat potato, sour cream, cream cheese, and 2 T butter
at med speed until smooth. Stir in milk and next 4 ingred.
Spoon into lightly greased 1 quart baking dish; Dot with
1 T. butter. Cover and chill 8 hours, if desired; remove
from refrig and let stand 30 minutes.Bake at 400 for
15 to 20 minutes
Author: Grammie

Title: White Truffle Potatoes
Ingredients:
The ultimate Italian style potato with grilled steak.
3 large Yukon Gold potatoes
(or 2 large Russet Potatoes)
1/2 cup whole milk or cream
1/2 stick butter
2-3 tsp. White Truffle Oil (olio tartufo bianco)
Sea salt and fresh ground pepper to taste
Instructions:
Peel potatoes and boil whole until a fork can pierce the center and then
release easily, about 40 minutes. If you are unsure, better to over-cook a
little than undercook. While potatoes cook, heat milk or cream and butter
in microwave until steaming hot.
Remove potatoes and mash in a mixing bowl. Add cream and butter mixture and
whip with an electric mixer until smooth. Add truffle oil and season to
taste with salt and pepper, whipping until well blended.
Author: Sandy

Title: Vidalia Onion and Rice casserole
Ingredients:
6 large Vidalia onions
1/2 cup uncooked rice
1 cup grated swiss chesse
2/3 cup half & half
salt & pepper
Instructions:
6 large Vidalia onions cut into chunks Saute till limp, not brown in ¼ cup butter, covered. Stir often. 
½ cup uncooked rice in 1 cup boiling salted water- Boil 5 minutes
1 cup grated swiss cheese 2/3 cup half and half cream
Add cooked rice to onion mixture, then cheese and cream. Salt and Pepper if desired
Put in 2 quart greased casserole. Cover.
Bake 1 hour at 325 degrees
Author: Grammie

Ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour 
 1 teaspoon baking powder 
 1/4 teaspoon salt 
 1 cup sugar 
 1/2 cup LAND O LAKES® Butter, softened 
 3/4 teaspoon almond extract 
 2 eggs 
 1 cup dried apricots, chopped 
 3/4 cup chopped slivered almonds toasted
Instructions:
Heat oven to 350°. Stir together flour, baking powder and salt in small bowl. Set aside.
Combine sugar, butter and almond extract in large mixer bowl. Beat at medium speed, scraping bowl often, until well mixed (1 to 2 minutes). Continue beating, adding eggs 1 at a time, until creamy (1 minute). Stir in apricots and almonds by hand. Gently stir in flour mixture just until dough forms.
Divide dough in half. Shape each half of dough on lightly floured surface into 12x1 1/2-inch log. Place logs about 4 inches apart on lightly greased large cookie sheet. Flatten each log to 2-inch width. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until logs begin to crack and edges begin to brown. Let stand 10 minutes on cookie sheet.
Reduce oven to 300°. Carefully cut logs diagonally into 1/2-inch slices with serrated knife. Place slices on same cookie sheet, cut-side down. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, turning once, or until crisp and very light brown on both sides. Place on cooling racks. Cool completely.
Sprinkle cooled cookies with sifted powdered sugar. Store in loosely covered jar.
TIPS:
To toast almonds, spread evenly in shallow baking pan. Bake at 350° for 4 to 8 minutes, stirring once, or until lightly browned. Cool completely
Use the Mediterranean variety of dried apricots for best results. You'll find them in the baking section of large supermarkets.
To cut apricots easily, use kitchen shears.
To prevent breakage while slicing, lightly hold each side of log to support edges.
Yield: 3 dozen cookies
1 cookie = 100 calories
Author: Grammie

Author: Grammie

Title: Lois' Biscuits
Ingredients:
2 cups flour
3 teaspoons baking powder
1 teaspoon salt (go lightly)
6-8 tablespoons butter/oleo/shortening - whatever
1/4 cup sugar (more or less) (not necessary, but we think it adds taste)
3/4 to 1 cup cold milk - added to five chilled ingredients above just before baking
Instructions:
Put first four ingredients in a bowl. Cut in butter to small pieces (I usually throw it in in big lumps and use my hands to break it up which makes ingredients too warm so I make them early in day and put the bowl in the refrigerator until just before baking)

When ready to bake:
Heat oven to 450 degrees. Lightly grease a flat baking pan. Add 3/4 to 1 cup milk and mix very lightly. When it's almost mixed put it on a lightly floured surface and pat into shape for cutting. Do not pick up dough again. Just push it around to keep making it ready for the biscuit cutter. Place on lightly greased flat baking pan. Put a small dab of butter on top of each biscuit (trick from Ruth's mother) and pop into fully heated oven.

Bake 12-15 minutes or until brown. Remove immediately. Enjoy.

Hints: Any leftover biscuits are great split in half and toasted on a grille for breakfast with jelly/jam, etc.
More sugar if you use these for strawberry shortcake or for any dessert base. Doubles well. Have fun. They've become a staple in our home.

Secret is the less handling the better. Everything should be cold.
Author: Lois

Title: Blueberry Pan Muffins
Ingredients:
½ cup butter at room temperature (calls for unsalted, I used regular)
1 cup sugar
2 eggs
3/4 cup milk
2 cups flour
2 teas. baking powder
½ teas. salt
2 cups blueberries
sugar for (sprinkling)
Instructions:
Set oven to 375 degrees. Grease and flour (I used Baker's Joy) an 8 inch square pan.
Beat the butter, sugar, then eggs and milk with electric beater until combined.
Add dry ingredients and mix just until the dry ingredients are moistened. By hand, fold in blueberries. 

Put several scoops of flour into a large shallow bowl. Use a large soup spoon to lift a heaping portion of batter out of the batter bowl and transfer it to the flour. With your hands, coat the batter with the flour, then lift it out of the flour bowl and transfer it from one hand to the other to remove excess flour.

Place the muffin in the corner of the prepared pan. Continue making floured balls of batter, overlapping them in pan until you have 14. 

Sprinkle the balls with sugar and transfer to hot oven. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes, or until a skewer or toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean.

Remove the pan from the oven, set on a wire rack and let it cool for 10 minutes. Use the tines of a fork to separate the muffins. Turn the block of muffins out of the pan, then turn the muffins right side up and return them to the rack.

Separate them carefully.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cherry-ful muffins
Ingredients:
½ cup (1 stick) butter at room temperature
1 cup sugar
2 large eggs
1 teas. vanilla
2 teas. baking powder
¼ teas. salt
about 2 cups dried cherries
2 cups flour
1 cup milk
1 Tab. sugar mixed with ¼ teas. freshly grated nutmeg
4 Tab. orange juice
Instructions:
Place dried cherries in oven proof dish with orange juice. Cover with foil; place in pre-heated oven 350 degrees for 10 minutes. Grease 12 muffin cups including area between the cups. In medium bowl, beat butter until creamy, beat in sugar until pale and fluffy. Beat in eggs, one at a time, beat in vanilla, baking powder and salt. Mix ½ of milk into batter. Fold in ½ of flour, then rest of milk, then rest of flour. Fold in cherries after draining off any extra juice. Scoop batter into muffin cups, sprinkle with nutmeg and sugar mixture. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Let muffins cool 30 minutes in pan before removing (I did it for 10 minutes.)
Good served with honey butter.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cranberry Bread
Ingredients:
2 c. flour sifted
1 cup sugar
1 ½ t. baking powder
½ t. baking soda
½ t. salt
1/4 c. shortning (I used Crisco)
1 egg beaten
3/4 c. orange juice
 1 T. grated orange rind (use my grater)
2 c. chopped cranberries
¾ c. pecan pieces
Instructions:
Sift dry ingredients. Cut in crisco till coarse meal.
Stir egg, oj, and rind together.
Add to dry ingredients.
Stir well. Fold in cran & pecans
Pour into greased and floured 9 x 5 pan.
Bake at 350 for an hour or until toothpick comes out clean.
Author: Grammie

Title: French Bread
Ingredients:
1 Tab. salt.
1 Tab. sugar
2 Tab. shortening
1 cup boiling water
¾ cup cold water
1 package yeast
¼ cup warm water
5-51/2 cups flour
1 egg white, beaten
Instructions:
Mix sugar, salt, shortening and boiling water.
To this mixture, add cold water and package of yeast
Which has been dissolved in the warm water.
Mix well using dough beaters, add flour slowly.
Knead in bowl, put on surface and knead a little
More. Put in a greased bowl. Cover and let rise
About an hour. I put in cold oven with pan of hot
Water under it.
After rising, divide dough into 2 portions. Roll each 
To about 10 x 15. Roll up in jelly roll fashion starting
At long end. Pinch ends together and put on greased
French bread pan. Brush with beaten egg and make 6 
Diagonal slashes across the top of each loaf.
Let rise an hour. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes.
Brush again with egg white and reduce heat to 350 and bake 
Another 20 minutes. Let cool and cut through slashes.
Author: A Cooking Affaire II

Title: Pull Apart Rolls
Ingredients:
