1 package hot roll mix
1 extra egg yolk
½ c. sugar
1 ½ t. cinnamon
¼ c. chopped pecans
¼ c. melted butter
Instructions:
Grease tube pan. Make up hot roll mix as directed adding extra yolk. 
Let rise until doubled about an hour.
Divide dough into 24-28 pieces. In small bowl, mix cin., sugar and pecans.
Dip each piece in melted butter, then in sugar mixture.
Layer in pan. Sprinkle rest of sugar mix on top. Cover. Let rise until doubled: 45 - 60 minutes. Cover outside of pan with tinfoil. Bake about 1 hour at 350 degrees.
When done, invert on serving plate.
Author: Grammie

Title: Sour Cream Coffee Cake
Ingredients:
Beat: 2 sticks butter
Cream: 2 cups sugar
Add: 2 eggs, beaten
 1 cup sour cream
 1 Tab. vanilla
Fold 2 cups flour mixed with 
 In: 1 Tab. Baking Powder &
 ¼ t. salt
Topping
1-1/3 c. chopped pecan
½ c. sugar
2 t. cinnamon
Instructions:
Grease bundt pan. Place some of topping,
Half of batter, more topping,
Rest of batter, small sprinkle of topping. I dont use it all.
Usually divide it in two and freeze half for the next coffee cake.
Bake at 350 degrees for 60 minutes.
Author: Grammie

Title: Almond Brittle
Ingredients:
1 c. sugar
½ c. light corn syrup
¼ t. salt
1 10 oz pkg slivered almonds (2 ¼ c.)
¼ c. water
2 Tab. butter (1/4 stick)
1 t. baking soda
Instructions:
Lightly butter large cookie sheet. In heavy 2-qt. saucepan over medium heat, heat sugar, corn syrup, salt and ¼ c. water to boiling, stirring constantly until sugar completely dissolves. Stir in almonds. Set candy thermometer in place and continue cooking, stirring frequently, until temperature reaches 300 degrees or hard crack stage. (about 20 minutes). As mixture begins to darken, stir constantly.
Remove saucepan from heat; stir in butter and baking soda; immediately pour onto cookie sheet. With two forks, quickly pull almond mixture into rectangle about 12 in. x 14 in. Cool brittle completely on cookie sheet on wire rack. With hands, break brittle into small pieces. Store in tightly covered container. Makes 16 servings, about 195 calories per serving.
Author: Grammie

Title: St. Paul's Carmels
Ingredients:
1 pound butter
2 pounds brown sugar
1 bottle (2 cups) light Karo
2 cans Eagle Brand condensed milk
1 Tab. vanilla
Instructions:
Use a candy thermometer and a heavy cooking container. Bottom part of a pressure cooker is ideal. 
Over low heat, cook to 240 degrees, stirring constantly.
Butter WELL a jelly roll pan. Pour candy into pan. Let stand for a day in the refrigerator until firmly set. Turn out onto a cutting board (marble if possible) and cut into bite size pieces (1inch). Wrap individually in 3-1/2 x 4 inch wax paper and store in refrigerator.
Iron bottom of pan to remove candy easily.
Score candy before cutting to know where cuts should be.
Author: Grammie

Title: Mamie's Favorite Fudge
Ingredients:
1 tall can (1-2/3 c.) evaporated milk
2 Tab. butter
4 ½ c. sugar
dash salt
2 c. semi-sweet choc. bits
3 bars (4 oz. each) sweet cooking chocolate
1 pint marshmallow cream
2 c. chop pecans
Instructions:
Combine milk, butter, sugar and salt. Bring to a vigorous boil,
Stirring often; then reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. Place 
Remaining ingred. (except pecans) in a large bowl. Gradually
Pour boiling syrup over the choc-marsh. mixture and beat
Until choc. is melted. Stir in nuts. Pour into buttered pan 
And store in a cool place.
Author: Grammie

Title: ANGEL NO FAT COOKIES
Ingredients:
1 package angel cake mix
½ cup water
1 cup dried cranberries
Instructions:
Use parchment paper- Drop by teaspoon
On one pan - cover rest of batter
Bake 8-10 minutes at 350-375 degrees
Author: Grammie

Title: Buckeyes
Ingredients:
2 sticks butter (not margerine)
1 # confectioners sugar
1 cup peanut butter
1 cup graham crackers (crushed)
1 cup ground nuts (I use pecans)
Instructions:
Mix all ingredients and chill.
Melt 1 1/2 cups chocolate chips and 1/4 bar paraffin wax.
Shape chilled mix into balls. Refrigerate. Dip with toothpick into 
chocolate. Leave a little section uncovered to 
resemble buckeyes. Close toothpick hole with
finger. I put finished cookies on waxed paper and
chill before putting into a cookie box separating
layers with wax paper.
Will keep in refrig. for months!
Author: Grammie

Title: Chocolate Cappuccino Cookies
Ingredients:
2 cups butter, softened
4 cups firmly packed light brown sugar
4 large eggs
5 ½ cups flour
1 cup cocoa
1 teas salt
1 teas. baking powder
1 teas. baking soda
¼ c. instant coffee granules
1 10 oz. package Hersheys Cinnamon Chips
Instructions:
Beat butter at medium speed (in your largest bowl) until creamy.
Gradually add brown sugar beating well.
Add eggs, beating until blended.
Combine flour and next 5 ingredients. Gradually add to butter mixture,
beating at low speed just until blended.
Stir in cinnamon chips.
Drop dough by teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on lightly greased baking sheet.
Bake at 350 degrees in batches for 8 to 10 minutes and cool on wire racks.
Makes 8 dozen.
Author: Grammie

Title: Chocolate Caramel Goodies
Ingredients:
Melt in microwave:
50 caramels (1# bag)
1/3 cup evaporated milk
Mix together:
1 German Chocolate cake mix
¾ cup butter melted
1/3 cup evaporated milk
1 cup chocolate chips
1 cup chopped pecans
Instructions:
Grease and flour (Bakers Joy) 9 x 13 pan.
Spread half of mix into pan.
Bake 6 minutes at 350 degrees.
Sprinkle chips and nuts on top.
Spread with caramel.
Top with remaining mixture
Bake 20-25 minutes at 350 degrees
Cool before cutting.
Author: Judy

Title: Chocolate Grahams
Ingredients:
1 c. semi sweet choc bits
1 can condensed milk
1 teas. vanilla 
2 cups crushed graham crackers
Instructions:
preparation--crush graham crackers
Line sheets with parchment paper or special pad. 
Turn on oven to 350°
melt 1 c. semi sweet choc bits
add 1 can condensed milk
add 1 teas. vanilla 
add 2 cups crushed graham crackers
Drop using cookie dropper or 1 teas. onto pan
Bake exactly 10 minutes
Author: Grammie

Title: Chocolate-covered Cherry Cookies
Ingredients:
1 (10 oz.) jar maraschino cherries
½ c. butter, softened
1 cup sugar
1 large egg
1 ½ teas. vanilla 
1 ½ cups flour
½ cup cocoa
¼ teas. baking powder
¼ teas. baking soda
¼ teas. salt
1 cup (6 oz.) semi-sweet choc. Chips
½ cup sweetened condensed milk
Instructions:
DRAIN cherries, reserving 3 teaspoons juice.
Cut cherries in half, and set aside.
BEAT butter and sugar at medium speed
With mixer until creamy; add egg, vanilla,
Add 2 teas. reserved cherry juice, beating
Until blended. Combine flour and next 4 ingredients
Gradually add flour to butter mixture, beating
Until blended after each addition. Shape dough
Into 1 inch balls using cookie scoop, and place
On ungreased baking sheets. Press center of each ball 
With thumb, and place one cherry (rounded side up)
In each indentation.
COOK chocolate and milk in a small saucepan
Over low heat, stirring until melted. Stir in
Remaining 1 teas. cherry juice. Cool slightly. 
Spoon 1 teas. mixture over each cherry half,
BAKE at 350 degrees for 10 minutes.
Freeze up to 3 months. YIELD: 6 dozen
Author: Grammie

Title: Cranberry Bars
Ingredients:
1 c. flour + 2 T.
1 1/4 c. sugar + 2 T.
1 cup finely chopped pecans
2 eggs
2 Tab. milk
1 Tab. finely grated orange peel
1 t. vanilla
1 cup chopped cranberries
½ cup coconut.
Instructions:
1 c. flour
2 Tab. sugar
1 cup finely chopped pecans (separated)
Using half of pecans, mix with rest of ingredients.
Press into ungreased 9 x 13 pan
Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes
Mix 1 ¼ c sugar, 2 Tab. flour, 2 eggs, beaten,
2 Tab. milk, 1 Tab. finely grated orange peel,
1 t. vanilla
Fold in 1 cup chopped cranberries, ½ cup coconut.
And rest of pecans.
Put on top of crust and bake 25 minutes until golden.
Cut while slightly warm.
Can be done a day ahead.
Author: Grammie

Title: Honey-Ginger Snaps
Ingredients:
1/2 c. honey
1 stick butter
1/2 c. sugar
1 egg
2 c. flour
2 t. soda
1/2 t. salt
1 t. ginger
1 t. cinnamon
1/2 t. cloves
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Cream 1/2 c. honey, 1 stick butter, 1/2 c. sugar. 1 egg. Sift tog. and add 2 c. flour, 2 t. soda, 1/2 t. salt, 1 t. ginger, 1 t. cinnamon, 1/2 t. cloves. Chill 1 hour. Roll 1 T. of dough into balls and place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. Bake for 10-12 minutes. Makes about 4 doz.
Author: Dianne Mott Davidson

Title: Dungeon Bars
Ingredients:
2 sticks unsalted butter
1/2 c. each of brown and white sugars
2 eggs
2 t. vanilla
1 c. flour
1/2 t. salt
1/4 t. soda
1 c. each of oats and raisins
Instructions: Cream 2 sticks unsalted butter with 1/2 c. each of brown and white sugars. Beat in 2 eggs and 2 t. vanilla. Add 1 c. flour, 1/2 t. salt, and 1/4 t. soda. Stir in 1 c. each of oats and raisins. Spread in greased 9x13 inch pan Bake 1/2 hour at 350° Cool slightly and cut into 32 bars.
Author: Dianne Mott Davidson

Title: Red and Whites
Ingredients:
2 sticks unsalted butter
1-3 oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened
1/2 c. sugar
1 t. vanila
2 c. flour
36 small ripe strawberries
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Beat the butter with the cream cheese until well blended. Beat in the sugar and vanilla, then stir in the flour until well mixed. Using a 1/2 T. measure, shape into small balls and place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Make a small indentation in top of each cookie with your thumb. Carefully place a strawberry half, cut side down, in each indentation. Bake for 12 to 18 min. or until very lightly browned. Cool on racks. Makes 5 dozen.
Author: Dianne Mott Davidson

Title: Ginger Cookies
Ingredients:
12 T butter (1-1/2 sticks)
1 c. sugar
1/4 c. molasses
1 egg
Sift dry ingredients together:
1 3/4 c. unbleached flour
1/2 t. cloves, ginger, salt, baking powder
1 t. cinnamon
Instructions:
Melt butter, add sugar & molasses, beat thoroughly. 
Add egg, blend well. Add dry ingredients.
Drop by teaspoon on parchment. Bake.
Author: Grammie

Title: Ginger Snaps
Ingredients:
2 cups all purpose flour
1 T. ground ginger
1 t. baking soda
1 t. ground cinnamon
¼ t. salt
2/3 c. sugar
½ c. molasses
1/3 cup Crisco or melted butter (or a mixture)
1 large egg
Water for moistening hands
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease 2 baking sheets.
Stir together flour, ginger, soda, cinnamon and salt in a small bowl.
Beat together sugar, molasses, shortening and egg in a large bowl.
Stir in dry ingredients until well blended.
On a sheet of wax paper, divide dough into 48 mounds.
With well-moistened hands, roll dough mounds into balls and place
2 inches apart on baking sheet.
Bake 10-12 minutes or until firm and crinkled.
Remove from oven and place on wire racks to cool.
Repeat with remaining dough. 
After cooled, pack in an airtight container.
Makes 48 cookies
Author: Grammie

Title: Jumbo Ginger Snaps
Ingredients:
sugar
2-1/4 c. flour
3/4 c. salad oil
1/4 c. molasses
1/4 c. maple syrup
2 t. baking soda
1 t. ginger
1/2 t. cinnamon
1/2 t. cardamon
1/4 t. salt
1 large egg
Instructions:
Into large bowl measure 1/2 c. sugar and remaining ingredients. With mixer at low speed, beat ingredients until well blended. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Place 2 T. sugar on piece of waxed paper.
Using 1/4 c. measure, measure dough, make into ball and roll into sugar. Place 3 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. (Dough is very soft and will flatten slightly.) Repeat using all of dough. Makes about 12 cookies. Bake 15 minutes. With pancake turner, remove cookies to wire racks to cool. Store cookies in tightly covered container.
Author: Grammie

Title: Mocha Crackle Cookies
Ingredients:
½ cup butter - no substitutes
5 squares (1 oz. each) unsweetened chocolate
1 Tab. instant coffee granules
4 eggs
1/8 t. salt
1 cup sugar
1 cup packed brown sugar
2 cups plus 3 Tab. flour
2 t. baking powder
1/3 c. conf. Sugar
Instructions:
Heat butter, chocolate and coffee until choc. is melted
Cool slightly. In a mixing bowl, combine eggs and salt.
Add sugar and brown sugar. Stir in choc. mixture. Mix well
Combine flour and BP. Gradually add to mixture to form a soft dough.
Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours till easy to handle.
Roll into ¾ inch balls. Roll in conf. Sugar; place on greased baking sheets.
Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes or until set. Remove to wire rack
Yield about 5 dozen.
Author: Grammie

Title: Peppacocker Cookies
Ingredients:
Sift 3-1/3 c. flour
1 t. soda
2 t. ginger
2 t. cloves
½ t. salt
2 t. cinnamon
Instructions:
Cream 1 c. butter. 1 cup sugar; Add ½ cup molasses.
Beat well;
Blend in dry ingredients by hands. Gradually add
1 cup blanched almonds with hands.
Divide and roll in wax paper (5 rolls).
Chill thoroughly.
Cut 1/8 inches thick. Bake 350 degrees 8-10 minutes.
Makes 8-10 dozen
Author: Grammie

Title: Snickerdoodle Pinwheels
Ingredients:
1/3 cup sugar
1 Tab. cinnamon
½ cup butter, softened
1-3 oz. pkg. cream cheese
1 cup sugar
½ t. baking powder
1 egg
1 t. vanilla
2 2/3 cups flour
1 Tab. melted butter
Instructions:
Combine sugar and cinnamon and set aside.
Beat butter and cream cheese. Add sugar
and baking powder. Beat until combined.
Beat in egg and vanilla.
Beat in as much flour as you can with the mixer.
Stir in any remaining flour.
Divide dough in half. Roll one half between
pieces of wax paper into a 12 x 8 rectangle.
Remove top sheet of wax paper. Brush dough
with half of melted butter. Sprinkle with 2 Tab.
of cin/sugar mixture.
Roll up, starting from one of the short sides, removing
wax paper as you roll. Seal edges. 
Roll other half of dough and repeat as above.
Roll each log in remaining sugar/cin. 
Wrap each log in plastic wrap or wax paper.
Chill in refrigerator about 4 hours until firm.
Using a sharp knife, cut dough into ½ inch slices.
Place one inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake in 375 degree oven for 8 to 10 minutes or
until edges are firm, cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute
Then transfer to rack to cool. Nakes about 60 cookies.
I would add a little more cin/sugar for flavor
Author: Grammie

Title: Soft Molasses Cookies
Ingredients:
½ cup butter 
½ cup Crisco 
1 ½ cups sugar 
½ cup molasses 
2 eggs 
4 cups flour
½ teas. salt
2 ¼ teas. soda and ginger
1 ½ teas. cloves and cinnamon
Additional sugar
Instructions:
Cream butter and Crisco and sugar until light colored
And fluffy. Beat in molasses and eggs.
Combine dry ingredients and blend with whisk.
Gradually add flour to creamed ingredients.
Mix until dough is blended.
Roll dough into 1 1/2 in. balls, dip in sugar.
Place on cookie sheet 2 ½ in. apart.
Bake at 350 degrees for 9-11 minutes.
Cool and place in tightly covered container to maintain
Softness. Slice of grapefruit or orange peel placed on
A piece of wax paper in container will help keep softness.
3 doz. Or 6 doz. If scooped with scoop.
Author: Grammie

Title: Special K Bars
Ingredients:
1 c. brown sugar
1 c. Karo white syrup
1-1/2 c. peanut butter
1 t. vanilla.
6 c. Special K cereal.(a 7 oz. box)
Melt 12 oz. pkg. each of choc chips and
butterscotch chips
Instructions:
1 c. brown sugar and 1 c. Karo white syrup, med. heat.
Bring to boil, but don't overcook.
Remove from heat and add 1-1/2 c.
peanut butter and 1 t. vanilla.
Mix well and add 6 c. Special K cereal.(a 7 oz. box)
Pat out on buttered cookie sheet and let cool.
Melt 12 oz. pkg. each of choc chips and
butterscotch chips together and spread on
top of the cooked mixture. Cut into small
bars when cooled.
I don't use all of chips, maybe 10 oz. of each.
Author: Grammie

Title: White Chocolate Macadamia Nut Cookies
Ingredients:
1/2 c. soft butter 
1/4 c. granulated sugar 
1/2 c. brown sugar 
1 egg 
1 Tab. water 
1 t. vanilla 

1-1/4 c. flour
1/2 t. salt
1/2 t. soda
6 oz. white chocolate
7 oz. jar macadamia nuts
coarsly chopped
Instructions:
Beat butter & sugars. Beat in egg. Add liquids.
Mix salt and soda with the 1/4 c. flour. Add.
Add rest of flour stirring by hand. Add choc.
and nuts. Drop by teaspoon. Bake at 350 degrees
10 - 15 min till lightly browned. Cool on wire rack.
Yields approx. 2-3 dozen cookies.
Author: Grammie

Title: Xmas cookies-roll out
Ingredients:
1/2 c. butter 
3/4 c. sugar 
1 egg 
1 Tab. milk
1 t. vanilla
1-1/2 t. baking powder
1/2 t. salt
Frosting
4 Tab butter 
2 c. conf. sugar
2-3 t. milk 
1/4 t. vanilla
Instructions:
Sift flour, B.P. and salt. Cream together butter and
sugar. Add egg and beat till smooth and fluffy. Stir in
vanilla. Add half of flour, milk, rest of flour mixture.
Chill & roll out 1/4 inches. Bake @ 350 degrees 8-10 min.
I usually double this to make a lot. Keep dough in refrig.
while rolling some out.
Author: Grammie

Title: Fresh Tomato Soup
Ingredients:
1/2 c. chopped onion
1/4 c. butter
1/4 c. flour
2 c. water
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatos
1 T. minced fresh parsley
1 1/2 t. salt
2 T. sugar
1/4 t dried thyme
1/4 t. pepper
Instructions: In large sauce pan or pot, cook onion in margarine. Stir in flour to form a smooth paste. Gradually add water, stirring constantly until thickened. Add tomoatos, parsley, salt, sugar, thyme, & pepper. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat; cover and simmer for 20-30 minutes or until tomatos are tender.
Author: Stephanie Lowry

Title: Popovers
Ingredients:
2 eggs
1 c. milk
1/4 t. salt
1 c flour
Instructions:
Combine ingredients. Pour into popover pan.
Bake at 450 for 15 minutes then at 350 for 20 minutes.
Author: Grammie

Title: Grandma L's Chicken Rice Casserole
Ingredients:
1 box chicken flavored Rice-A-Roni
1 can cream of chicken soup
1/2 can chicken broth
1 c. sour cream
3 c. cooked chicken (cut-up)
Instructions: Prepare rice-a-roni according to directions. Remove from heat and add rest of ingredients. Place in greased casserole dish and top with cheese, bread crumbs, and paprika. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 20 minutes.
Author: Stephanie Lowry

Title: Chicken with Crescent Rolls
Ingredients:
4 pieces chicken
1 large and 1 small can of crescent rolls (total of 12 rolls)
4 oz. grated mild cheddar cheese
1/2 cup milk
1 can cream of chicken soup
Dash of salt & pepper
Instructions: Boil chicken in water with a dash of salt and pepper for 1/2 hour. Cool and remove from bone (or dice). Flatten each roll with hand. Put chicken and small amount of cheese in each roll. Fold all corners into the center of the roll. Place in pan folded side down. Mix soup and milk, then pour over rolls. Bake in glass dish at 350 degress for 35 minutes.
Author: Mark Scheufler

Title: Hellmann's Parmesan Crusted Chicken
Ingredients:
1/2 c. Hellmann's Mayo
1/4 c. grated parmesan cheese
4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
4 t. Italian seasoned dry bread crumbs
Instructions:
Combine mayo and cheese. Spread on chicken, then sprinkle with bread crumbs.
Bake at 425 for 20 minutes.
Author: Hellmanns.com

Title: Steak Marinade
Ingredients:
1/4 c. olice oil
1 T lemon juice
1/2 t rosemary
1/2 t thyme
Instructions:
Combine above with meat and let sit over night.
For approximately 4 servings of meat. Best for use with grilling.
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Milleniyum Chocolate Torte
Ingredients:
1 cup whipping cream 
1 (12-oz.) pkg. (2 cups) semisweet chocolate chips 
1 tablespoon instant coffee granules or crystals 
1/4 cup butter 
3 tablespoons water 
1 (15.5-oz.) pkg. Pillsbury® Fudge Supreme Chocolate Chunk Premium Brownie Mix 
2 eggs 
1 (8-oz.) pkg. cream cheese, softened
Instructions:
1. Heat oven to 350°F. Grease 10 or 9-inch springform pan. Heat whipping cream in medium saucepan over medium heat until very hot. DO NOT BOIL. Stir in chocolate chips until melted and smooth. Set aside. (Mixture will thicken.) 
2. In small saucepan, combine coffee granules, butter and water; heat over medium heat until butter is melted, stirring occasionally. In large bowl, combine coffee mixture, brownie mix and 1 of the eggs; mix well. Spread batter in greased pan. 
3. Beat cream cheese in small bowl until light and fluffy. Add remaining egg; beat until smooth. Add 1/2 cup of the chocolate mixture; blend well. Spread evenly over brownie mixture in pan. 
4. Bake at 350°F. until top springs back when touched lightly in center and surface appears dry. For 10-inch pan, bake 35 to 45 minutes; for 9-inch pan, bake 45 to 55 minutes. Cool 10 minutes. Run knife around sides of pan to loosen; remove sides of pan. Cool 1 1/4 hours or until completely cooled. 
5. Place torte on serving platter. Spread remaining chocolate mixture over top of torte, letting mixture run down sides. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until chilled. If desired, serve with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream. Store in refrigerator. 
High Altitude Instructions: 
Add 3 tablespoons flour to dry brownie mix. Bake as directed above. 
This is Scott's favorite dessert both to make and to eat!!
Author: Pillsbury

Title: Cream Cheese Icing
Ingredients:
1/2 c butter
1 pkg cream cheese (8 oz.)
1 box powdered sugar
2 t vanilla
Instructions: Combine. Best if spread over cinnamon rolls.
Author: Sandy

Title: Brown Betty
Ingredients:
2 c. crumbs from 3-day old bread
3 tsp melted butter
3 or 4 medium apples
1 tsp. lemon juice
1/2 tsp grated lemon peel
1/2 c. packed brown or white sugar
1/3 c. hot water
Instructions: Combine bread crumbs and butter in skillet; cook over low heat until lightly browned, stirring constantly. Place 1/3 of the crumbs in greased baking dish. Pare, core, and slice apples; arrange half the apples in layer over crumbs. Sprinkle with half the lemon juice, lemon peel and brown sugar. Add half the remaining crumbs; cover with remaning apples, lemon juice, lemon peel, and sugar. Top with remaining crumbs. Pour water over crumbs. Bake in preheated 375-degree oven for 30-40 minutes or until apples are tender. May serve warm with second cream of lemon sauce.
Author: Sandy's Patient

Title: Chicken and Cashews
Ingredients:
Marinade:
1 egg white
2 t. cornstarch
1/4 t. salt
1/4 t. seasame oil
4 boneless chicken breasts
Cooking Sauce:
1/2 c. water
1 T soy sauce
2 t cornstarch
1 t sugar
1/2 t chicken bouillon
3 to 4 T peanut or vegetable oil, divided
1 clove garlic, minced
8-10 green onions, cut into 1 inch pieces
1 c sliced fresh mushrooms
1 c. salted cashews
Instructions:
For marinade: In small bowl blend all ingredients until smooth. Sitr in chicken strips. Refridgerate 30 minutes.
For cooking sauce: In small bowl combine all ingredients. Set aside.
In wok on Hi, heat 2 T oil, about 1 minute or until hot. Add chicken mixture. Stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink. Remove chicken to platter.
In wok heat 1 to 2 T oil about 1 minute or unitl hot. Add garlic, green onions and mushrooms. Stir-fry one minute. Add chicken and cooking sauce. Stir fry until sauce thickens. Remove wok from heat. Stir in cashews.
Author: Unknown

Title: Mini-Doughnut Stacks
Ingredients:
16 miniature powdered sugar doughnuts
2 T butter, softened
1 pint chocolate-cherry ice cream
Toppings: hot fudge, whipped cream
maraschino cherries
Instructions:
Cut doughnuts in half horizontally; spread cut sides evenly with butter. Place, buttered sides up, on a lightly greased baking sheet.
Broil doughnut halves 3 inches from heat 3-4 minutes or until golden brown.
Place 1 to 4 doughnut halves on each serving plate. Top with a small scoop of ice cream. Serve with desired toppings.
Author: Southern Living

Title: Waffle Taco Sundaes
Ingredients:
8 frozen waffles
1 quart chocolate ice cream
1/2 c. mini marshmallows
Desired toppings
Instructions:
Microwave 8 frozen waffles, in two batchs, in a single layer at high 1-2 minutes or until just warm. Centle fold each waffle in half to form a taco; place in a n 11x7inch baking dish, pressing waffles together to hold shape.
Stir together 1 quart chocolate ice cream, softened, and 1/2 cup mini marshmallows. Fresse 30 minutes.
Spoon ice cream evenly into waffles; cover and freese 1 hour or until firm. 
Drizzle with deisre toppings: fudge sauce, candy pieces, whipped cream, etc.
Author: Southern Living

Title: Easy Chocolate-Mint Ice Cream Sandwiches
Ingredients:
2 pints vanilla ice cream, softened
15 mint-and-cream-filled chocolate sandwich cookies, chopped
1 package large chewy chocolate cookies
Instructions: Stir together softened ice cream and sandwich cookie pieces. Freese 30 minutes. Spread ice cream evenly on 1 side of 5 large chewy cookies. Top with remaining cookies. Place in plastic or wax paper sandwhich bags, and freeze at least 1 hour.
Author: Southern Living

Title: Tea Quiche
Ingredients:
1 1/2 cups cottage cheese
5 eggs
2 T butter
1 small onion, diced
6-8 oz. diced ham
5 oz. diced swiss cheese
9 inch deep dish pie shell, unbaked
1/2 t salt
1/8 t pepper
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 degrees.
Place cottage cheese in food processor or blender and process until smooth, about 3-5 minutes.
Begin adding eggs, one at a time and continue processing. Add salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, in a skillet, saute onion in butter until trasnparent but not browned. Spread onion carefully on bottom of pie crust and layer ham and cheese over onion in shell. Immediately pour egg mixture over onion and cheese.
Bake in preheated oven for 35 to 45 minutes or until firm.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Delicious Brownies
Ingredients:
3/4 cup butter, melted
1 1/2 c. sugar
1 1/2 t vanilla extract
3 eggs
3/4 c flour
1/2 c cocoa
1/2 t baking powder
1/2 t salt
1 c semi-sweet chocolate chips (6 oz)
1/2 c walnuts, coarsely chopped
Instructions:
heat oven to 350. Grease 8-9 inch round or square pan. In medium mixing bowl blend melted butter, sugar, and vanilla. Add eggs; beat well with spoon. Combine flour, cocoa, baking powder, and salt. Gradually add to egg mixture, beating until well blended. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Spread into prepared pan. bake 40 to 45 minuts or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan. Cool completely. Makes 16 brownies.
To double, use 9x13 pan and bake full 45 minutes.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Aunt Eleanor's Bar Cookies
Ingredients:
1 1/2 cups white sugar
1 cup butter
2 eggs
1 1/4 t vanilla
1/4 t almond extract
3 cups flour
1 t baking soda
1/4 t. salt
1 c. chocolate chips
5/6 c. water
Glazed Icing:
2 T. melted butter
1 t. vanilla
1/4 t. almond extract
1 1/2 cups powdered sugar
Instructions:
Cream together: 1 1/2 cups white sugar, 1 cup butter, 2 eggs, 1 1/4 t vanilla, and 1/4 t almond extract.
Stir together: 3 cups flour, 1 t baking soda, 1/4 t. salt.
Mix together wet and dry ingredients. Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips. Add 5/6 cups water.
Spread batter onto a greased and floured 9x13 metal baking pan.
Bake for 20-25 mintues or until lightly brown at 350 degrees.
Ice while warm.
RAISON BAR VARIATION:
In small sauce pan, covered with lid, bring 1 cup golden raisins and 1 cup water to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes. Drain and save the liquid. Replace choc. chips with drained raisons above. Use all of raisin liquid plus necessary water to make 5/6 cups in place of water.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Microwave Boston Brown Bread
Ingredients:
1 c. whole wheat flour
1/2 c. cornmeal
1 c. 100% bran cereal (do not crush)
1 T baking soda
1/2 t. salt
1/3 c. molasses or brown sugar
1 c. buttermilk (Substitution: 1 T lemon juice or vinegar + milk to = 1 cup)
Instructions:
Combine dry ingredients in bowl, then add liquid ingredients. Stir just until combined. Pour into greased 1 quart/liter glass cup or 9x5 glass bread pan. 
Cover tightly with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 5 minutes. Let cool 5 minutes. Microwave for another 2 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. 
Alternative: Bake in over for 30 minutes at 350 degrees.
Raisin or nutty brown bread: substitute one half cup of the cereal with raisins or nuts.
Author: Stephanie Lowry

Title: Banana Nut Bread
Ingredients:
1 stick butter (1/2 cup)
1 1/2 cups sugar
2 eggs 
1 teaspoon vanilla 
2 ½ cups sifted flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
1 teaspoon baking soda
½ teaspoon salt
¾ cup ripe mashed bananas (about 2+ bananas)
2 eggs 
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 cup buttermilk or use (½ cup whole milk plus ½ cup sour cream)
Chopped nuts (cut coursely)
Instructions:
Cream together using the electric mixer:
 1 stick butter (1/2 cup)
 1 1/2 cups sugar (or a little less)
Add and beat into the above mixture:
 2 eggs 
 1 teaspoon vanilla 
 Set aside.
Stir together with a spoon and set aside.
 2 ½ cups sifted flour
 1 teaspoon baking powder
 1 teaspoon baking soda
 ½ teaspoon salt
Measure and set aside:
 ¾ cup mashed bananas
 (about 2+ bananas)
 Note: bananas must be very ripe)
Stir into the bananas:
 1 cup buttermilk or use
 (½ cup whole milk plus ½ cup sour cream)
 Chopped nuts
METHOD: In a large mixing bowl:
Alternate the flour mixture and the banana-buttermilk 
mixture into the creamed mixture (eggs, sugar) above. 
Start and end with flour. Mix until no dry flour can be seen.
** Stir in the nuts.
Line two 9 inch cake pans with wax paper & pour in batter. 
Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes+ or until done.
Frost or sprinkle with powdered sugar.
NOTE: This same recipe can be used to make: 
 28 cupcakes OR
 1 sheet cake in a jelly roll pan OR
 2 loaf cakes for banana bread (use more nuts)
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Blueberry Jello Salad
Ingredients:
1 large (6 oz.) package blueberry gelatin or 2 small (3oz.) pkgs. (NOTE: you can substitute other kinds of gelatin: example, blackberry, strawberry, etc.)
1 (21 oz.) sized can of Blueberry Pie Filling
NOTE: you can substitute other kinds of pie (filling: example, blackberry, strawberry, etc.)
One (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple WITH juice (NOTE: you can also add more fruit mandarin oranges, strawberries, peaches, etc., but, these must be drained)
1 teaspoon vanilla
TOPPING
I large (8 oz.) package cream cheese (softened)
1 cup sour cream
½ cup sugar
chopped nuts (optional)
Instructions:
Dissolve gelatin in 2 cups boiling water; stir until thoroughly mixed.
Add the following to the hot gelatin mixture above and stir:
1 (21 oz.) sized can of Pie Filling
1 (20 oz.) can crushed pineapple WITH juice and any additional drained fruit you desire.
1 teaspoon vanilla
Pour into a 9 X 13 glass dish. Chill in the refrigerator until firm.
TOPPING
I large (8 oz.) package cream cheese (softened)
Hint: you can unwrap the cream cheese and softened it in the microwave oven on low temperature, BUT, be careful, it will burn easily).
Beat the cream cheese using the electric mixer until it is smooth.
Add the following and mix until smooth:
 1 cup sour cream
 ½ cup sugar
Spread over the top of the set gelatin and chill again.
Garnish or sprinkle chopped nuts over the top. 
ENJOY!
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: STOVE-TOP one-dish CHICKEN BAKE
Ingredients:
1 package Stove-Top Stuffing mix (6 oz.) (chicken flavored)
1 2/3 cup water
4 boneless chicken breasts: 1 ¼ lbs. (or chicken tenders) 
1 can (10 ¾ oz) can of Cream of Chicken Soup, undiluted

1/3 cup sour cream or whole milk
Instructions:
Toss the contents of the vegetable seasoning packet,
stuffing mix and 1 2/3 cup water together. Set aside.
Place the raw chicken breasts in a greased 9 X 13 baking dish.
Mix chicken soup (undiluted) and sour cream together.
Pour over top of the chicken breasts in the baking dish.
Spoon stuffing mixture above evenly over the top.
Bake at 350 degrees about 35 minutes or until the chicken
is thoroughly baked. ENJOY!!
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Pork Chops with Golden Apple Sauce
Ingredients:
4 Golden Delicious apples, chopped
2 teaspoons lemon juice 
2 ounces golden raisins, a handful 
1-inch piece fresh ginger root
3 tablespoons light brown sugar
2 cups all natural apple juice or cider, plus a splash for pan sauce
1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 
1/4 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg
2 tablespoons vegetable oil or olive oil, 2 turns of the pan 
4 (1-inch) thick center cut boneless pork loin chops, 6 to 8 ounces each 
Salt and pepper
2 tablespoons butter
Instructions:
Combine first 8 ingredients in a medium pot placed over medium high heat and cook until a chunky sauce forms, 10 to 12 minutes, stirring occasionally. If sauce begins to spatter as it bubbles, reduce heat back a little, but it should be allowed to reduce and form quickly. Once apples are soft and sauce forms, remove it from the heat. 

Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. Add oil to the pan. Season chops on 1 side with salt and pepper. Using a pair of tongs, add chops to hot skillet seasoned side down. Season the opposite side of the chops with salt and pepper. Brown and caramelize the chops 2 minutes on each side, then reduce heat to medium and cook another 5 to 6 minutes, turning occasionally, until juices run clear. Remove chops from heat and let them rest a couple of minutes for juice to redistribute. Deglaze the pan with a splash of apple juice and 2 tablespoons of butter. Pour pan sauce over chops. Remove ginger from the sauce and top chops with generous portions of warm golden apple sauce.
Author: Rachael Ray

Title: Cindy Egeland's Fruited Salad
Ingredients:
4 cups cleaned, torn, mixed leaf and iceberg lettuce
1/2 cup sliced celery
8 scallions, sliced thin
2 cups fresh sliced strawberries and/or raspberries
Sugared almonds: See recipe below.
Instructions:
Dressing:
1/3 cup vegetable oil
1/4 cup red wine vinegar
2 T. sugar
1/2 tsp. salt
1/2 tsp. pepper

Thoroughtly mix dressing into salad greens just before serving.
Place the fruit and almonds on top before serving.

SUGARED ALMONDS
Toss 1 cup sliced almonds in a skillet with 3 T. sugar.
Cook over medium heat until the sugar coats the almonds completely and the almonds are lightly browned. Cool on a plate.

Notes:
Cindy and I have used a variety of fruits: apples, mandarin oranges, sliced grapes, mango etc. I have never used the scallions. I use romaine rather than iceberg, but it doesn't really matter.
Author: Cindy Egeland

Title: Baked Ziti
Ingredients:
1 box ziti pasta
1 onion chopped
2 garlic cloves minced
1 pound ground beef
1 1/2 - 2 jars spaghetti sauce
(spices for the sauce - I usually use basil, italian seasoning, and a tiny bit of ground red pepper)
6 oz sliced provolone cheese
1 cup sour cream
8 oz shredded mozzarella
2 T. grated Parmesan cheese
Instructions:
Cook ziti according to package directions. Meanwhile in large skillet brown ground beef, onion and garlic. Drain off fat. Add sauce and spices and simmer for 15 minutes.
Layer pan as follows: Small amount of sauce on bottom of pan. Then 1/2 of ziti, all of provolone cheese, all of sour cream, 1/2 of sauce, remaining ziti, mozzarella cheese, and remaining sauce. Top with parmesan cheese. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 20 minutes. Remove foil and bake 10-15 minutes more. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Author: Sara Love

Title: Chocolate Yummies
Ingredients:
3 cups Rice Krispies cereal
7 whole pieces honey graham crackers
2 ½ cups miniature marshmallows
1 pkg (12 oz.-2 cups) semi sweet chocolate morsels
2/3 cups ligh corn syrup
3 Tab. butter
½ cup crunchy peanut butter (I used creamy)
Instructions:
Coat 12x9x2 inch microwave-safe dish with cooking spray. Place 6 whole pieces graham crackers in single layer in bottom. Cut remaining piece to fit remainder of bottom.
Sprinkle marshmallows over crackers.
Microwave on high 1 minute or until marshmallows are puffy. Remove from over and cool completely.
In 2 quart microwave-safe mixing bowl, combine morsels, corn syrup and butter. Microwave on high about 1 ½ minutes or until chocolate can be stirred smooth. Stir in peanut butter. Add rice krispies cereal, mixing until evenly combined. Spread evenly over marshmallows.
Cover and refrigerate about 1 hour or until firm.
Cut and store in airtight container in refrigerator
Author: Grammie

Title: J's (Sugar Cookies)
Ingredients:
Cream together in mixer:
1 cup butter
2 cups white sugar
4 eggs
2 T. sour cream
1 tsp. vanilla

Sift:
4 cups flour
1 tsp. salt
1 tsp. soda
Instructions:
Add dry ingredients to above mixture. Mix with an electric mixer. Mix by hand if dough gets too thick. 
Divide dough into 2 parts. Wrap in foil dusted with flour.
 Chill in refrigerator at least 3 hours, or until ready to bake.

On floured board, roll out dough and cut out cookies. 
 Bake at 350 degrees for 8-10 minutes. 

Frosting:
Mix together:
1/2 stick butter, melted
2-3 T. milk
3 cups sifted xxx sugar
Add 1 tsp 
NOTE: Use an upside-down candy cane cookie cutter to make J's for Jesus. (J's just taste better)
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Scandinavian Almond Bars
Ingredients:
1 3/4 cups flour 
2 teas. baking powder
1/4 teas. salt
1/2 cup butter
1 cup sugar 
1 egg
1/2 teas. almond extract 
milk
1/2 cup sliced almonds, chopped
Almond Icing:
1 cup powdered sugar 
1/4 teas. almond extract
3 to 4 teas. milk to make icing of drizzling consistency
Instructions:
Stir together flour, baking powder and salt. In a large mixer bowl beat butter till softened. Add sugar and beat till fluffy. Add egg and almond extract and beat well. Add flour mixture and beat till well mixed.

Divide dough in half and place each half on a cookie sheet. Press or roll the dough into 
12 x 6 rectangles. ( the original recipe says to divide into fourths and make 4 rectangles 
12 x 3. I think it is easier and less time consuming to make 2 rectangles. After the cookies are baked, I cut the large rectangle in half so it turns out the same.)

Brush flattened dough with milk and sprinkle with almonds. Bake in a 325 oven for 12 minutes or till edges are lightly browned. While cookies are still warm cut them into 1 inch strips. Cool. Drizzle with Almond Icing.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Sinfully Delicious
Ingredients:
1/2 gallon vanilla ice cream
1 1/2 cups milk
1 small box Vanilla instant pudding
1 small box French Vanilla instant pudding
Instructions:
Cut ice cream into chunks and put in large mixing bowl. (I leave it out on the counter for at least 20 minutes. It will ruin your beaters (make them crooked) if the ice cream is not soft).
Add pudding and milk. Mix with electric mixer for 2 minutes until smooth.

Melt 3/4 cup butter. Crush 60-80 Ritz Crackers in food processor. Add butter. Layer bottom of 9 x13 glass dish with cracker mixture, saving 1/4 cup for the top. 
Pour in ice cream mixture. Sprinkle remaining cracker crumbs on top. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Almond Bars
Ingredients:
4 eggs 
1/4 tsp. salt
2 sticks melted margarine
2 tsp. almond extract
2 c. sugar
2 c. flour
Instructions:
Mix all ingredients together and put in lightly buttered 9x13 pan. 
Top with toasted sliced almonds and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake at 323 for 30 minutes.
Enjoy!
Author: Sandy Seifert

Title: Pumpkin Dip
Ingredients:
4 c. powdered sugar
2 pkg 8 0z. cream cheese softened
1 30 oz can pumpkin pie mix
2 t cinnamon
1 t ginger
Instructions: mix well, serve in small (pie) pumpkin with ginger snaps
Author: Sandy Seifert

Title: Carmel Apple Dip
Ingredients:
1/2 c Brown sugar
2 pkg 8 oz cream cheese
1 t vanilla
1 tub carmel
1 bag toffee chips
Granny Smith apples
Instructions:
Mix: 1/2 c Brown sugar
2 pkg 8 oz cream cheese
1 t vanilla
place in casserole or pie type pan
cover with 1 tub carmel
top with 1 bag toffee chips
Serve with Granny Smith apples
Author: Sandy Seifert

Title: Easy Quiche
Ingredients:
2 cups COOKED chicken
 ½ c. carrots
½ c. celery
½ c. onion
½ c. green pepper
½ c. broccoli florettes
1 ¼ cup grated Mozzarella Cheese
4 eggs, beaten
2 cups whole milk
1 cup Bisquick
¼ teaspoon salt
Instructions:
Grease a 10 inch GLASS pie plate (with high sides)
Cut up 2 cups COOKED chicken in ½ pieces. Set aside.
In the electric steamer, steam these vegetables in the following order:
NOTE: You will need approximately ½ cup or more of each cooked vegetable below.
1. steam the carrots (cut in 1/2 inch cubes) first, because they take the longest time to cook; drain and set aside. Note: Grated carrots can be used and par-cooked just a few minutes. 
2. steam the finely chopped celery; drain & set aside
3. steam the grated onion and chopped green pepper; drain & set aside.
4. steam the broccoli florettes; drain.

1 ¼ cup grated Mozzarella Cheese (save the ¼ cup for the top)
Mix all the vegetables, the cooked chicken cubes, and 1 cup of Mozzarella cheese above. Place in the bottom of a well-greased 10 pie plate.
TOPPING:
4 eggs, beaten
2 cups whole milk
1 cup Bisquick
¼ teaspoon salt 
Mix the beaten eggs, milk, Bisquick and salt together- do not overmix, batter should be a little lumpy.
** Pour over top of the vegetables, etc.
Sprinkle the top with ¼ cup grated cheese.
Bake in a pre-heated oven at 350 degrees for 40-45+ minutes. To test for doneness, check the bottom of the pie plate to see if the quiche looks baked. Check with a toothpick -- however, the quiche will be a little runny in the middle and will thicken after it is removed from the oven.
ENJOY!!
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Favorite Carrot Cake
Ingredients:
2 cups flour
2 cups white sugar
2 teaspoons cinnamon
½ teaspoon salt
2 teaspoons baking SODA
3 eggs
¾ cup oil
¾ cup buttermilk (I use the dry buttermilk and add enough water to make ¾ cup)
2 cups of finely shredded carrots ( use the food processor)
¾ cup DRAINED crushed pineapple
l cup coarsely ground walnut (use the food processor)
OPTIONAL: l/2 cup flaked coconut
FROSTING:
l (3 ounce) package softened cream cheese
2 tablespoons softened butter
l teaspoon vanilla
2 cups powdered sugar
Instructions:
Stir together the following dry ingredients in a bowl and set aside.
2 cups flour
2 cups white sugar
2 teaspoons cinnamon
½ teaspoon salt
2 teaspoons baking SODA
In a large mixing bowl, beat the following ingredients together.
3 eggs
¾ cup oil
¾ cup buttermilk (I use the dry buttermilk and add enough water to make ¾ cup)
Mix ALL the above ingredients together (dry and moist ingredients)
Stir in the following ingredients by hand.
2 cups of finely shredded carrots ( use the food processor)
¾ cup DRAINED crushed pineapple
l cup coarsely ground walnut (use the food processor)
OPTIONAL: l/2 cup flaked coconut
Oven 350 degrees. 
For a 9 X 13 inch cake, grease and flour the pan. Bake 40-45 minutes..
For a sheet cake, grease and flour a jelly roll pan. Bake 25-30 minutes.
***For a 2 layer cake, grease and flour the pans; line the bottom of each pan with waxed paper. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Pretty Gelatin Fluff
Ingredients:
1 large can mandarin orange slices
1 can pineapple tidbits
1 small (3 oz.) package flavored gelatin (DRY) 
1 (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 small container of Cottage Cheese (small curd)
1½ cups of miniature marshmallows
Optional: flaked coconut, chopped nuts
Instructions:
Drain the following ingredients several hours or over night:
 1 large can mandarin orange slices
 1 can pineapple tidbits
 **Be sure all the moisture is out of the fruit--- pat with a
 paper towel. This recipe does not use the juice from 
 the canned fruit)
______________________________________________________
1 small (3 oz.) package lemon gelatin (DRY) 
 ( substitute any other flavored gelatin if you want another color)
 (use the gelatin in DRY form)
1 (12 oz.) container Cool Whip
1 small container of Cottage Cheese (small curd)
** Method: Sprinkle DRY gelatin over the Cool Whip and mix thoroughly until the gelatin is completely dissolved (takes about 5 minutes of beating)
Using a rubber scraper, gently fold in the cottage cheese.
Stir in the drained mandarin oranges and pineapple tidbits into the mixture above.
Add 1½ cups of miniature marshmallows. Mix in gently.
Optional: flaked coconut, chopped nuts.
Chill. Serve in stemmed glass sherbets or in a glass dish.
ENJOY!!
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Lola's Lemon Dessert
Ingredients:
3 cups of crushed graham crackers or vanilla wafers
2/3 cup melted butter
2 (3 ounce) packages lemon gelatin or 1 (6 ounce) package
l ¾ cups boiling water
½ cup sugar 
¼ teaspoon salt
1 ½ teaspoons lemon rind, grated
3 lemons
2 large cans of evaporated milk
Instructions:
BOTTOM LAYER: 
Combine :
3 cups of crushed graham crackers or vanilla wafers
2/3 cup melted butter
Place in the bottom of the two (9x 9 pans), saving some for the topping
 ***********************************************************
GELATIN LAYER:
Dissolve :
 2 (3 ounce) packages lemon gelatin or 1 (6 ounce) package
 l ¾ cups boiling water
 Stir until dissolved.
Add: ½ cup sugar 
 ¼ teaspoon salt
 1 ½ teaspoons lemon rind, grated
 3 lemons: 
(NOTE: squeeze 3 lemons and add enough water to the lemon juice to make 2/3 cup)
CHILL the above until slightly thickened (egg white consistency)
ADD: 2 large cans of evaporated milk to the thickened gelatin above and BEAT with the electric mixer until fluffy. 
Pour gelatin mixture over the bottom crusts. Chill until firm. ENJOY!!
Author: Aunt Lola

Title: Pasta & Cheese Casserole
Ingredients:
l large (16 oz.) package of extra wide noodles
l stick of butter (1/2 cup)
½ cup flour
2 teaspoons salt
l 1/3 cups chopped celery 
Carrots 
5 cups milk
1 or 1 ½ cups grated Velveeta Cheese
4 cups COOKED, cubed meat or fish (ham, chicken, salmon, tuna or shrimp)
Instructions:
Pasta: l large (16 oz.) package of extra wide noodles , cooked according to package directions
SAUCE: l stick of butter (1/2 cup)
 ½ cup flour
 2 teaspoons salt
 l 1/3 cups chopped celery (cooked in the micro-wave with a little water, OR sauteed 
 in butter in a skillet)
 Carrots: (optional) cook the same as the celery above. NOTE: frozen, cooked peas can be used 
 5 cups milk
 1 or 1 ½ cups grated Velveeta Cheese
 4 cups COOKED, cubed meat or fish (ham, chicken, salmon, tuna or shrimp)

METHOD: Cook pasta according to package directions. Drain.
In a HEAVY saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the flour and salt. (be careful, this mixture burns very easily) Stir constantly until a paste forms.
Gradually add: milk, stirring until the mixture thickens (this take about 10 minutes).
Remove the above from the heat, and stir in the cooked chopped celery and carrots or peas; grated cheese; and cooked, chopped meat or fish. You can serve and eat this without it being baked.
Baking Instructions: (optional)
Grease a very LARGE casserole dish and bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes. 
Serve and eat. 
NOTE: This dish freezes well; can be frozen in small amounts in freezer bags.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Amy's Chocolate Cake
Ingredients:
1 pkg dark chocolate cake mix 
1/3 cup br. sugar 
4 eggs 
1 cup sour cream 
1/2 cup warm H2O 
1/2 cup vegetable oil 
6 oz melted choc. chips
1/2 cup chocolate chips 
2 T pow. sugar
Instructions:
1. Combine 1st 6 ingredients - beat 4 minutes. Fold in choc. chips 
2. Spoon into bundt pan 
3. Bake 45-50 minutes, until toothpick comes out clean 350 degrees
4. Cool in pan 10 mins, invert on wire rack 
5. Dust w/ pow. sugar 
6. enjoy!
Author: Amy

Title: Apple Crisp
Ingredients:
4-5 cups sliced apples
1 t. cinnamon
1 stick butter
½ cup water
½ cup sugar
¾ cup flour
vanilla ice cream or whipped cream
Instructions:
Place apples in buttered 1-1/2 qt. casserole.
Mix cinnamon and water and pour over apples.
Mix together sugar, flour and butter which has
been sliced thin and spread over top.
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 to 1-1/2 hours.
Serve warm or cold with cream or ice cream.
Author: Grammie

Title: Boston Cream Pie
Ingredients:
1/3 c. crisco 
1 c. sugar 
2 large eggs 
1-1/4 c. flour 
1-1/2 t. Bak.Pow. 
1/2 t. salt 
3/4 c. milk
1 t. vanilla 
Instant pudding
Glaze
3 T. water
2 T. butter
1 c. sifted conf sugar
3 T. cocoa
1/2 t. vanilla
Instructions:
Pour batter into greased and floured 9 inch round pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 min. Cool and split.
Pudding between layers
Glaze--Bring water and butter to a boil over med
heat. Remove from heat. Add conf. sugar, cocoa
and vanilla, stirring till smooth. Pour on top of cake
Author: Grammie

Title: Carrot Sheet Cake
Ingredients:
2 c. flour
2 t. baking soda
2 t. cinnamon
½ t. salt
3 large eggs
2 c. sugar
¾ c. canola oil
¾ c. buttermilk
2 t. vanilla
2 c. grated raw carrots
1-8oz. can crushed pineapple
1-3 1/2 oz can sweetened flaked coconut
1 c. chopped pecans or walnuts
Buttermilk glaze
Cream cheese frosting
Instructions:
Stir together first 4 ingredients in a small bowl.
Beat eggs and next 4 ingredients at medium speed with
an electric mixer until smooth. Add flour mixture beating
at low speed until blended. Fold in carrots and next 3 ingredients.
Pour batter into a greased and floured (bakers joy) 9 x 13 pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes, cover pan loosely with aluminum
Foil to prevent excessive browning, and bake 13 more minutes
Or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean. (I needed more time)
Drizzle buttermilk glaze evenly over cake. Cool completely in pan.
Spread Cream cheese frosting evenly over cake.
Buttermilk Glaze
1 cup sugar
1 ½ t. baking soda
½ cup butter
½ cup buttermilk
1 Tab. light corn syrup
1 t. vanilla
Bring sugar, soda, butter, buttermilk and corn syrup to a boil in a saucepan.
Boil stirring often until mixture is golden brown. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla.
Cream cheese frosting
½ c. butter 
1 8 oz, pkg. cream cheese 
1 3 oz. pkg. cream cheese
1 lb. conf sugar
1 ½ t. vanilla
Beat butter and cream cheese till creamy
Add conf. sugar and vanilla and beat till smooth
Author: Grammie

Title: Cheese Cake
Ingredients:
1 large and 1 small cream cheese- room temp.
¾ c. granulated sugar
3 eggs
1 T. lemon juice
1 t. vanilla
Instructions:
Cream cheese, sugar and eggs. Beat well.
Blend in flavorings. Cook 30-40 min. in
Graham cracker crust at 350 degrees.
8 in. =40 min, 9 in. = 30 min. Spring form pan.
While hot, mix ½ pint sour cream, 1/3 c. sugar,
1 t. vanilla - Pour on top. Cook again 5 minutes
Crust 
Use half of:
1 package graham cracker crumbs - 1 2/3 c.
¼ cup sugar
¼ cup soft butter
Save rest for next cheesecake!
Author: Grammie

Title: Chocolate Cherry Cake
Ingredients:
1 18.24 oz, chocolate cake mix
1 21 oz. can cherry pie filling
2 eggs
½ t. almond flavoring
5 Tab. butter
½ c. milk
1 cup sugar
6 oz. choc. chips
1 t. vanilla.
Instructions:
1 18.24 oz, chocolate cake mix
1 21 oz. can cherry pie filling
2 eggs
½ t. almond flavoring
Combine above ingredients, mix with spoon
Put in 13 x 9 pan. Bake 35-40 minutes.
Remove from oven and pour hot frosting over it
Frosting
Bring to a boil the following and boil 1 minute
5 Tab. butter
½ c. milk
1 cup sugar
Add 6 oz. choc. chips and 1 t. vanilla. Stir.
Author: Grammie

Title: Chocolate Raspberry Cobbler
Ingredients:
¾ cup (1.5 sticks) butter
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 teaspoons baking powder
½ teaspoon salt
1 ½ cups milk
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 ½ cups firmly packed light brown sugar
4 cups raspberries, fresh or frozen (no need to thaw)
1 cup semisweet chocolate chunks or chips
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Melt the butter in a 9x13 inch baking dish. In a large bowl, mix together the flour, baking powder, salt, milk, vanilla, and brown sugar. Pour half the batter directly into the hot, buttered pan. Add three cups of the raspberries and the chocolate chunks. Pour the remaining batter over the berries, then top with the last cup of berries. Place the pan in the oven and bake 35 to 40 minutes or until the center is set. Let cool at least 10 minutes before serving. Makes 12 servings.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cinnamon Raisin Bread Pudding
Ingredients:
4 cups milk
5 large eggs
10-12 slices white bread torn into pieces
3 cups Nilla wafer crumbs (about 65 wafers)
¾ cups sugar
½ teas. cinnamon
1 ¼ cups raisins
Instructions:
Whisk together milk and eggs in a large bowl.
Add remaining ingredients, stirring until blended.
Pour into buttered 11 x 7 inch baking dish
Place in a larger pan filled with
1 ½ inches water. Cover smaller pan with foil.
Bake at 350 degrees for an hour.
Remove foil and bake for 30 minutes more.
Serve with caramel sauce or vanilla ice cream
10 servings.
Author: Grammie

Title: Summer Fruit Punch Salad
Ingredients:
1 pkg. (4-serving size) JELL-O Brand Cherry Flavor Gelatin 
1 pkg. (4-serving size) JELL-O Brand Strawberry Flavor Gelatin 
1-1/2 cups boiling water 
Ice cubes 
1 cup orange juice 
1 pt. (2 cups) strawberries, sliced 
1 cup seedless grape halves 
1-1/2 cups thawed COOL WHIP Strawberry Whipped Topping
Instructions:
MIX dry gelatin mixes in large bowl. Stir in boiling water at least 2 min. until completely dissolved. Add enough ice to orange juice to measure 2-1/4 cups. Add to gelatin; stir until slightly thickened. Remove any unmelted ice. Stir in fruit. 
POUR into large serving bowl. 
REFRIGERATE 2 hours or until firm. Top with the whipped topping just before serving. Store leftovers in refrigerator.
Author: Jello

Title: Floating Fruit Parfaits
Ingredients:
1/2 cup sliced strawberries 
3/4 cup boiling water 
1 pkg. (4-serving size) JELL-O Brand Strawberry Flavor Sugar Free Low Calorie Gelatin 
1/2 cup cold water 
3/4 cup ice cubes 
1 cup plus 6 Tbsp. thawed COOL WHIP LITE Whipped Topping, divided
Instructions:
DIVIDE strawberries evenly among 6 dessert glasses. Stir boiling water into dry gelatin mix in medium bowl at least 2 min. until completely dissolved. Add cold water and ice cubes; stir until ice is completely melted. Remove 3/4 cup of the gelatin; pour evenly over strawberries. Refrigerate 20 min. or until gelatin is set but not firm. 
ADD 1 cup of the whipped topping to remaining gelatin; stir with wire whisk until well blended. Spoon evenly over gelatin in dessert glasses. 
REFRIGERATE 1 hour or until firm. Top each parfait with 1 Tbsp. of the remaining whipped topping just before serving. Store leftover parfaits in refrigerator.
Author: Jello

Title: Fettuccini Alfredo
Ingredients:
8 ounces dry fettuccine pasta 
4 1/2 tablespoons butter 
2 1/2 tablespoons all-purpose flour 
2 cups milk 
1 teaspoon minced garlic 
5 drops hot pepper sauce 
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 
Chicken (optional)
Instructions:
Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water. 
Meanwhile, melt butter or margarine in a saucepan. Stir in flour. Whisk in milk, garlic, and hot sauce; stir until thickened. Stir in cheese. 
Drain pasta. Serve sauce over noodles. 
Add cooked chicken if desired.
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Spicy Chicken Fingers
Ingredients:
1 cup instant mashed potato flakes 
2 Chicken Flavored Bouillon Cubes, crushed 
1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper 
1/4 cup butter or margarine, melted 
1 egg, beaten 
2 tablespoons water 
1 1/4 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breast tenders 
Honey mustard dipping sauce, if desired
Instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. In bowl, combine potato flakes, bouillon and cayenne pepper. Add melted butter to potato flakes. In pie plate, combine egg and water. Dip chicken tenders in egg mixture and coat in potato flakes. Place chicken on baking sheet. Bake for 18-22 minutes, turning halfway through baking, until chicken is cooked through. If desired, serve with honey mustard dipping sauce.
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Potato Dumpling Casserole
Ingredients:
2 cups mashed potatoes 
1 cup all-purpose flour 
2 eggs, beaten 
1 1/2 teaspoons salt 
1/8 teaspoon black pepper 
1 medium onion, chopped 
3 tablespoons butter 
2 tablespoons all-purpose flour 
1 cup light cream 
1 cup chicken broth 
1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese 
1/2 cup shredded Jarlsberg cheese (may substitute Swiss)
Instructions:
In a medium bowl, mix together the mashed potatoes, 1 cup flour, eggs, salt and pepper until well blended. Spoon into a clean plastic bag. 
Bring 5 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot. Adjust heat so that water boils very gently. Cut a small opening in the corner of the baggie, and squeeze out dumplings into the water, cutting with scissors at 1 inch intervals. Let the dumplings simmer uncovered until they float to the top. Remove with a slotted spoon, and place in a 2 quart baking dish. Keep warm. 
Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat. Saute onion in butter until tender. Blend in 2 tablespoons flour until smooth. Pour in cream and broth, and cook, stirring constantly until thickened. Remove from heat and stir in half of the Parmesan cheese and half of the Jarlsberg until smooth. Pour over the dumplings in the dish. Sprinkle remaining cheeses over the top. 
Bake uncovered for 45 minutes in the preheated oven, until the top is golden brown and sauce is bubbly. 
Annie tried it once and it was a little too strong. Try using less butter and cheese in the sauce.
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Poppy Seed Chicken
Ingredients:
4-5 chicken breasts, cooked and cut-up
1 can cream of chicken soup
8 oz. sour cream
1 tube ritz crakers
1 stick butter
1 T. poppy seeds
Instructions:
Combine cream of chicken soup & sour cream. 

Melt butter in medium bowl, add crushed ritz crackers & poppy seeds.
Pam a 9x13 pan, and layer chicken then sauce. Top with cracker mixture.
Bake uncoverd for 30 minutes at 350 degrees.
Author: Unknown

Title: Hamburg Noodle Casserole
Ingredients:
1 lb. hamburg
2 tbsp. butter
Salt & pepper
2 sm. cans tomato sauce
1 (8 oz.) pkg. noodles
6 scallions
1 c. (1/2 pt.) sour cream
1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
Sharp cheese, grated
Instructions: Take color out of hamburg in saute pan, add salt and pepper as desired and tomato sauce. Simmer 25 minutes. Add cut up onions to sour cream and butter and cream cheese. Mix until smooth. Cook noodles. Layer 1. noodles; 2. hamburg mix; 3. cream cheese mix. Repeat again. Top with grated cheese, use drip pan or 2 quart pan. Bake in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes.
Author: cooks.com

Title: Cinnamon Rolls
Ingredients:
1/2 c warm water 
2 pkg. dry yeast 
2 T sugar 
3 1/2 oz. pkg vanilla pudding mix 
1/2 c margarine, melted 
2 eggs 
1 t salt 
6 cups flour 
Filling 
1 cup butter, softened 
1 cup light brown sugar 
4 teaspoons cinnamon
Instructions:
Mix water, yeast, and sugar together until yeast and sugar are dissolved. Set aside. In a large bowl prepare pudding mix according to package directions. Add margarine, eggs and salt; mix to blend well. Add yeast mixture and blend well. Gradually add flour; transfer to a lightly floured surface and knead dough until smooth. Place in a greased bowl; cover and let rise until doubled. Punch down dough and let rise again.
Roll out on a floured surface. Take 1 cup soft butter and sprad over surgace. In a bowl mix 2 cups brown sugar and 4 teaspoons Cinnamon; sprinkle over the top. Roll up tightly. Put a notch every 2 inches. Cut with thread or a sharp knife. Place cinnamon rolls on lightly greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart; lightly press each roll down. Cover and let rise to double again. Bake at 350° for 15 to 20 minutes. Remove when they start to turn golden - don't overbake. Frost warm rolls with a cream cheese frosting. Makes about 20 large Cinnamon-like Cinnabon Rolls
Author: Unknown

Title: Double Delicious Halloween Bars
Ingredients:
1/2 c. butter
1 1/2 c. graham cracker crumbs
1 (14 oz.) can sweetened condensed milk
1 (12 oz.) pkg. semi sweet chocolate chips
1 c. peanut butter chips
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees (325 degrees for glass dish). In 13"x9" pan, melt butter in oven. Sprinkle crumbs evenly over butter; pour milk evenly over crumbs. Top with chips; press down firmly. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly brown. Cool. Cut into bars. Makes 24 to 36 bars.
Author: cooks.com

Title: Easy Cheese Chicken Casserole
Ingredients:
3 1/2 c. chopped cooked chicken
1 1/2 c. cooked med. egg noodles
1 (4 oz.) pkg. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese
1/4 c. grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 c. chicken broth
1/2 c. mayonnaise
1 (2 oz.) jar diced pimiento, drained
1 tbsp. minced onion
1 tbsp. parsley flakes
1 tbsp. celery flakes
1/2 tsp. salt
1/2 tsp. ground black pepper
Instructions: Combine all ingredients; spoon into a greased 8 inch square baking dish. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until casserole is thoroughly heated. Yield 4 to 6 servings.
Author: cooks.com

Title: Cheesy Green Bean Casserole
Ingredients:
1/2 cup chopped onion
2 tablespoons butter
2 tablespoons flour
2 cups sour cream
32 ounces style green beans, seasoned
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon pepper
1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
Instructions:
Brown onion in 2 tablespoons butter; add 2 tablespoons flour. Mix well.
Add sour cream and stir until it is mixed well. Drain water off green beans; put in large bowl. Pour mixture over green beans; salt and pepper.
Stir. Pour in baking dish; add shredded cheese over top. Bake at 350 F. for 30 minutes.
Author: cooks.com

Title: Winter Chicken Salad
Ingredients:
3 chicken breasts, about 12 oz. each
1 lb. carrots, pared and sliced thin
2 c. sliced celery
1 sm. onion, chopped, 1/4 c.
1/4 c. water
1 env. instant chicken broth or 1 chicken bouillon cube
2 tsp. salt
1/2 c. mayonnaise or salad dressing
Potato chips
Instructions:
1. Pull skin form chicken breasts, then cut meat from bones, dice meat.
2. Combine with carrots, celery, onion, water, chicken broth or bouillon cube and salt in a large frying pan; heat to boiling; cover.
3. Simmer 30 minutes, or until chicken is tender. Drain off any broth and save to add to soup or stew. Fold mayonnaise or salad dressing into chicken mixture.
4. Spoon onto a large platter; frame with potato chips and garnish with parsley, if you wish.
Author: cooks.com

Title: Pan Perogies
Ingredients:
4 onions, chopped 
4 tablespoons butter 
1 (16 ounce) package lasagna noodles 
16 ounces shredded Cheddar cheese 
4 cups instant mashed potato flakes 
1/4 cup butter
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Butter the bottom and sides of a 9x13 inch baking dish. 
Saute onions in the butter until translucent and soft. 
Cook and drain lasagna as per package directions. 
Make potatoes as per package directions for 12 servings. Combine the onions with the potatoes. 
Place a layer of noodles over the bottom of the baking dish. Cover with a layer of potatoes, sprinkle with cheese and pats of butter. Repeat ending with noodles sprinkling top with cheese and butter. Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 1 hour.
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Potato Cakes
Ingredients:
2 cups mashed potatoes 
1 egg, beaten 
1/2 cup all-purpose flour 
salt to taste 
1 pinch garlic salt 
1 tablespoon butter 
1 cup shredded Cheddar cheese
Instructions:
In a medium size mixing bowl combine mashed potatoes, egg, flour, salt and garlic. Mix well. 
Melt butter in a large frying pan over a low heat. Drop pancake-size (4 inch circles) lumps of mashed potatoes into the frying pan. Pat to flatten to 1/2 to 1 inch thickness. Sprinkle some cheddar cheese onto the mashed potato cake. Spoon more potato mixture over the cheese. Flip the potato cake over when the bottom is browned (about 10 minutes). Brown the other side (about 10 minutes).
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Grilled Pizza Wraps
Ingredients:
2 tablespoons margarine, softened 
8 (10 inch) flour tortillas 
1 (16 ounce) package shredded Cheddar-Monterey Jack cheese blend 
1/2 cup pizza sauce 
4 ounces sliced pepperoni
Instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-low heat. Spread margarine over one side of a tortilla, and place it margarine-side down in the skillet. Spoon a tablespoon of pizza sauce onto half of the tortilla. Sprinkle 1/2 cup of shredded cheese over the sauce, and top with a few slices of pepperoni. Fold the clean half of the tortilla over the filling, and cook until golden on each side. Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: White Sloppy Joes
Ingredients:
1 pound ground beef 
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup 
3 tablespoons milk 
4 tablespoons sour cream 
1 teaspoon liquid smoke flavoring 
salt and pepper to taste 
6 hamburger buns, split
Instructions: Place ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook, stirring to crumble, until evenly browned. Drain off excess grease. Stir in cream of mushroom soup (undiluted), milk and liquid smoke. Reduce heat to low, and cook just until hot. Stir in sour cream, and season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat. Serve on hamburger buns.
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Angel Chicken Pasta
Ingredients:
6 boneless, skinless chicken breasts
4 T butter
1 (.7 ounce) package dry Italian salad dressing mix
1/2 cup white wine or chicken broth
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed golden mushroom or cream of chicken soup
1 (4 ounce) pkg cream cheese with chives
1 (16 ounce) pkg angel hair pasta
Instructions:
In a large sauce pan melt butter over low heat. Add package of dressing. Blend in wine (broth) and undiluted can of soup. Blend in cream cheese and stir until smooth. Heat through gently.
Arrange chicken breasts in a baking dish. Pour sauce over.
Bake in a preheated 325 degree F (165 degree C) over for 60 minutes.
As baking time nears, in a large pot with boiling salt water cook angel hair pasta until al dente. Drain well.
Serve chicken dish over warm angel hair pasta.
Author: Unknown

Title: Chicken Italiano
Ingredients:
1/2 cup freshly grated parmesan cheese
2 T minced fresh parsley
1 t dried oregano (or Italian seasoning)
1 clove garlic, minced
1/2 t freshly ground pepper
2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts (pounded thin)
3 T butter, melted
Instructions:
Combine parmesan, parsley, oregano, garlic, and pepper. Dip chicken in melted butter, then in cheese mixture.
Place in shallow baking dish. Drizzle with remaining butter. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes or unitl tender.
Author: Cheryl Carter

Title: No Bake Cookies
Ingredients:
2 cups white sugar
1 stik butter
1/2 cup milk
3 T cocoa
1/2 cup peanut butter
1 t vanilla
3 cups quick oatmeal
(or 2 c oatmeal and 1 c coconut)
Instructions:
Combine first four ingredients in a saucepan. Heat unitl mixture reaches a full rolling boil. Continue to boil 1 minute longer. Remoce from heat.
Immediately add final ingredients. Stir. Drop by teaspoon onto waxed paper. 
Remove when firm.
Makes 2.5 -3 dozen
NOTE: Best to measure the peanut butter and oatmeal ahead of time so it is ready to add to hot mixture.
Author: Linda Dietz

Title: Dijon and Balsamic Glazed Roaster
Ingredients:
1 (5-7 pound) Perdue fresh whole oven stuffer roaster
 Salt and Pepper
3 tablespoons olive or vegetable oil
3 tablespoons Dijon mustard
1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar
1 tablespoon sugar
½ tablespoon dried thyme
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F/ Remove giblets from roaster and place it breast up in a 9x13-inch roasting pan. Season with salt and pepper. Whisk together remaining ingredients. Brush half of mixture over roaster. Cover roaster with aluminum foil; roast 45 minutes. Remove foil and brush remaining half of mustard mix over bird. Continue roasting uncovered 1 ¾ hours, or until bird-watcher thermometer pops up and meat thermometer inserted into thickest part of thigh registers 180 degrees F.
Author: Grammie

Title: Chicken Spaghetti
Ingredients:
10 half chicken breasts
3 T. oil
1 ½ c. chopped celery
1 c. chopped onion
1 green pepper chopped
1-16 oz. can diced tomatoes
1-15 oz. can tomato sauce
1 cup reserved broth
1-6 oz. can sliced mushrooms
1 T. chili powder
Tabasco to taste
3 T. Worcestershire sauce
Salt and Pepper to taste
1 cup chopped black olives (optional)
8 oz. thin spaghetti
3 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese
Instructions:
Cook chicken in salted water approximately 25 minutes.
Cool; Shred chicken. Reserve 2 cups broth, degreased and strained.
In large skillet, brown celery, onion and pepper in oil. Add next 9 ingredients and chicken and simmer for 30 minutes.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions, using 1 cup broth and water. Drain.
Combine spaghetti with chicken mixture and cheese in large casserole
Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until bubbly. If refrigerated before cooking, additional time must be allowed.
Best made day before serving.
Serve with tossed salad and rolls&
Author: Tracy

Title: Hot Cider
Ingredients:
2 quarts cidar
1/3 c brown sugar
1/4 t salt
6 whole cloves
6 whole allspice
4 sticks cinnamon
Instructions: Combine in saucepan. Bring to boil. Simmer for 5 minutes. Strain whole spices
Author: Linda Dietz

Title: Chili Spaghetti
Ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs ground beef
1 c. chopped onion
1 28-ounce can tomatos
1 16-ounce can kidney beans
1/2 c. ketchup
1 T. chili powder
2 t. brown sugar
1 1/2 t. salt
1 t. mustard
1 box spaghetti
Instructions:
Cook beef and onion in 3-quart heavy saucepan over medium heat until browned, stirring. Drain the meat once browned. Stir in tomatos with their liquid and liquid only from kidney beans. Stir in rest of ingredients (except spaghetti and kidney beans).
Simmer 45 minutes. Stir in kidney beans and heat 15 mintues longer. Meanwhile cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Add cooked spaghetti to chili and mix.
Author: Shannyn Petersen

Title: Mom's Veggie Dip
Ingredients:
1 c. sour cream
1/3 c. ketchup
1/2 t. worchestershire sauce
dash of salt, pepper, oregano, garlic salt, onion salt
Instructions: Mix. Serve with raw vegetables.
Author: Linda Dietz

Title: Taco Salad
Ingredients:
1 head of lettuce (cold and crisp)
3 diced ripe tomatos
1 chopped onion
3 cups grated cheese
1 1/2 lbs browned ground beef
1 large bottle catalina salad dressing
1 bag tortilla chips
1 T dry taco mix (add to dressing)
1 can kidney beans
Instructions:
Fry meat until browned; drain off excess grease. Drain liquid off kidney beans. 
Seperate lettuce into bite-sized pieces - soak in ice water for 30 minutes to crispen; drain thoroughly on paper towel.
Combine all the ingredients and pour salad dressing over the top of the mixture and toss lightly.
Serve immediately.
NOTE: Gets soggy if let to stand very long.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Coconut Cake
Ingredients:
1 cup whole milk (I used 1%)
2 Tab. butter
2 cups flour
2 teas. baking powder
¼ teas. salt
4 eggs
2 cups sugar
2 teas. vanilla
Topping
6 Tab. (3/4 stick) butter
1/3 cup dark brown sugar (I used lt. Brown)
1 cup (4 oz. can) shredded coconut (Preferable to flaked)
1 Tab. vanilla
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Butter and flour a 13x9 inch baking pan. I used Bakers Joy.
In a small saucepan or microwave, heat butter and milk to scalding. Set aside.
Beat eggs in an electric mixer. Add sugar and continue beating until thick and foamy.
With mixer turned on, gradually add hot milk, then vanilla. Beat in flour, BP&salt mixture with mixer at slow speed. Pour batter into prepared pan. Pat on bottom to get out some bubbles.
Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes, testing after 25 minutes with a toothpick. Cake is done when toothpick comes out clean. Cool cake slightly in the pan.
Prepare the topping. Melt butter in a medium saucepan or in a microwave oven. Stir in brown sugar, then add coconut and vanilla. Spread topping over the cake as evenly as possible, making sure to reach in the corners.
Turn oven to broil and place cake 4-6 inches below the heat. Broil until bubbling and dark brown, turning if necessary to assure even browning. The topping should be beyond golden, a definite brown, but be careful as it can burn in an instant.
Let cake cool to room temperature. Cut into squares at serving time.
We ate it warm and it is delicious that way!!!!!
Author: Grammie

Title: Cranberry-Pecan Pound Cake
Ingredients:
1 cup chopped pecans (about 5 ounces)
1 ½ cups cranberries
2 cups sugar
1 cup (2 sticks) unsalted butter, room temperature
5 large eggs
¼ cup sour cream
¼ cup orange liqueur, such as Grand Marnier or Triple Sec
2 teaspoons vanilla extract
1 teaspoon grated orange peel
1¼ cups all purpose flour
1 cup cake flour
½ teaspoon salt
Powdered conf. sugar
Instructions:
Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 350 degrees. Butter and flour (I use Bakers Joy) a 2½ quart tube cake pan or two loaf pans. 
Place pecans on cookie sheet and bake until lightly colored and fragrant, about 10 minutes. Cool. Coarsely chop cranberries.
Using electric mixer, beat sugar and butter in large bowl until light and fluffy, scraping sides of bowl once. Beat in eggs, one at a time. Beat in sour cream, then liqueur, vanilla and orange peel. Sift all purpose flour, cake flour and salt together. With mixer on low speed, add dry ingredients to egg mixture and stop when all flour has been added. Mix by hand until just combined. Fold in cranberries and pecans. Pour batter into prepared cake pan. Tap pan on counter to release any bubbles. (Place tin foil over bottom and up side a little, as my tube pan leaked a little.) Bake until tester inserted in center comes out clean, about 45 minutes for loaf pan and one hour for tube pan. (I think it takes longer). 
Cool cake in pan for 10 minutes. Turn out onto rack and cool completely. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least one and up to 3 days. (Can be frozen up to 1 month or even longer.) Dust cake lightly with powdered sugar before serving.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cream Puffs
Ingredients:
¼ pound (1/2 cup) butter
1 cup flour
¼ t. salt 
4 eggs
Regular Pudding
1  3.4 oz. pkg. jello instant pudding mix
1 ¾ c. whole milk or 1 ½ c. 1% milk
16 oz container whipping cream
1 t. vanilla
1 t. sugar
or
Cornstarch Pudding
3 T. cornstarch
1/3 c. sugar
dash salt
½ c. cold milk
1 ½ c. scalded milk
1 t. vanilla
Choc. Sauce
1 square baking chocolate
1 cup sugar
½ t. vanilla
1 t. butter
1/3 c. milk
or
Creamy choc. frosting
¼ c. water
2 T. butter
t. vanilla
2 melted squares chocolate
2 c. sifted conf sugar
Instructions:
Add ¼ pound (1/2 cup) butter to 1 cup boiling water. 
Stir to melt butter. Add 1 cup flour, ¼ t. salt all at once.
Cook stirring vigorously, until mixture is smooth and
Forms soft ball that does not separate.
Cool mixture slightly, add 4 eggs, one at a time.
Beat vigorously after each egg is added. Beat till smooth.
Drop batter onto greased cookie sheet.
Bake at 450 degrees for 15 minutes then
325 degrees for 25 minutes. 
Mini puffs  450 for 12 minutes, then 325 for 15 minutes.
When cool, fill with pudding.
Pudding
1  3.4 oz. pkg. jello instant pudding mix and
1 ¾ c. whole milk or 1 ½ c. 1% milk. Cool. 
16 oz container whipping cream, 1 t. vanilla, 1 t. sugar
or
Cornstarch Pudding
3 T. cornstarch
1/3 c. sugar
dash salt
½ c. cold milk
1 ½ c. scalded milk
1 t. vanilla
Mix c,s & s. Combine with cold milk. Cook in double boiler
Until thick; cover, cook 15 n 20 minutes. Add vanilla. Cool
Add some cool whip to it to thin it a little.
Choc. Sauce
1 square baking chocolate
1 cup sugar
½ t. vanilla
1 t. butter
1/3 c. milk
or
Creamy choc. frosting
¼ c. water  heat with
2 T. butter
add 1 t. vanilla & 2 melted squares chocolate
Add 2 c. sifted conf sugar. Beat.
Author: Grammie

Title: Fresh Fruit Cake
Ingredients:
1 1/2 cups orange juice
3/4 cups sugar
2 T cornstarch
1 t. grated lemon peel
1 t. grated orange peel
1/2 t. salt
1 14 1/2 to 16 oz pkg. angel cake mix
3 med. size peaches
1 pint strawberries
1 cup blueberries
Instructions:
1. Prepare fruit sauce: In a 2 quart
saucepan over medium heat, mix
orange juice, sugar, cornstarch,
orange and lemon peels and salt.
Cook over medium heat, stirring con-
stantly, until mixture thickens and
boils; boil 1 minute. Cover saucepan
and refrigerate at least 1 hour or until
mixture is chilled.
2. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 375 degrees
Line 15 1/2 x 10 1/2 jelly roll pan with
waxed paper. Prepare cake mix as directed,
Spread batter evenly in pan. Bake 20 min.
or until golden.
3. Cover large wire rack with sheet of
waxed paper. When cake is done,
with small spatula, loosen it from
sides of pan; invert onto waxed paper
on rack. Lift off pan; peel off paper.
Cool cake completely, then return
cake to jelly roll pan or large tray. 
Cover if not using right away.
4. To serve: Spread top of cake with
 about half of chilled fruit sauce.. Slice fruit. 
Arrange on cake. Brush with remaining
sauce. Makes 12 servings
215 calories
Author: Grammie

Title: Harvey Wallbanger Cake
Ingredients:
1 pkg. lemon cake mix
1 pkg. vanilla instant pudding (3.4 oz size)
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup vegetable oil
3/4 cup orange juice
1/4 cup Vodka
1/4 cup Galliano Liqueur
4 eggs
Instructions:
Mix all ingredients together with electric beater on medium speed for
4 minutes. Pour into greased and floured bundt pan. Bake 350 degrees for
45-50 mins.
 Glaze: After cake has cooled, drizzle 1 cup conf. sugar mixed with 1
tsp. butter and 1-2 T orange juice over cake.
Or 1 c. conf sugar, 1 T. Galliano and 1 t. Vodka, 1T. OJ
Author: Grammie

Title: Kahlua Cake
Ingredients:
1 package devils food cake mix
2 cups sour cream
1 package instant vanilla pudding mix
½ cup Kahlua
¼ cup oil
3 eggs, beaten
12 oz. chocolate chips (2 cups)
Instructions:
Mix all ingredients by HAND.
Pour into a greased and floured bundt pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 60  65 minutes.
Check with toothpick.
Author: Grammie

Title: Lemon Angel Cake Roll
Ingredients:
1 pkg. (10 oz.) angel food cake mix
¾ cup plus 1 Tab. confectioners sugar
1 (8 oz.) pkg. reduced fat cream cheese, softened
¼ cup lemon juice
2 tsp. grated lemon peel
8 oz. reduced fat whipped topping, thawed
12 drops yellow food coloring, optional
Strawberries or raspberries
Instructions:
Line 15 x 10 x 1 baking pan (jelly roll pan) with waxed paper.
Coat paper with Pam. Set aside. Prepare cake mix according
to package directions. Spread batter evenly in prepared pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes, or until golden.
Turn cake onto a kitchen towel that is lightly dusted with
conf. Sugar. Gently peel off wax paper. Dust with ¼ cup 
conf. Sugar. Roll up cake in towel, jelly roll style, starting
with a short side. Cool completely on wire rack.
Beat cream cheese and ½ cup conf. Sugar. Stir in lemon juice
and lemon peel. Fold in whipped topping and food coloring.
Unroll cake and spread with filling to 1 inch of edges.
Roll up again. Dust with remaining conf. Sugar.
Refrigerate 1  2 hours. Cut into slices. Garnish with berries.
12 servings.
Author: Grammie

Title: Maisonette Mousse au Chocolate
Ingredients:
¼ c. sugar
4 t. rum
¼ # semi sweet chocolate
2 egg whites
2 c. heavy cream
Instructions:
Place sugar and rum in small pan. Cook over low
Heat until melted and syrupy but not brown.
Break choc. into small pieces in small pan.
Melt over low water-let syrup cool to choc. temp.
Add syrup. Stir to smooth. If too thick, add more
Rum. Let this mixture become cool. Beat egg whites.
Fold choc. mixture into it. Whip cream and fold in
Also. Chill. Serves 8-10.
Author: Grammie

Title: Ann's Chocolate Mousse
Ingredients:
4 oz. sweet milk-chocolate -Cadburys
2 eggs separated
(1 egg, 2 oz choc. per person)
Instructions:
Melt choc. over warm water till melted. Remove from heat.
Beat egg yolks  add to choc. while hot, beating thoroughly. (This cooks yolk)
Cool 15 minutes. Beat egg whites to soft peak.
Fold into choc. mix. Spoon into dishes, cover and chill.
Garnish with shaved choc. and whip cream
Author: Grammie

Title: Old Fashioned Bread Pudding
Ingredients:
3 T. butter, melted
¾ c. sugar
2 c. milk
3 large eggs
2 t. vanilla
3  1 thick French bread slices, torn into small pieces
Instructions:
Drizzle butter into an 8 square pan
Whisk together sugar and next 3 ingred in a large bowl.
Stir in bread. Spoon into pan.
Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes. Stir. Bake 35 min.
More or until pudding is set.
Author: Grammie

Title: One Bowl Chocolate Cake
Ingredients:
6 squares Bakers Semi-sweet chocolate
¾ cup (1 ½ sticks) butter
3 eggs
2 t. vanilla
2½ c. flour
1 t. baking soda
¼ t. salt
1½ c. water
Instructions:
Microwave chocolate and butter on high for about 2 minutes
Until melted.
Stir sugar into chocolate mixture until well blended.
Beat in eggs, one at a time, until completely mixed.
Add vanilla. Add ½ cu flour that is mixed with soda and salt.
Beat in remaining flour alternately with water until smooth.
Pour into 2 greased and floured pans and bake at 350 degrees for
35 minutes or until toothpick is clean. Cool in pans for 
10 minutes. Then invert on wire racks and cool completely.
Author: Grammie

Title: Peach Crisp
Ingredients:
1 cup flour
½ cup packed brown sugar
¼ tsp. salt
½ cup butter
Filling
2 cans (16 ounces each) sliced peaches (1 quart jar)
1 cup sugar (used ½)
¼ cup cornstarch (used 2 Tbs.)
Topping
1 ½ cups rolled oats
½ cup brown sugar
¼ cup flour
5 Tbs. Butter
