Instructions: In a bowl, combine flour, brown sugar and salt. Cut in butter until crumbly. Pat into a greased 9 in. square baking pan. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, drain the peaches and reserve juice in a medium saucepan. Add sugar and cornstarch; bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Boil for 2 minutes or until thickened. Remove from the heat; stir in peaches. For topping, combine oats, brown sugar, and flour. Cut in butter until crumbly. Sprinkle over filling. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Author: Grammie

Title: Rhubarb Pie
Ingredients:
3 Tab. flour
1 cup sugar
4 cups rhubarb (5 Cups=1 ¼ c. sugar)
Instructions:
Mix flour and sugar together. Mix with rhubarb.
Add 1 egg that is beaten with 1 Tab. water.
Place in pastry shell. Top with 1 Tab. butter
Top with solid crust with slits.
Bake 450 degrees for 10 minutes
375 degrees for 40 minutes.
Author: Grammie

Title: Chocolate Chip Rugalach
Ingredients:
2 c. all purpose flour
1 cup (2 sticks) butter
 slightly softened
1 cup vanilla ice cream, softened
1 cup semi sweet choc. chips
1/2 cup strawberry jam
1 cup finely chopped walnuts
powdered sugar
Instructions:
Beat flour and butter, beat in ice cream. Blend well.
Divide dough into 4 balls and wrap each in waxed paper.
Refrigerate until firm (approx. 1 hour).
Heat oven to 350 ° Roll out each dough ball
on a floured surface. Shape each into an 11 x 6 inch 
rectangle, about 1/8 inch thick. Spread ach with 2 Tab.
jam and sprinkle with 1/4 of chips and walnuts.
Roll up lengthwise as for a jelly roll. Place on an
ungreased cookie sheet. Cut 12 diagonal slits in the
roll, but do not cut all the way through.
Bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool 5 minutes. Cut through each roll and 
separate the pieces. Finish cooling on wire rack.
Sprinkle with conf. sugar if desired
Author: Grammie

Title: Sour Cream Pound Cake
Ingredients:
1 c. butter
3 c. sugar
6 lg. eggs
3 c. flour
¼ t. baking soda
1 c. sour cream
1 t. vanilla
1 t. almond extract
Instructions:
Beat sugar medium speed about 2 minutes. 
Gradually add sugar, medium speed  5-7 minutes.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating just till the yellow disappears.
Combine flour and baking soda.
Add to mixture alternately with sour cream, beginning and ending with flour.
Mix at lowest speed until blended. Add flavorings.
Put tinfoil under a 10 tube pan which has been greased and floured. (Bakers Joy)
Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes. I needed more!
Cool in pan on wire rack 10-15 minutes. Remove from pan and cool.
Author: Grammie

Title: Steamed Chocolate Pudding
Ingredients:
1 egg
1 c. sugar
2 T. butter
2 squares melted baking chocolate
1 ¾ c. flour
1 t. salt
¼ t. soda
¼ t. cream of tarter
1 c. milk
1 t. vanilla
Instructions:
Beat well, 1 egg, 1 cup sugar, 2 T. soft butter,
2 squares melted baking chocolate
Sift tog.  1 ¾ c. flour, 1 t. salt,
¼ t. soda, ¼ t. cr. of tarter.
Beat in alt. with 1 c. milk & 1 t. vanilla.
Pour into greased and floured 1 quart mold. (I use Bakers Joy)
Steam 2 hours.
Author: Grammie

Title: Strawberries and Cream Layer Cake
Ingredients:
1 box butter recipe golden cake mix (1# 2.5 oz)
3 large eggs
¾ c. buttermilk
½ cup unsalted butter (1 stick) room temp,
1 T. vanilla
¾ t. almond extract
1  10 oz. pkg. frozen strawberries in syrup, thawed.
4 cups chilled whipping cream.
¾ c. sugar
3  1 pint baskets fresh strawberries. Hulled and sliced
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Butter and flour 9x13 pan or
2 8 layer cake pans. Using electric mixer, beat cake mix,
eggs, buttermilk and butter in large bowl until moistened,
about 30 seconds. Beat on medium speed for 4 minutes.
Beat in both extracts. Transfer batter to pan. Bake until 
golden about 28 minutes for 9x13. Less for layer.
Cool on rack about 20 minutes. Turn onto rack and cool.
Puree thawed berries with syrup in small cuisinart.
Beat cream with sugar in large bowl until peaks form
Using serated knife, cut cake horizontally in half.
Transfer bottom half of cake, cut side up, to platter.
Spread 1 cup strawberry puree over cake. Arrange 1 ½ c.
strawberries in single layer on cake. Spread 2 c. whipped cream
over strawberries. Top with 2nd half of cake, cut side down.
Spread remaining puree on top. Frost top and sides of cake
with rest of whipped cream. Garnish top with rest of berries.
Can be prepared 8 hours ahead and refrigerated.
Author: Grammie

Title: Tracy's Peach Cobbler
Ingredients:
2 cups peaches, peeled and sliced
1 ¾ cups sugar. divided
1 stick butter. melted
1 ¼ cup flour
2 teas. baking powder
¾ cup milk
pinch of salt
1 Tab. vanilla
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees
Mix peaches with 1 cup sugar, set aside
Melt butter in 9x9 pan or other 9 round casserole
Mix together ¾ c. sugar, flour, BP, milk salt and vanilla
Pour batter evenly over butter. 
Place peaches on top. Do not stir.
Bake for 1 hour
Author: Grammie

Title: Crab Cakes
Ingredients:
2 slices white bread
1-2 T milk
1 t. old bay seasoning
1 T. baking powder
¼ t. salt
1 t. Worcestershire sauce
1 beaten egg
1 T. chopped parsley
1 T. mayonnaise
1 # crab meat
Instructions:
2 slices white bread, crusts removed, broken into small pieces
Soak in 1-2 T milk
Add: 1 t. old bay seasoning
1 T. baking powder
¼ t. salt
1 t. Worcestershire sauce
1 beaten egg
1 T. chopped parsley
1 T. mayonnaise
1 # crab meat
Mix ingredients. Make into 8 patties. Fry quickly till brown.
Serve with cocktail sauce
Author: Grammie

Title: Grilled Salmon Fillet
Ingredients:
1 salmon fillet (about 1 pound)
2 T. lemon juice
2 T. red wine vinegar
2 t. grated lemon peel
1 ½ t. dried basil
1 t. garlic powder
1 t. soy sauce
4 ½ t. grated parmesan cheese
dash pepper
Instructions:
Place fish skin side down in disposable foil pan.
Combine lemon to soy; pour over fish
Sprinkle with cheese and pepper
Place pan on grille
Cover grille and cook on medium 15-20 minutes
Or until fish flakes easily with fork
Author: Grammie

Title: Easy Grilled Salmon Fillet
Ingredients:
Fillet
Lemon juice
melted butter
dill
Instructions: Wrap in foil and grill
Author: Grammie

Title: Pistachio Crusted Salmon
Ingredients:
1 to 3# side of salmon, skin removed
1 heaping cup shelled pistachios, coarsely blended
½ cup or more pesto
Instructions:
1 to 3# side of salmon, skin removed
1 heaping cup shelled pistachios, coarsely blended
½ cup or more pesto (I use Knorrs that you mix up) Preheat oven to 375 degrees
Remove any bones
Use tin foil on broiler pan. Place fish on it.
Cover with pesto
Pack pistachios on top
Remove any loose ones as they might burn
Bake 22 to 24 minutes (more if thick) at 375 degrees
Do not overcook
Let cool 2-3 minutes then cut with sharp knife into serving pieces
Serve immediately. Serves 6-8
Author: Grammie

Title: Mustard Pickle
Ingredients:
2 qts. green tomatoes
3 jars cocktail onions
2 large red peppers
4 large green peppers
1 cauliflower
1 english (small seeds) cucumber
Sauce
1 ¼ cup flour
3 cups light brown sugar
6 ounces dry mustard
2 tab. tumeric
2 quarts vinegar
Instructions:
Wash and cut into small pieces. Cover with water and salt (! quart water to ¼ c. salt). Let stand 1 hour then bring to a boil 10 to 15 minutes, till barely tender. Drain.
Sauce:
Mix mustard, tumeric and flour with enough vinegar to make a thin paste, then add sugar and rest of vinegar (I use a whisk for adding things!)
Cook on medium heat till sauce thickens stirring constantly to prevent burning. Add vegetables and heat a little more. Seal in sterilized (just pour boiling water in them and then tip upside down) jars. Makes about 8 pints. I keep it refrigerated so I dont have to process it.
Author: Grammie

Title: Lois H's Dill Pickles
Ingredients:
32 oz baby dills  slice and drain
1 ½ cup sugar
½ c. cider vinegar
stick cinnamon
¾ T pickling spice or ½ t. celery seed
1 t. mustard seed
¼ t. ground allspice
Instructions:
Boil solution 1 minute. Pour over sliced pickles. Set in solution 24 hours
Tip jar upside down
Author: Grammie

Title: Blender Hollandaise Sauce
Ingredients:
½ cup butter
3 egg yolks
¼ t. salt
Dash white pepper
½ t. prepared mustard
Instructions:
Heat butter in microwave. Put rest of ingredients
in blender container. Cover and blend about 5 seconds.
While running, add melted butter in slow stream till
blades are covered. Turn to higher speed and add
rest of butter slowly. Serve immediately. Great on
Eggs Benedict
Author: Grammie

Title: Spicy Cherry Sauce for Ham
Ingredients:
3/4 cup sugar
dash salt
2 tablespoons cornstarch
3/4 cup orange juice
1 tablespoon lemon juice
1 16-ounce can pitted, tart red cherries (water pack)
1 1-inch stick cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon whole cloves
1/4 teaspoon red food coloring
Instructions:
Tie cinnamon and cloves in cheese cloth bag.
Combine sugar, salt, and corn starch.
Stir in orange and lemon juices. 
Add undrained cherries, spice bag and food coloring.
Cook, stirring constantly, over medium heat until mixture thickens and comes to a boil.
Boil two minutes.
Before serving remove spice bag.
Serve warm with ham.
Makes 3 cups.
Author: Margaret Cyrus

Title: Cranberry Sauce
Ingredients:
4 cups cranberries 
1 ½ c. cold water
2 cups sugar
Instructions:
To 4 cups cranberries (1-1/3 pkg.)
Add 1 ½ c. cold water
Boil rapidly until skins pop (about 5 min.)
Press through fine sieve (foley mill)
to remove skin and seeds. Return to cooking pot.
Add 2 cups sugar. Boil rapidly 3 minutes.
Stirring occasionally. Skim off top foam.
Pour into jar or molds. Cool at room temp,
Store in refrigerator. Makes about 1 quart.
Author: Grammie

Title: Horseradish Sauce for Ham
Ingredients:
¼ c Mayonnaise
¼ c Sour Cream
2 T Grey Poupon Mustard
1 T Horseradish
Chives
Salt
Lemon Juice
Instructions: Mix together and chill.
Author: Grammie

Title: Grammie's Hot Fudge Sauce
Ingredients:
1/2 c. real butter (1 stick)
2 oz baking chocolate
1 c. light cream or half and half
1/2 c. cocoa
1 1/2 c. sugar
pinch of salt
2 t. vanilla
Instructions:
Melt together:
1/2 c. real butter (1 stick), 
2 oz baking chocolate. 

Add 1 c. light cream, 1/2 c. cocoa, 1 1/2 c. sugar, pinch of salt. 

Blend.
Bring to a full boil.
Remove from heat.

Add:
2 t. vanilla

Refrigerate until needed.
Heat to serve.
Author: Grammie

Title: Asparagus Soup
Ingredients:
¼ c. butter 
½ c. chopped onion 
1/3 c. flour 
2 c. cooked chopped asparagus
2 c. half and half
1 t. nutmeg
S & P
2 c. chicken broth
1 T. chicken base
Instructions:
Melt butter. Add onion. Cook till transparent.
Stir in rest of ingred. Except asparagus. Bring to a boil.
Add asparagus. Reduce heat and simmer 25-30 min.
Put in blender.
Author: Grammie

Title: Butternut Squash Soup
Ingredients:
3-4 T. unsalted butter (can use salted)
2-3 large leeks, washed and sliced (white parts only) Can use Vidalia onion
2 pounds (about 3 small) butternut squash, peeled, seeded and cubed
4 cups chicken broth (can use non fat)
Salt & Pepper to taste
Instructions:
Saute leeks in butter. Add squash and broth.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer till tender (30ish minutes)
Puree in blender and add S & P, ½ c. light cream, ¼ c. sherry (optional)
Author: Grammie

Title: Cantaloupe Soup
Ingredients:
2 ripe cantaloupes chopped
¼ c. plain yogurt
3 T. lemon juice
1 t. balsamic vinegar
1 T. honey
¼ t. salt
Instructions:
Put melon in processor and puree till smooth.
Add rest of ingred. Puree till fine-5 minutes
Chill. Serve in wine glasses. 4-6 servings
I did one melon at a time so container would
Not overflow.
Author: Grammie

Title: Corn Chowder
Ingredients:
1/8 # Salt Pork
1 diced large onion
2 large potatoes, diced
2 c. boiling water
1 - 12 oz can whole grain corn
1 - 12 oz can creamed corn
1 t. salt
1/8 t. pepper
1 qt. milk=some cream if on hand
1/4 t. paprika
Instructions:
Cut salt pork into small cubes; place in kettle
and cook on med. heat stirring often, till brown
and crisp. Remove and keep warm. Add onions 
to fat and cook till tender stirring occasionally.
Add potatoes and boiling water and cook till
tender. Add corn, seasonings, milk, pork bits.
Heat well over low heat.. Serve sprinkled with
paprika. Better second day.
Author: Grammie

Title: Pappagallo Gazpacho
Ingredients:
4 cups V-8 juice
4 large tomatoes, peeled and seeded
2 chopped green onions (or 1 med. onion)
1 cucumber, peeled and seeded
½ green pepper
½ cup celery
parsley
clove of garlic
4 Tab. olive oil
3 Tab. red wine vinegar
Instructions:
Blend till relatively smooth, retaining some crunch.
Tobasco if desired
Chill at least 4 hours
Serve in cold mugs with a dollop of sour cream on top 
If desired
Author: Grammie

Title: Pea Soup
Ingredients:
1# dry green peas
½ onion
1 cup cold water
1 hambone
½ c. cut up carrots
½ c. diced potato
¾ c. chopped onion 2 qts. boiling water
1+ t. salt
pepper
2 chicken boullion cubes
Instructions:
Wash peas. Soak if possible. Put together with cold water and onion. 
Lay hambone on top. Add boiling water salt and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and allow to simmer until peas are tender, about 90 minutes.
Remove hambone.
While soup is cooking, cook carrots, potato and onion in a pan. Drain.
Put soup mixture in blender, a little at a time. Then add ham from ham bone 
And vegetables. Check for seasoning.
Author: Grammie

Title: Southwest White Chili
Ingredients:
1 T. olive oil
1-1/2 lb. boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into small cubes
¼ c. chopped onion
1 c. chicken broth
1 can (4 oz.) chopped green chilies
1 can (19 oz. or 15 oz.) white kidney beans (cannelloni), undrained
2 green onions, sliced
Southwest Spice Blend:
1 t. garlic powder
1 t. ground cumin
½ t. oregano leaves
½ t. cilantro leaves
1/8 t. ground red pepper
Instructions:
1. Heat oil in large saucepan over medium-high heat. Add chicken and onions; cook 4-5 min.
2. Stir in broth, green chilies and Spice Blend; simmer 15 min.
3. Stir in beans. Simmer 5 min. Top with onions. Garnish with Monterey Jack cheese, if desired. Makes 4 cups.
NOTE: I always double or triple this recipe, except for the chicken, unless you want more chicken. I prefer not to use the cilantro. The consistency is close to soup, so if you want it thicker, you can use instant potato buds, a little at a time. I usually simmer for at least ½ to 1 hour&. Enjoy!
Author: Amy

Title: Tortellini Soup
Ingredients:
One quarter pound mild Italian sausage (casing removed)
1 cup sliced zucchini squash
One half cup green pepper squares
1 medium clove of garlic bud, minced
One half cup chopped onion
One quarter teas. crushed oregano
2 cans chicken broth, (10 + oz.) or use large one if you double recipe (46-49 oz)
One and one half soup cans water
One -8 oz. can tomatoes, diced (use juice too)
One -8 oz. package frozen tortellini
2 Tab. chopped parsley
Instructions:
In large saucepan, cook sausage, zuc, gr. pepper, onion, garlic and oregano until sausage is done. Stir to separate meat while cooking. Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat. Simmer 5 minutes or until done, stirring occasionally.
If frozen tortellini is not available, can use 8 oz. box and cook it in the chicken broth.
Author: Grammie

Title: Turkey Chowder
Ingredients:
Vegetable cooking spray
1 small onion chopped
1 c. turkey or chicken broth
1 (8-3/4 ounce) can cream style corn
1 medium potato, peeled and cubed
1/2 cup chopped celery
1 cup cubed cooked turkey
1/4 teas. salt
Dash pepper
1/8 teas. paprika
1/8 teas. ground ginger
½ cup milk
1 cup half and half
2 teas. chopped fresh parsley
Instructions:
Coat a large nonstick skillet with spray; place over medium-
high heat until hot. Add onion and saute until tender. Add 
broth and next 4 ingredients; bring to a boil. Cover, and 
reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are
tender. Add seasonings; grad. stir in milk and half and half.
Cook over low heat until soup is heated through, stirring
occasionally. Ladle into bowls, and sprinkle with parsley.
1 Quart.
Author: Grammie

Title: Turkey Barley Soup
Ingredients:
1 turkey carcass
6 qts. water
12 peppercorns
3-4 stalks celery, cut into fourths
2 bay leaves
1 large onion, cut into eighths
Pinch of garlic powder
1 cup barley
2 (16 oz) cans diced tomatoes
1 cup chopped onion
1 cup chopped celery
1 cup chopped carrot
2 teas. salt
1/4 teas. pepper
Instructions:
Combine first 7 ingredients in a large Dutch oven; bring to a boil
Cover, reduce heat, and simmer 1 hour. Remove 
carcass from broth, and pick meat from bones; set aside.
Measure 4 qts. broth and return it to Dutch oven;
Refrigerate remaining broth for other uses. Bring broth to
a boil. Add barley; reduce heat to medium, and cook 45 
minutes. Add turkey, tomatoes and remaining ingredients;
Simmer 30 minutes. Remove bay leaves. Yield about 
5 quarts.
NOTE: For Chicken carcass, I half the ingredients
Author: Grammie

Title: Winter Vegetable Soup
Ingredients:
3 T. Butter
1 med. head cabbage, chopped
4 medium carrots, sliced
2 stalks celery, diced
1 medium leek, diced
1 T. flour
1 ½ t. salt
½ t. pepper
1-13 3/4 oz. can chicken broth
1 10 oz. pkg. frozen baby Lima beans
6 cups water
½ cup regular rice
1 10 oz. pkg. frozen chopped spinach
½ cup heavy cream or half and half
Instructions:
Cook first 5 ingredients about 10 min. 
Stir in flour, salt and pepper.
Add next 4 ingredients and simmer 35 minutes.
Add spinach and break up.
Stir in cream and heat through
Yum!
Author: Grammie

Title: Punch
Ingredients:
1 can pineapple juice
1- 6 oz. can lemonade
1 quart lemon sherbert
1-1/2 quarts ginger ale
Instructions:
Have ingredients cold
Serve in punch bowl
Author: Grammie

Title: Incredible Pimiento cheese spread
Ingredients:
2 (8 oz.) packages cheddar cheese
2 (8 oz.) packages sharp cheddar cheese
1 (16 oz.) loaf process cheese spread (Velveeta)
3 T. sugar
½ t. salt
½ t. pepper
2 (4 oz.) jars diced pimiento, drained
2 cups mayonnaise (Hellmans)
Instructions:
Position shredding disk in food processor bowl;
shred cheddar cheeses. Cut cheese loaf into
cubes. Position knife blade in processor bowl;
Add half of cheeses. Process until smooth,
stopping once to scrape down sides. Transfer
mixture to a bowl. Add remaining cheeses, sugar, 
S & P to processor bowl; process until smooth
stopping once to scrape down sides.
Stir into cheese mixture in bowl. Stir in pimiento
and mayonnaise.
Yield: 2 quarts
Note: This dish may be frozen
I usually half this recipe
Author: Grammie

Title: Artichoke Spread
Ingredients:
Mix one 14 oz. can artichokes, drained and cut up
1 cup Parmesan cheese
1 cup Hellmans mayo
4 oz. can green chilis
garlic salt
Instructions:
Mix all ingredients together and place in a glass container
Cover
Bake 20 min at 350 Degrees
Serve with town house crackers or tortilla chips
Author: Grammie

Title: Chicken Salad
Ingredients:
3 cups diced cooked chicken
1-1/2 cups diced celery
3 t. Lemon juice
1-1/2 cups seedless green grapes sliced
¾ cups slivered toasted almonds
Dressing:
1 cup Hellmans
¾ t. salt
pepper
1 t. dry mustard
Instructions:
Combine chicken, celery, & lemon juice, chill an hour. 

Add grapes and almonds

Toss with dressing
Author: Grammie

Title: Baked Chicken
Ingredients:
Chicken
Milk
1/2 tsp. Salt
1 T Morton’s Season All or Lawry's season salt 
3/4 tsp. Pepper
1 c. Flour
2 tsp. Paprika
Butter
Instructions:
Place thawed chicken breast tenderloin strips in a bowl of milk. Let soak for 20-30 min. 
 
Mix in a Gallon Size Ziploc or Large Bowl: 

1/2 tsp. Salt
1 T Morton’s Season All or Lawry's season salt 
3/4 tsp. Pepper
1 c. Flour
2 tsp. Paprika

Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Cut 1/2 stick of butter into a few pieces and place in a 9x13 pan. Melt butter in pre-heated oven. 

Spread melted butter around the bottom of the pan. Lightly spray the pan, if needed, to make sure that there are no dry spots. 

Shake excess milk off of chicken and completely coat each piece with the seasoning mix. You can either shake the chicken in the bag, until coated, or dip each piece in the bowl until coated. 

Place each piece of chicken in the pan. 

Cook for 10-20 min. Turn each piece of chicken and continue cooking for 10-20 more minutes, or until cooked through. (I did 15/10 min)
Author: Sandy Seifert

Title: Tossed Fruit Salad
Ingredients:
Dressing:
1 c. oil
¼ c. sugar
1 t. dry mustard
1/3 c. white vinegar
1 ½ Tab. poppy seed
1 head lettuce, wash, dried and torn
1 pint fresh strawberries, halved
2 oranges, peeled and diced or mandarin oranges or clementines
2 avocados, peeled and diced 
1 t. salt
Instructions:
Dressing-Mix together in blender: Chill well.
For salad, add avocado just before serving or put
lemon juice on avocado
Author: Grammie

Title: North Shore Chicken Salad
Ingredients:
Dressing: Put in blender or processor and blend together:
2 large cloves garlic minced
1 Tab. Dijon Mustard
1/2 teas. salt
1/4 teas. sugar
1/4 teas. freshly ground pepper
1/4 cup rice wine vinegar
1/3 cup vegetable oil 
Salad:
4 c. freshly cooked wild rice (1 cup dry cooked in 3 c. chicken stock or broth
Juice of 1 lemon. Add to warm rice and cool.
1 whole chicken breast cooked and cubed or shredded
3 scallions including tops
1/2 red bell pepper diced
2 oz. snow peas, boiled 1 minute, drained and cut into 1 pieces
1 or 2 ripe avocados, cut into med size pieces
1 cup roasted pecan halves
Lettuce leaves
Instructions:
Mix all but last three ingredients with the dressing. Cover; refrigerate 2-4 hours
Just before serving, add the avacados and pecans and toss. Transfer to a salad bowl and garnish with lettuce leaves.
Serve with potato salad, deviled eggs, pickle and olive plate, fresh vegetables cut up with a dip in center, bowl of fresh fruit cup up
Ham, cheese, buns (Costco 39 in a bag), mustard, mayonnaise (Hellmans)
Author: Grammie

Title: Diet Cheesecake
Ingredients:
2 1/2 tsp. Sweet & Low
4 eggs
1 1/3 8 oz. pkgs. cream cheese
20 oz. light sour cream
1 1/2 Tbsp. vanilla extract
3 Tbsp. cocoa (I like the Dutch cocoa)
1/3 c. crushed sliced almonds for crust
Instructions: Butter a 9 inch square pan. Blend almonds in blender till fine. Pour in pan over bottom and sides. Mix eggs and Sweet & Low till foamy. Add cream cheese that has been cut into small chunks. Mix till only small lumps remain. Add sour cream and vanilla. Mix well. Pour half of batter into crust. To other half, add cocoa. Blend well. Pour over vanilla batter. Bake at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes until just set. Cool for 30 minutes. Then refrigerate.
Author: Grammie

Title: Diet Ice Cream
Ingredients:
2 cups heavy (whipping) cream
2 eggs
1 package gelatin
1 Tbsp. vanilla extract
3 1/4 tsp. Sweet & Low
1/2 c. cold water
1/4 c. cocoa (for chocolate ice cream) OR
1 Tbsp. plus 1 Tsp. decaf. coffee crystals (for coffee ice cream)
Instructions: Heat cream. Sprinkle gelatin over cold water to soften. Whisk eggs and gelatin into cream. Whisk until mixture begins to thicken (or coat the whisk). Remove from heat. Add Sweet & Low, vanilla, and either cocoa or coffee crystals. (I guess you could mix the two for mocha ice cream, but I never tried it). Whisk till smooth. Chill for about 2 hours. Follow manufacturer's instructions for ice cream maker.
Author: Grammie

Title: Croquettes (Salmon or Crab)
Ingredients:
1 large can salmon, drained, bones removed ( or 16 oz. crabmeat)
1 egg
1/2 c. chopped celery
1/4 c. mayo
Seasonings to taste - I use Old Bay, rosemary, parsley and McCormick lemon bits.
Instructions: Mix well. Form into 4 patties. Bake on non-stick cookie sheet at 325 degrees for 30 minutes. These freeze well.
Author: Grammie

Title: Croissant French Toast with Fresh Strawberry Syrup
Ingredients:
2 large day-old croissants
3/4 cups milk
2 large eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 tablespoons butter
3 tablespoons powdered sugar
Whipped Cream (optional)
Fresh Strawberry Syrup:
1 quart fresh strawberried
1/2 cup sugar
1/4 cup orange juice
1 teaspoon orange rind
Instructions:
Slice croissants in half lengthwiese
Wisk together milk, eggs, and vanilla. Pour into shallow baking dish. Dip croissant halves into egg mixture, coating well.
Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add four croissant halves, and cook about 2 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Repeat procedure with remaining butter and croissants. Sprinkle with powdered sugar. Top with whipped cream and strawberry syrup.
Fresh Strawberry Syrup:
Combine all ingredients in a saucepan, and let stand 30 minutes or until sugar dissolves. Cook over low heat, stirring occassionally, 5 minutes or until warm.
Author: Southern Living

Title: Marinated London Broil
Ingredients:
1 (12 ounce) can cola soft drink
1 (10 ounce) bottled teriyaki sauce
1 (2.5 - 3 pound) London Broil
Instructions:
Combine cola and teriyaki sauce in a shallow baking dish or large zip-loc bag; add London Broil. Cover or seal and chill 24 hours, turning occassionally.
Remove london broil from marinade, discarding marinade.
Grill, covered with grill lid, over medium heat (300-350 degrees) 12 to 15 minutes on each side or to desired degree of doneness. Let stand 10 minutes; cut diagonally into thin slices across the grain.
Author: Southern Living

Title: Easy Parmesan Garlic Chicken
Ingredients:
1/2 cup parmesan cheese
1 envelop Italian salad dressing mix
6 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1/2 t garlic powder
Instructions:
Mix cheese, garlic powder, and salad dressing mix.
Moisten chicken with water; coat with cheese mixture. Place in shallow baking dish
Bake at 400 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until chicken is cooked trhough
Author: Kraft

Title: Mom's Beef Stroganoff
Ingredients:
1 lb. cooked beef sirloin steak or top round cut in 1/4 inch strips
1 chopped onion (optional)
1 can cream of mushroom soup
3/4 cup chicken broth
3 T ketchup
2 teaspoons worchestershire sauce
2 T cooking wine
1 package (8 oz.) egg noodles
Instructions: Cook noodles. Mix liquid ingredients together. Add beef. Pour into 2.5 quart casserole dish. Bake for 40 minutes at 350 degrees.
Author: Linda Dietz

Title: Oh Boy Waffles
Ingredients:
2 1/2 C. Sifted flour
4 t Baking Powder
3/4 t Salt
1 T Sugar
2 Beaten Eggs
2 C Milk
1/4 C. light sour cream or buttermilk
3/4 C. oil
1 t Vanilla
Instructions:
Use electric mixer to beat eggs. Stir in the rest of the liquid ingredients.
In a seperate bowl, mix the dry ingredients.
Combine all ingredients, mixing by hand until no dry flour can be seen. Do not overmix.
Bake in waffle iron on medium.
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Dirt
Ingredients:
1/2 cup butter, softened 
1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, softened 
1/2 cup confectioners' sugar 
2 (3.5 ounce) packages instant vanilla pudding mix 
3 1/2 cups milk 
1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed 
32 ounces chocolate sandwich cookies with creme filling
Instructions:
Chop cookies very fine in food processor. The white cream will disappear. 
Mix butter, cream cheese, and sugar in bowl. 
In a large bowl mix milk, pudding and whipped topping together. 
Recipe yield: 2 medium size flower pots or 1 large
Combine pudding mixture and cream mixture together. 
Layer in flower pot, starting with cookies then cream mixture. Repeat layers. 
Chill until ready to serve. 
Add artificial flower and trowel. Enjoy!
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Chocolate Chip Cheese Ball
Ingredients:
8 oz. package cream cheese
1/2 stick butter
3/4 cups powdered sugar
2 T brown sugar
1/4 t. vanilla
3/4 cups mini choc. chips
graham crackers/sticks
Instructions: Beat together cream cheese and butter. Add sugar and vanilla. Beat until creamy. Fold in mini choc. chips. Put in fridge for several hours. Serve with graham crackers or graham cracker sticks (chocolate or regular)
Author: Cheryl Carter

Title: Fruit Cobbler
Ingredients:
2 cups berries (fresh or thawed and drained)
1/2 cup sugar
1 cube butter
3/4 cups milk
3/4 cups flour
3/4 cups sugar
2 T. baking powder
Instructions:
MIx berries and sugar and set aside. Heat overn to 350 degrees. Put stick of butter in 3 quart casserole and place in oven. While butter is melting, mix milk, flour, sugar and baking powder in blender. ONce butter is fully melted (not brown), pull out of oven. Pour flour mixture evenly in pan. Do not stir. add berry mix evenly on top of butter/batter. Do not stir. Bake for 1 hour. Cobbler will rise. 
Serve warm with ice cream.
Author: Amy Taylor

Title: Mom's Burgers
Ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs ground beef
1/2 cup ketchup
1 T onion flakes
1/2 cup bread crumbs (less if real)
NOTE: All measurements are approximate
Instructions:
Combine all ingredients. Make into balls and flatten. Cook on one side until juice is visible.
Makes 5 burgers
Author: Sandy

Title: Baked Ziti
Ingredients:
2 T. olive oil
1 medium onion, chopped
2 cloves garlic, minced
28 oz. can crushed tomatos
1/2 t. dried oregano
1 t. dried basil
1/8 t. pepper
8 oz. ziti
1 cup shredded mozzerella
2 T. parmesean cheese
Instructions:
In skillet, heat oil over low heat for 1 minute. Add onion and garlic then cook until soft. 
Add tomatos, oregano, basil, and pepper. Bring to boil and simmer 20 minutes. Heat oven to 375 degrees.
Cook pasta, drain well. Place in 13 x 9 casserole dish. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake uncovered 30 minutes.
Author: Cheryl Carter

Title: Crepes
Ingredients:
3 eggs
1 1/4 c. flour
1 1/2 c. milk
2 T melted butter
pinch salt
Instructions:
Beat eggs with whisk. Add rest of ingredients. Brush butter on skillet. Put about 2 T. of batter into skillet - spread around. Turn crepe over and cook on other side.
Makes 20 crepes
Author: Grammie

Title: Dump Bars
Ingredients:
2 cups white sugar
5 eggs
1 cup vegetable oil (or 1/2 c. applesauce & 1/2 cup oil)
1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder
1 1/3 cups flour
1 t. salt
1 t. vanilla
1 cup semi sweet choc. chips.
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a 9x13 pan with cooking spray. Dump all ingredients except for choc. chips into a large mixing bowl. MIx until ingredients are moistened. Spread into pan. Sprinkle choc. chips evenlly over the batter. Bake for 35 minutes. Cool and cut into squares. 
Makes 2 dozen or more depending on how big you cut them.
Author: Aunt Fran

Title: Autumn Pork Chops
Ingredients:
6 pork chops, about 1/2 in. thick
1 med. acorn squash, unpeeled
1/2 t. salt
2 T. butter, melted
3/4 c. brown sugar
3/4 t. kitchen bouquet browning and seasoning sauce (optional)
1/8 t. freshly grated nutmeg
2 T. orange juice
1 t. grated orange peel
Instructions:
Place 3 pork chops on bottom of a crock pot. Cut squash into 6 crosswise slices. Place squash slices on top of pork chops and place remaining 3 pork chops on top of squash. 
Combine salt, margarine, brown sugar, browning sauce, nutmeg, orange juice, and orange peel. Spoon sauce mixture over chops. 
Cover and cook on low 5 to 5.5 hours.
Author: Maria Thomas

Title: Amy's Sloppy Joes
Ingredients:
3/4 c. chili sauce (Heinz)
1/4 c. water
2 T. vinegar
3 T. brown sugar
1 t. dry mustard
1 t. worchester sauce
1 lb. ground meat
1 onion
Instructions:
Mix and cook first 6 ingredients for 10 minutes.
Add to cooked meat and onion.
Serve on buns with sliced carrots.
Author: Amy Myers

Title: Sloppy Janes
Ingredients:
3/4 c. chili sauce (Heinz)
1/4 c. water
2 T. vinegar
3 T. brown sugar
1 t. dry mustard
1 t. worchester sauce
1 onion - cut into thin rings
Instructions: Mix and cook first 6 ingredients for 10 minutes. Add to cooked onion rings. Serve on bread squares or rounds as an appetizer.
Author: Amy Myers

Title: Beef Marinade
Ingredients:
1 c. salad oil
4 t. worchestershire sauce
1/2 c. chopped onion
1 clove garlic
1 c. cooking sherry
1/2 c. lemon juice
2 T. soy sauce
2 t. oregano
1/2 t. basil
Instructions: Add all ingredients and shake well. Completely cover meat and refridgerate covered at least 3 hours. Turn meat once.
Author: Barb Myers

Title: German Oven Pancake
Ingredients:
3 T. butter
4 large eggs
1 c. milk
1 c. flour
1 T. sugar
Instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Melt butter in a 12 inch skillet over medium heat. IN blender mix eggs, milk, flour, and sugar until well mixed. Pour into skillet, place skillet in oven and bake 20 minutes until puffed up. Serve with a few drops of lemon juice and sprinkle with 6X sugar. Also can be filled with any fruit filling and sour cream.
Author: Unknown

Title: Roquefort Dressing
Ingredients:
1 cup Hellman's mayonnaise
½ cup sour cream
1 teas. garlic salt
1/8 teas. black ground pepper
2 drops Tabasco
Juice of 1 lemon
2 Tab. grated onion
Splash brandy if desired
1-2 cups blue cheese
Instructions:
Mix above together and add 1-2 cups crumbled blue cheese
(less than ½ #)
Fold together and chill. Best made in advance
Author: Grammie

Title: Easy Ramen Noodle Salad
Ingredients:
3 packages of dry RAMEN NOODLES, chicken flavored
1 bag of broccoli salad mix (bought in a bag, washed & ready to eat)
Fresh Broccoli, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 cup of peanuts (can substitute other nuts)
1 cup oil
½ cup sugar
¼ cup vinegar
Instructions:
Leave the Ramen Noodles in the packages and 
place all three bags into a plastic bag. Using a hammer, crush
the noodles until they are separated and in very small pieces.

Combine all the above ingredients together and set aside.
Variation: Use chopped carrots and green peppers  or, be creative.
DRESSING:
In a microwave dish, combine and bring the following ingredients
to a rapid boil. (this is done to dissolve the sugar)
1 cup oil, ½ cup sugar, ¼ cup vinegar
After the dressing has cooled slightly, pour over the broccoli, etc. above.
Store the salad covered in the refrigerator over night. It helps to stir the salad a few times to be sure all the ingredients are moistened.
NOTE: This is a very easy salad to make and it is great to take on a picnic on a HOT summer day (due to the type of ingredients)
Author: Aunt Eleanor

Title: Dijon Asperagus Salad
Ingredients:
2 oz. ziti
1/2 lb. asparagus, cut diagonally
10 cherry or grape tomatoes
2 T chopped red or white onion
1/3 c. poppy seed dressing (Marzetti's is best)
2 T dijon mustard (or a little less)
1/4 t salt/pepper
pine nuts
Instructions:
Cut asparagus. Boil pasta 5 minutes. Add asparagus and boil 4 minutes longer. Drain, rinse in cold water. Refidgerate 2 hours or longer. Add tomatoes and pine nuts at serving time.
We have this recipe every Easter!
Author: Rachel Mertz

Title: Homemade Dinner Rolls
Ingredients:
3 1/2 c. warm water
3/4 c. sugar
6 T. yeast
1 T. salt
1 c. oil
3 eggs, beaten
10 c. flour
Instructions:
Mix yeast, water, and sugar. let rise 15 minutes. Add salt, oil, eggs, and 1/2 of the flour.
Mix, then add remaining flour. Knead and cut out for rolls. Let rise 10 minutes. Bake for 10 minutes at 425 degrees.
May wish to cut recipe in half.
Author: Helen Tannehill

Title: Plattar (Swedish Pancakes)
Ingredients:
2 eggs
1 1/4 teaspoon salt
1 tablespoon sugar
4 cups milk
1 1/2 cups sifted flour
Instructions:
Beat eggs, salt, and sugar. Add milk and flour alternatively to mixture. Let stand for 2 hours. Beat again. 
Fry on top to stove in a lightly buttered Plattar Pan. If no Plattar Pan, make small 2 inch circles in fry pan.
Serve with lingonberry sauce and powdered sugar, or maple syrup.
Author: Ingrid Highberg

Title: Swedish Rice Pudding
Ingredients:
2 eggs beaten slightly
1 T. vanilla
1/3 c. sugar
2 1/2 cups boiled rice
1/4 t. salt
2 c. milk
1 cinnamon stick
powdered cinnamon and butter for top
raisins and almonds optional
Instructions:
1. Mix all ingredients.
2. Pour into buttered dish (approx. 8x8)
3. Put cinnamon stick into mixture.
4. Add powdered cinnamon and butter pats to top.
5. Place dish in a larger pan with 1 1/2 inch boiling water in bottom.
6. Cook 350 degrees for 1 hour.
Serve warm as a vegetable with Swedish meatballs, Korv, sill, and Lingonberry sauce OR serve cold as a dessert with whipped or heavy cream.
Whoever gets the serving with the cinnamon stick will have good luch throughout the new year!
Author: Ingrid Highberg

Title: Peach Cobbler
Ingredients:
1/2 c. butter
1.2 cup sugar
1 c. flour
2 t. baking powder
1/2 c. milk
4 cups canned or fresh peaches
Instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add flour and baking powder to sugar mixture. Add milk. Mix well. Pour batter into a greased 8 x 12 dish. Place fruit on top of batter. Sprinkle with sugar. Pour juice over batter. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes. Batter will form a crust over the batter. Serve iwth milk or ice cream.
Author: Aunt Lola

Title: Chocolate Mousse
Ingredients:
6 oz. semi sweet chocolate
2 T kahula
1 T orange juice
2 eggs
2 egg yolks
1 t vanilla extract
1/4 c. sugar
1 c heavy cream
Instructions: Melt the chocolate in the Kahlua and orange juice over very low heat. Set aside. Put the egg yolks and eggs in the top of a blender with vanilla and sugar. Blend for 2 minutes at medium to high speed. Add the heavy cream and blend for another 30 seconds. Add the melted choc. mix and blend until smooth. Pour into a bowl or small individual cups. Refridgerate.
Author: Unknown.

Title: Balsamic Chicken Marinade
Ingredients:
Chicken breasts - up to 5 lbs.
1 cup olive oil
1/2 cup balsamic vinegar
3 T. brown sugar
2 medium scallions
1 T. worchester sauce
1 t. dry mustard
1 t. salt, pepper, garlic powder
Instructions:
Mix. Marinate overnight. Grill Chicken.
Half this recipe for 4-5 breasts.
Author: Cheryl Carter

Title: The Original Chex Party Mix
Ingredients:
2 T. worchestershire sauce 
6 T. butter
1 1/2 t. seasoned salt
3/4 t. garlic powder
1/2 t. onion powder
3 cups Corn Chex cereal
3 cups Rice Chex Cereal
3 cups Wheat Chex Cereal
1 cup mixed nuts
1 cup pretzels
Instructions:
Heat oven to 250 degrees. Melt butter in large pan. Stir in seasonings.
Gradually stir in remaining ingredients until evenly coated. Then put in 2 jelly roll type pans. Bake 1 hour stirring every 15 minutes.
Spread on paper towels to cool. Stire in airtight container.
Makes 12 cups.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cheese Cake
Ingredients:
1 pkg Duncan Hines Yellow Cake Mix
2 pfg. (8 oz. each) cream cheese, softened
2 T. vegetable oil
1/2 cup sugar
3 T. lemon juice
4 eggs
1 1/2 cup milk
3 t. vanilla
Pineapple Topping:
1 can creushed pineapple (20 oz. per half cake)
3/4 cups sugar
2 rounded T cornstarch
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 300 degrees. Reserve one cup dry cake mix. 
In large mixing bowl combine remaining cake mix, 1 egg, and oil. (Mixture will be crumbly) Press crust mixture evenly into bottom and 3/4 way up side of greased 9x13 cake pan. 
In same bowl blend cream cheese and sugar. Add 3 eggs and reserved cake mix - beat 1 minute at medium, speed. 
At low speed slowly add milk and flavoring. Mix until smooth. Pour into crust. Bake at 300 degrees 45-55 minutes until center is firm. When cool top with filling. Chill several hours before serving.
Top with canned chery pie filling or half cherry and hlaf pineapple.
Pineapple Topping:
Bring pineapple, sugar, and cornstarch to boil for a few seconds. Let cool, put on helf of cake.
Author: Unknown

Title: Broccoli-Rice-Cheese Casserole
Ingredients:
1 stick margarine
2 T minced onion
1 box frozen broccoli - broken
1 1/2 cups minute rice
1 can cream of celery soup
1 8 oz. cheese wiz
Instructions:
Boil 1 1/2 cups water, add margarine, onion, and broccoli - boil 5 minutes. Add minute rice, remove from heat, let set 5 minutes. Add cream of celery soup and cheese wiz. Mix well.
Bake at 350 for 40 minutes or until golden brown. Fits 8x8 square baking dish.
Author: Karen Wolfe

Title: Chicken Parmesan
Ingredients:
Boneless chicken breasts
Spaghetti sauce
shredded mozzarella cheese
grated parmesan cheese
dry bread crumbs
egg or olive oil
angel hair pasta
Instructions:
Mix an equal amount of parmesan cheese and bread crumbs in a cereal bowl. In a second cereal bowl beat one egg or use 1/2 cup olive oil. Dip each chicken breast into egg or olive oil and then into cheese and bread mixture. Brown the chicken in a frying pan. Spread a thin layer of sauce in the bottom of a 9 x 13 dish. Put the chicken in the dish and top each piece with 1-2 spoonfuls of sauce and as much mozerella cheese as desired. Bake for 30-60 minutes at 350 degrees. Cook time depends on thickness of chicken)
Serve over a bed of angel hair pasta.
Author: Annie

Title: Sugar Snap Peas with Bell Peppers
Ingredients:
1/2 cup water
1 large red bell pepper, cut into thin strips
1 pound fresh sugar snap peas
1 garlic clove, minced
2 Tablespoons butter
2 Tablespoons fresh lemon juice
1/2 teaspoon salt
Instructions: Bring 1/2 cup water to boil in large skillet. Add red bell pepper strips, sugar snap peas, and minced garlic to skillet. Cook, covered, over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes until crisp-tender. Toss with 2 tablespoons butter, lemon juice, and salt.

Title: Broccoli Casserole
Ingredients:
2 boxes frozen chopped broccoli
8 oz. shredded velvetta cheese
1/2 - 3/4 cups margarine
1 sleeve of ritz crackers
Instructions:
Use 1 1/2 quart baking dish. Thaw broccoli, sprinkle with salt, and cook in microwave until nearly done. Remove and dot with margarine (about 1/8 cup). 
Sprinkle with shredded Velveeta cheese. Place in 350 degree oven for 15 minutes. Melt remaining margarine in microwave oven. Crush 1 sleeve of Ritz crackers and toss in melted margarine. Remove casserole from oven and sprinkle crumbs evenly over the top. Place back in oven for approximately 15 minutes or until casserole begins to bubble.
Men Love This!
Author: Darla Main

Title: Berry Party Punch
Ingredients:
1 can frozen concentrated grape juice (12 ounces)
1/2 can frozen concentrated fruit punch (6 ounces)
4 liters lemon-lime soda
1 lemon
4 cups raspberry sorbet
Instructions:
Cut lemon into tiny wedges and place into ice cube tray. Cover with water and freeze.
Thaw concentrated juices and mix together.
Pour juice mix and soda into punch bowl. Scoop a few generous scoops of sorbet on top. Add tray of lemon ice cubes for decoration.
Makes one large punch bowl full - approximately 60 6 oz. glasses.
This is Annie's absolute favorite punch!!!!
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Pizza Sauce
Ingredients:
1/4 cup olive oil 
1 cup minced onion 
1/4 teaspoon onion powder 
2 cloves garlic, minced 
2 tablespoons dried oregano 
2 (6 ounce) cans tomato paste 
2 (15 ounce) cans tomato sauce
Instructions: Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Saute onion, onion powder, garlic and oregano until clear. Stir in tomato paste and tomato sauce; reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes. Let cool and spread over prepared pizza crust.
Author: allrecipes.com

Title: Celestial Chicken Salad
Ingredients:
4 cups diced chicken
2 cups diced celery
4 1/2 oz. can sliced mushrooms (drained)
1/2 cup toasted pecans (halves)
4 slices crisp bacon (crumbled)
1 cup mayonaise
1 cup sour cream
1 1/2 tsp. salt
2 Tbsp lemon juice
Instructions:
Bake bacon in 350 degree oven for 10 minutes - watch carefully.
MIx all ingredients together.
Chill and serve in lettuce cups or on a plate with a slice of pineapple or cantaloupe and green grapes. Tasty ans pretty accompaniment.
Author: Lois Kienholz

Title: Coconut Macaroons
Ingredients:
2 egg whites
1/2 t. vanilla
2/3 c. sugar
1 1/3 cup flaked coconut
Instructions: Lightly grease a cookie sheet; set aside. In a medium mixing bowl beat egg whites and vanilla with an electic mixer on high speed until soft peaks form. Gradually add sugar, about one tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff peaks form (tips stand straight). Fold in coconut. Drop mixture by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto the prepared cookie sheet. Bake in 325 degree oven about 20 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. Trafer to a wire rack and let cool.
Author: Emil Arnold

Title: Bourbon Hot Dogs
Ingredients:
1 pound hot dogs
1/2 cup catsup
3/4 cup bourbon
1/4 cup brown sugar
1 Tab. grated onion
Instructions:
Cut 1 # hot dogs into 1 inch pieces
 Mix together:
1/2 cup catsup
3/4 cup bourbon
1/4 cup brown sugar
1 Tab. grated onion
Add hot dogs and simmer 1 hour
Put in dish that has candle or sterno under it
to keep it hot.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cheese-Olive Dip
Ingredients:
1-1/2 c. pimento stuffed olives, finely chopped
1 c. (4 oz) mozarella cheese, shredded
1 c. (4 oz) cheddar cheese, shredded
1 c. mayonnaise
3/4 c. pitted ripe olives, finely chopped
2 small green onions, finely chopped
Instructions:
Combine all ingred. in a medium bowl; Stir well.
Spoon into ungreased shallow 1-quart baking
dish. Bake uncovered at 350° for 25 minutes
or until heated through. Serve with corn chips or 
crackers. 3-1/2 cups.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cold Crab Dip
Ingredients:
1#crab meat (Phillips at PC is best)
1-1/4 c. mayonnaise (Hellmans)
1 c. grated cheddar cheese
1 t. horseradish
4 Tab. french dressing
Instructions:
Combine all and refrigerate
Serve with crackers
Author: Grammie

Title: Eggplant Appetizer
Ingredients:
Egglant
flour
milk
saltines
canola oil
Lawreys seasoned salt
Coctail sauce:
Catsup
Chili Sauce
Horseradish
S & P
Instructions:
Peel and cut eggplant into fingers
Dip in 1. flour
 2. milk
3. crushed saltines
Heat canola oil to 350 degrees
Fry until browned
Place on paper bag to absorb oil
Sprinkle with Lawreys seasoned salt
Serve with coctail sauce
 Catsup
 Chili Sauce
 Horseradish
 S & P
 Lemon juice
Author: Grammie

Title: Hidden Valley Ranch Party Pin Wheels
Ingredients:
2 (8oz) pkg. cream cheese, softened
1 pkg. Hidden Valley Ranch dressing (milk recipe)
2 green onions, minced
4 (12-in.) flour tortillas
1/2 cup diced red pepper
1/2 cup diced celery
1 can sliced black olives, drained
Instructions:
Mix first 3 ingredients. Spread on tortillas. Sprinkle on remaining
ingredients. Then roll & wrap tightly. Chill 2 hrs. Cut off roll ends.
Cut rolls into 1-in. slices. Makes 3 dozen.
Author: Grammie

Title: Knock-your-Socks-off Hot Crab Dip
Ingredients:
1/3 c. dry white wine
4 oz. cream cheese-room temp.
1-16oz. can water packed artichokes
 drained and finely chopped
1 c. mayonnaise
1 egg
1 pound fresh crabmeat drained and
 picked over well. Use Phillips from PC
 no need to pick over.
2 oz. blue cheese, crumbled fine
slices black olives for garnish
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350°. In a sauce pan over low
heat, combine wine and cr. cheese and simmer
until cheese is creamy. Remove from heat and
blend thoroughly with wire wisk.
Stir in rest of ingred. Pour into 8x8 inch baking(Pam it)
dish and bake for 30 minutes Garnish with olives
if desired. Serve with crackers
Author: Grammie

Title: Onion Pepper Relish Spread
Ingredients:
1/2 jar Harry and Davids onion/pepper relish
8 ounces cream cheese
crackers
Instructions:
Mix 1/2 jar Harry and Davids onion/pepper relish with
8 ounces cream cheese
Spread on crackers
Author: Grammie

Title: PasteDi Olive
Ingredients:
6 oz can pitted black olives 
8 oz Kalamata olives, pitted 
3 cloves garlic 
1/4 c olive oil 
fresh ground pepper to taste 
1 t. dried oregano 
Extra virgin olive as needed
Instructions:
Combine pitted olives in a food processor & finely chop into a coarse paste-like consistancy. Set aside. In a saute pan, lightly brown garlic over med-low heat. Discard garlic. Let oil cool. By hand, mix ingred. together. Store in refrig. Let age one week. Will keep up to 3 weeks. Top with more oil if needed,
Spread on baguette slices and serve.
Makes 1-1/2 cups
Author: Grammie

Title: Saga Blue Appetizer
Ingredients:
1/4 # saga blue cheese
1-8 oz. cream cheese
1/4 c. chopped pecans
few cut up chives
Serve as a spread for crackers
Instructions:
Oyster crackers-I make them ahead and keep them in the refrigerator at all times
16 oz. oyster crackers
Mix together, 1 package Hidden Valley (Milk) Dry Ranch Dressing
3/4 c. oil
1/2 teas. garlic salt
1 teas. lemon pepper
1 t. dill weed
Place crackers in Zip loc Baggie. Add liquid mixture. Mix around. 
Keep in refrig. and every time you open refrig, mix them up.
Next day, place them in a jar and keep refrigerated. Will keep for months.
Author: Grammie

Title: Meatball Sauce
Ingredients:
1 cup catsup
1/3 cup fresh lemon juice
1/3 cup grape jelly
Instructions:
1 cup catsup
1/3 cup fresh lemon juice
1/3 cup grape jelly
Simmer
Add to meatballs which have been heated and keep warm
Author: Grammie

Title: Savory Southern Pecans
Ingredients:
¼ cup unsalted butter
1 ½ teas. ground cumin
¼ teas. ground red pepper
3 cups pecan halves
2 Tab. sugar
1 teas. salt
Instructions:
Melt butter in large saucepan; add cumin and red
pepper, and cook 1 minute.
Remove from heat; add pecans, sugar and salt,
stirring to coat. Spread pecans in single layer in a 
15x10x1 inch jellyroll pan.
Bake at 300 degrees for 20 minutes, stirring
occasionally. Serve warm or at room temperature.
Store in airtight container for up to 5 days.
Yield-3 cups.
I used less of the red pepper and cumin.
Author: Grammie

Title: Spanakopitas
Ingredients:
1/3 package phyllo dough, found in freezer section of store
1/ 2-3/4 # butter, melted 
Nutmeg (optional)
Filling:
Stouffers spinach soufflé  thawed completely -- this is the best filling
 OR
2 Tab. olive oil
1 small onion, diced
1  10 oz. package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1 egg, beaten
1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese
1/8 t. pepper
Instructions:
About 1/3 package phyllo dough, found in freezer section of store  I have used rest for apple struddle or whatever!
Put phyllo dough in refrigerator the night before to defrost completely.
When using dough, place dampened dish towel over unused dough so it will not dry out.
Filling: Stouffers spinach soufflé  thawed completely -- this is the best filling
 OR
2 Tab. olive oil
1 small onion, diced
1  10 oz. package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1 egg, beaten
1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese
1/8 t. pepper
In 2 quart saucepan over medium heat, in med-hot oil, cook onion until tender stirring occasionally. Remove from heat; stir in spinach, egg, cheese and pepper
 1/ 2-3/4 # butter, melted 
With sharp knife, cut phyllo lengthwise into 2 inch wide strips. Place strips on wax paper then cover with slightly damp towel. I usually cut 3 layers at a time, about 6 strips per width.
Brush top of one strip of phyllo with melted butter. Place 1 teaspoonful spinach mixture at short end of strip. Can sprinkle with nutmeg, if desired.
Fold one corner of strip diagonally over filling so the short edge meets the long edge forming a triangle. Continue folding over, forming triangles until you reach the end ;of the strip to form a triangular shaped package. Repeat with remaining strips and filling.
Place on jelly roll pan, seamside down. Brush tops with butter.
Can be placed on cookie sheet and frozen, then place in plastic bags until ready to use or
Bake at 425 degrees about 15 minutes or until golden
Leftover dough should not be refrozen as it dries out and is difficult to use.
Author: Grammie

Title: Buttermilk Pancakes
Ingredients:
1 cup flour
1 ½ t. baking powder
¼ t. baking soda
1/8 t. salt
1 Tab. sugar
1 cup buttermilk
¼ cup sour cream
2 Tab. unsalted butter.
melted and cooled slightly
1 egg
½ cup fresh or semi-defrosted
blueberries or chopped
strawberries
About 2 Tab. butter for frying
Instructions:
In med. bowl, whisk together dry ingredients.
In large bowl, whisk together rest of engred.
With wooden spoon, mix the two, stirring
Just until combined.
Gently fold in berries.
Heat griddle. Add 1 Tab. butter and heat until
melted. Ladle about ¼ cup batter and cook.
Makes about 16 pancakes.
Author: Grammie

Title: Chile Relleno Torta
Ingredients:
1/2 # cheddar cheese, grated
1/2 # Monterey Jack, grated
5 eggs
1/3 c. flour
1 2/3 c. half and half
1-4 oz. can chiles, drained
1/4 c. picante sauce
Instructions: Preheat oven to 375°. Mix grated cheeses and spread evenly in buttered 10 pie plate. Beat eggs, add flour slowly, and then beat in half and half. If mixture is lumpy, strain it. Pour egg mixture over cheeses in pie plate. Carefully spoon chilies over the surface, then spoon picante sauce over all. Bake about 45 minutes or until center is set.
Author: Grammie

Title: Creamy Ham and Chicken Medley
Ingredients:
1 Tab. butter
1/2 cup sliced fresh mushrooms
1/3 cup butter
1/3 cup flour
2-1/2 to 3 cups milk, divided
1 cup whipping cream
1 cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese
1/2 teas. salt
1/4 teas. freshly grated pepper
1/4 teas. nutmeg
Dash red pepper
2 cups chopped cooked chicken
2 cups chopped cooked ham
1/2 cup peas (optional)
2 (10 oz) packages puff pastry shells, baked
Paprika
Instructions:
Melt 1 Tbutter in a large saucepan over med. heat; add mushrooms, and cook until tender, stirring constantly. Remove from saucepan; set aside.
Melt 1/3 c. butter in saucepan over low heat; add flour, stirring until smooth. Cook 1 minute stirring constantly. Gradually add 2-1/2 cups milk; cook over medium heat,; stirring const. until thickened & bubbly. Stir in whipping cream and the next 5 ingred. Cook stirring const., until cheese melts and muxture is smooth; stir in chicken and ham. Add enough of remaining 1/2 cup milk for a thinner consistancy, if desired. To serve, spoon into baked shells and top with paprika. Yield -12 servings. Sprinkle with freshly grated parmesan cheese if desired. Can be made a day ahead and heated in microwave.
Author: Grammie

Title: Crustess Jarlsberg Quiche
Ingredients:
1 stick unsalted butter
1/2 c. flour
1 1/2 c. milk
1 t. baking powder
1 t. salt
2 1/2 c. small curd cottage cheese
1 t. Dijon style mustard
9 eggs
11 oz cream cheese, softened
3/4 # Jarlsberg cheese, grated
1/3 c. freshly grated parmesan cheese
Instructions: Preheat oven to 350° (high altitude 375°). In a saucepan, melt the butter over me.-low heat, add the flour and stir just until mixture bubbles. Slowly add milk, stirring constantly. Stir this cream sauce until it thickens. Set aside to cool. Stir b.p., mustard, and salt into cottage cheese. Beat eggs well, then beat insoft cr. cheese and cottage cheese mixture. Slowly beat in cream sauce, then thoroughly incorporate Jarls. and Parmesan cheeses. Pour into 2 buttered pie plates. Bake about 45 min. or until puffed and browned. Cut each quiche into 8 large wedges. 16 servings
Author: Grammie

Title: Hash Brown Bake
Ingredients:
3 cups frozen shredded potatoes
1/4 cup butter, melted
1 cup finely chopped ham
1 cup (4 oz) shredded cheddar cheese
1/4 cup finely chopped green and red pepper
1/4 cup sliced green onion
2 large eggs beaten
1/2 cup milk
1/2 to 1 t. salt
1/4 t. pepper
Instructions:
Thaw potatoes between layers of paper towels to remove excess moisture.
Press potatoes into bottom and up sides of an ungreased 9 pie pan
Drizzle with butter.
Bake at 425° for 25 minutes or until lightly browned.
Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
Combine ham, cheese, peppers and green onion. Spoon into shell
Combine eggs and next three ingredients stirring well.
Pour egg mixture over ham mixture.
Bake at 350°for 25-30 minutes or until set.
Let stand 10 minutes before serving.
Yield 6-8 servings.
Note: May be assembled, omitting egg mix, and refrigerated 8 hours or overnight.
Let stand at room temp for 30 minutes.
Combine eggs, milk, S & P.
Pour over ham mixture
Bake at 350°for 25 to 30 min or until set.
Let stand 10 min before serving.
Author: Grammie

Title: Kamp Kofee Kake
Ingredients:
2 cups sugar
3 1/3 cups flour
1 ½ T. baking powder
1 T. Salt
3 eggs
6 oz. evaporated milk
Topping
½ pound brown sugar
1 T. cinnamon
¼ cup flour
4 T. soft butter
1 1/8 c. water
1 ½ sticks butter
Instructions:
Mix dry ingredients and set aside. Mix liquids then add to dry ingredients.
Sprinkle topping over batter before baking
Bake at 350 degrees 30-35 minutes. Makes one 9x13 pan.
Serves 25
Author: Sara Carter

Title: Pearl's Pecan Puffs
Ingredients:
Base
1/2 c. butter
1 c. flour
2 Tab. cold water
chopped pecans
Filling
1 c. water
1/2 c. butter
1 c. flour
3 eggs
1 teas.vanilla or almond
Frosting
2 c. conf. sugar
1 Tab. soft butter
1/4 t. almond flavoring.
chopped pecans
Instructions:
Base
1/2 c. butter
1 c. flour
2 Tab. cold water
Mix above like pie crust and spread 2-3 inch strips on 
cookie sheet--I use rolling pin to get them thin.
Press in some chopped pecans
Filling
Boil 1 c. water and 1/2 c. butter. Add 1 c. flour and
stir quickly until mixture forms a ball. Remove from heat.
Add 3 eggs, one at a time and stir well. 
Add 1 teas.vanilla or almond
Spread this filling on rectangles sealing to edges.
Bake at 350° for about one hour. Cool
Frosting
2 c. conf. sugar, 1 Tab. soft butter, 1/4 t. almond flavoring.
Moisten with milk and spread on puffs. 
Decorate with chopped pecans
Author: Grammie

Title: Cheesy Spaghetti
Ingredients:
3 pounds lean ground beef
2 teas. salt
3 cloves garlic, crushed
2 teas. oregano
2 teas. dried basil
Four 10 ½ oz. cans tomato soup
15 oz. can tomato sauce
1 pound mozzarella cheese, shredded
Two one pound packages spaghetti
Instructions:
In large saucepan, sauté meat, breaking it up with a fork, until it loses its pink color. Pour off fat.
Stir in salt, garlic, oregano, basil, tomato soup and tomato paste.
Cook, stirring occasionally, 15 minutes or until heated through and mixed well
May be refrigerated for two days.
May be frozen.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions. 
While spaghetti cooks, reheat sauce.
Stir in cheese and cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until melted.
Toss spaghetti with sauce.
Serves 12 - 14
Author: Grammie

Title: Mixed-up Salad
Ingredients:
2 bunches romaine lettuce
1 head iceberg lettuce
½ cup lemon juice
½ cup catsup
½ cup chopped onion
1 teas. salt
3 Tab. honey
1 cup salad oil
1 large cucumber, peeled and coarsely chopped
1 pint cherry tomatoes, cut in half
2 small avocados, peeled and diced
¾ cup coarsely chopped black olives
2 cups croutons
Instructions:
Tear lettuce into bite size pieces. Wash, dry, and store in plastic bags until ready to use.
Make dressing by combining lemon juice, catsup, onion, salt, honey and oil in food processor with metal blade or in blender.
Dressing may be refrigerated for several weeks.
Before serving, place lettuce in large salad bowl. Add remaining ingredients and toss with dressing. Serves 12  14.
Author: Grammie

Title: CrockPot Spaghetti
Ingredients:
1# ground beef
1/4 t. dry mustard 
1 T. instant onion
1/3 t. mace, allspice & pepper
1-1/2 t. salt
1/2 t. garlic powder
8 oz can tomato sauce
4 oz. can mushroom
4 oz. dry spaghetti (1-1/2 c.) broken into 4-5pieces
Instructions:
Brown beef well in skillet and drain
Put in crock pot
add rest of ingred. except spaghetti
Stir well. Cover and cook 6-8 hrs on low or 3-1/2 hrs on HI
Turn to high last hour and stir in spag. Eat
Author: Grammie

Title: Lasagna
Ingredients:
1 1/2# ground beef
2 large onions chopped 
1 clove garlic
olive oil
2-3 t. salt
3 c. tomato juice
1 6 oz. can tomato paste, 2 cans water
1 t. sugar
1 t. oregano
1 t. basil
1 pkg. lasagna noodles 
24 oz. mozarella
1 # ricotta
Parmesan
1 egg
Instructions:
Cook ground beef, onion, garlic, and oil until browned. Add salt, tomato juice, tomato paste, water, sugar, oregano, and basil. Cook lasgna noodles as directed. Blend cheeses together.
Layer: 1. meat sauce 2. lasagna 3. ricotta mix
1. moz cheese repeat 1 or 2 times. End with meat sauce.
Top with more parmesan Bake 350 deg. 40 min. 13x9x2 pan
Author: Grammie

Title: Sausage Lasagna
Ingredients:
Sauce
1 # mild sausage
1 clove of garlic minced 
1 T. parsley flakes
1 T. basil
1 1/2 t. salt
1 1#can tomatoes (2c.) cut up
2 6oz tomato paste
10 oz. pkg. lasagna
3 c. cream style cottage cheese
2 beaten eggs
2 t. salt 1/2 t. pepper
2 t. parsley flakes 
1/2 c. grated parmesan cheese
1 # mozarella
Instructions:
Brown meat slowly in oil and spoon off fat. Add garlic, parsley, basil, salt, tomatos, and tomato paste.
Cook lasagna noodes as directed.
Mix together cottage cheese, eggs, pepper, salt, parsley, and parmesan.
Layer: 1. sauce, 2. noodles, 3. cheese 4. mozzerella in a 9x13 pan.
Repeat twice-end with meat sauce. Bake 350-30 min.
Author: Grammie

Title: Linguini with Roasted Vegetables
Ingredients:
1½ # plum tomatoes, cut in ¾ inch chunks
2 large zucchini (about 1¼#) quartered lengthwise,
 cut crosswise into ¾ inch pieces.
1 yellow squash (about 6 oz.) quartered lengthwise,
 cut crosswise into ¾ inch pieces.
2 red bell peppers, cut into ½ inch pieces
1 medium red onion, cut into eighths.
3 Tab. olive oil
1½ Tab. minced garlic
1 tsp. salt
½ tsp. freshly ground pepper
1 lb. linguini or spaghetti
½ cup grated Parmesan cheese
1/3 cup chopped basil or parsley
Serve with: grated Parmesan cheese
Instructions:
1. Adjust oven racks to divide oven in thirds. Heat to 450
degrees. Have ready 2 rimmed baking sheets. (Lightly spray with pam)
2. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil.
3. Put first 9 ingredients into a large bowl. Toss to mix and coat.
Spread in baking sheets. Roast, switching position of pans once. Cook
20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender.
4. Meanwhile, stir pasta into the boiling water and cook as package directs
5. .Remove and reserve ½ cup of the pasta cooking water. Drain pasta.
Return to pot. Add vegetables, scraping baking pans with a rubber spatula to
include any juices, reserved cooking water, the cheese and basil or parsley.
Serve additional cheese at the table.
Author: Grammie

Title: Linguini with Tomatoes and Basil
Ingredients:
3 large ripe good quality tomatoes (I use the ones with stems)
 cut into 1/2 inch cubes
3/4 pound Brie cheese, rind removed, torn into irregular pieces
3/4 cup cleaned fresh basil leaves, cut into strips
2 garlic cloves, peeled and finely minced
3/4 cup olive oil (good quality)
1/2 teas. salt
1/3 teas freshly ground pepper
1 pound Linguini
Freshly grated Parmesan Cheese
Instructions:
Combine first seven ingredients in a large serving bowl. Cover with saran wrap. Prepare 2 - 5 hours before serving and set aside at room temperature.
 Bring 6 quarts water to a boil. Add 1 Tab. olive oil and 2 teas. salt. Add linguini and boil until tender but firm = 8 - 10 minutes
 Drain pasta and immediately toss with the tomato sauce. Serve at once with parmesan cheese.
Great with good loaf of fresh bread (Great Harvest) and baby greens salad.
Author: Grammie

Title: Pasta Primavera
Ingredients:
1# fresh asparagus, cut diag. 1 1/2
2 c. fresh broccoli flowerets
1 med onion, chopped
1 large clove garlic, chopped
1 T. olive oil
l large carrot peeled & cut diag.
1 med. size red & yellow pepper,
coarsely chopped
1/2# sliced mushrooms
1 c. whipping cream
1/2 c. chicken broth
2 T. fresh basil or 2 t. dried basil
1/2 t. salt
3 green onions, chopped
8 oz uncooked linguini, broken in half
1 c. freshly grated parmesan cheese
1/4 t. freshly ground pepper
Instructions:
Place asp. & broc. into vegetable steamer over
boiling water. Cover and steam 6-8 minutes till
crisp-tender. Set aside. Saute onion and garlic
in oil in a large skillet till tender. Add carrots,
peppers, mushrooms. Saute till crisp-tender. Remove
from heat, drain. Combine cream, broth, basil, gr onion & 
salt in medium skillet. Cook over med heat 5 min. 
stirring occasionally.
Cook linguini according to package directions. Drain
well. Place in large serving bowl. Add vegetables, 
whipping cream mixture--toss gently. Sprinkle with
parmesan cheese and pepper. Toss gently again.
Serve immediately. 8 servings. Good reheated in micro.
Author: Grammie

Title: Rachel's Shrimp Pasta
Ingredients:
1/2C minced onion
2T butter
1 1/2T olive oil
1/2C dry white wine
2 cans of stewed tomatoes
2 cloves minced garlic
1t salt
1/4 t ground pepper
1 1/2t oregano
4-6 ounce crumbled feta cheese
1 lb raw shrimp- peeled and deveined
1/4C chopped fresh parsley
Instructions:
Saute onion in oil and butter until soft. Add wine, tomatoes, garlic, salt 
and pepper, and oregano, Bring to a boil, lower heat and simmer until sauce 
thickens. Stir in feta cheese and let simmer 10-15 minutes. Adjust 
seasonings to taste. Add shrimp and cook for 5 minutes until just tender. 
Garnish with parsley and serve over pasta.
Author: Rachel Carter

Title: Seafood Lasagna
Ingredients:
6 c. water 
1-1/2 to2 # med. shrimp 
12 lasagna noodles, uncooked 
1 c. chopped onion 
2 T. butter or margarine, melted 
1-8 oz. pkg. cream cheese softened 
1-1/2 c. small curd cottage cheese 
1 large egg, beaten 
2 t. dried basil, crushed
1/2 t. salt, 1/8 t. pepper
1/4 c. butter or margarine
1/4 c. flour
2 c. milk
2/3 c. Chablis or dry white wine
1 -6 oz. can crabmeat, drained-use Phillips
1/4 c. parmesan cheese
1/2 c. shredded Am. or cheddar cheese
Garnish: chopped fresh parsley
Instructions:
Bring water to a boil; add shrimp and cook 3-5 minutes. Drain well; rinse with cold water. Chill. Peel and devein shrimp. (I eliminate this step and buy frozen, cooked shrimp.) Coarsly chop shrimp; set aside. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions; drain well, add cold water and set aside.
Saute onion in 2 T butter in a large skillet over medium heat until tender. Add cream cheese, cook over low heat, stirring constantly until cheese melts. Stir in cottage cheese and next 4 ingredients; remove from heat, and set aside.
Melt 1/4 c. butter in heavy saucepan over low heat; add flour, stirring until smooth. 
Gradually add milk; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly. Remove from heat; stir in reserved shrimp, wine and crabmeat.
Layer half of reserved noodles in a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Spread half of reserved cream cheese mixture over noodles. Spread half of shrimp mixture over cream cheese mixture. Repeat layers with remaining noodles, cream cheese mixture and shrimp mixture. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Bake, uncovered at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. Sprinkle with cheese. Bake an additional 5 minutes, or until cheese melts. Let stand 10 minutes before serving. Garnish if desired. 8 servings.
Author: Grammie

Title: Grammie's Stuffed Shells
Ingredients:
2 beaten eggs
1# ricotta cheese
1# cottage cheese
1/2 cup parmesan cheese
1Tab. chopped parsley
salt and pepper to taste
1 box jumbo shells
Spaghetti Sauce
Instructions:
Mix 2 beaten eggs, 1# ricotta cheese, 1# cottage cheese, 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, 1Tab. chopped parsley, salt and pepper to taste.
In 5 quarts of boiling water, boil 1 box jumbo shells 9-10 minutes. Stir occasionally. Drain in colander, then cover them in pan with cold water. Drain a few (6-8) at a time on a clean dish towel. Fill shells with stuffing using a spoon. I put them on large plates till finished, to make sure all the filling is used. If not, stuff some fuller!!!!!!!!!!!
Use kind of spaghetti sauce you like, and you be the judge on how much to use. They dont need to be swimming in it!!
Cover the bottom of 9x13 pan with spaghetti sauce. Arrange shells side by side. Pour remaining spaghetti sauce over shells. Sprinkle with parmesan. Cover with foil. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes.
Can be made in smaller casseroles to suit a family and some can be frozen till ready to use. Leftovers are great in the microwave.
Author: Grammie

Title: Spaghetti Pie
Ingredients:
6 oz. spaghetti
2 T butter
1/2 cup parmesan cheese
2 well-beaten eggs 
1 lb. ground beef
1/2 cup chopped onions
1 jar spaghetti sauce
1 cup cottage cheese
1 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded
Instructions:
Makes 2 pies.
Cook spaghetti & drain. Stir in butter, parmesan cheese and eggs. Form
spaghetti mix into crust in two 9-in (or 8-in) pie pans. In skillet,
cook ground beef with onion. Drain off fat. Stir in spaghetti sauce and
heat. Spread cottage cheese over the bottom crust of spaghetti. Top with
meat sauce. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese. Bake at 350 degrees for
30-45 minutes, or until heated through.
(This casserole freezes well. It will keep in the refrigerator for
several days before baking.)
Author: Grammie

Title: Tomato and Garlic Sauce
Ingredients:
3 T. olive oil
1 cup finely chopped onions
1 T. finely chopped garlic
4 c. Italian plum or whole pack tomatoes, 
chopped but not drained
1-6oz. can tomato sauce
1 T. dried oregano, crumbled
1 T. finely cut fresh basil or 1 t. dried basil
1 bay leaf
2 t. sugar, 1 ½ t. salt, freshly ground black pepper
Instructions:
Saute onions in oil and cook on low 7-8 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1-2 more min. stirring constantly.
Add remaining ingredients. Bring to a boil.
Simmer about an hour. Sauce should be thick and smooth.
Remove bay leaf. May puree if desired.
Author: Grammie

Title: Tomato Sausage Sauce with Shells
Ingredients:
1 pound Italian pork sausage
3 T. butter
1 t. rosemary
1 28 oz can diced tomatoes
3 T. water
red pepper flakes
Salt to taste
3/4 c. heavy cream
Hot cooked pasta shells
1/2 c. grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese
Instructions:
Boil sausage in water to cover 3-4 minutes, drain
Let cool and slice into thin rounds
Melt 3 T. butter in skillet and brown sausage
Add rosmary, tomatos, and water. Cook 7-10 minutes until water is evaporated and tomato forms a sauce. 
Add red peper flakes, salt, and cream and reduce by half, stirring often 
Remove from heat. Serve on Hot cooked pasta shells with 1/2 c. grated Parmigiano-Reggiano cheese
Author: Grammie

Title: Chicken Parisiennee
Ingredients:
10-12 chicken breast halfs
6-8 slices baby swiss cheese
1 can cream of mushroom soup
1 can cream of chicken soup
1 (4oz.) can mushrooms undrained
1 cup sour cream
½ cup sherry
paprika
Instructions:
Spray 9 x 13 pan. Place chicken in pan.
Arrange cheese slices to cover
Blend rest of ingredients.
Spoon over cheese layer
Sprinkle with paprika
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 ½ hours or till tender
Serves 6-8 people
Author: Grammie

Title: Devon Chicken
Ingredients:
8 boned half-breasts of chicken
Mix together the following marinade:
1 pint sour cream
2 T. lemon juice
2 t. Worcestershire sauce
¼ t. crushed celery seed
1 t. paprika
1 clove of garlic, minced
½ t. salt
1/8 t. pepper
1 bag herbed stuffing, crumbled with rolling pin
½ c. melted butter
1 10 ½ oz. golden mushroom soup
Parsley
1-2 T. sherry
Instructions:
The night before serving, mix together the marinade and add chicken. Marinate overnight.
Roll chicken in stuffing mix
Put in greased baking dish
Top with butter
Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
Combine soup, parsley and sherry to make sauce.
Heat and put in gravy boat and serve with chicken.
Author: Grammie

Title: Chicken with Balsamic Vinegar Sauce
Ingredients:
4 chicken breasts, halved
Salt and Pepper
1 Tab. + 2 teas. butter, 1 Tab. olive oil
2 large shallots, minced
6 Tab. balsamic vinegar
1 teas. dark brown sugar
1 c. unsalted chicken broth
1-1/2 Tab. fresh marjoram (or 1-1/2 teas. dried)
2-4 Tab. evaporated skim milk
Instructions:
Pat chicken breasts dry and sprinkle with S & P
Melt 1 T butter and oil in large skillet over med-hi heat.
Saute breasts till just colored, about 2 min. on each side.
Remove chicken. Add remaining 2 t. butter. Lower
heat and add shallots. Saute, stirring till translucent.
Add vinegar, bro. sugar and ch. broth. Bring to a boil
and return the chicken and any accumulated juices to pan.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes or until ch. is springy to the touch.
Remove chicken and keep warm. Raise heat and boil rapidly
till reduced to 1/2 cup. Remove from heat and whisk in marjoram, 
S & P and evaporated milk. Slice on diagonal the reserved
chicken into 1/2 slices. Spoon sauce over.
Author: Grammie

Title: Lois' Apricot Chicken
Ingredients:
8-10 chicken breasts
1 8 oz. bottle Russian Dressing
1 envelope onion soup mix
1 10 or 12 oz jar apricot preserves
Instructions:
In a small bowl, combine dressing, soup mix and preserves.
Place chicken in a 9 x 13 baking dish. Cover with glaze.
Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for an hour. 
Uncover and bake longer if more browning is desired.
I remove all skin from chicken. Other parts of chicken can be used.
If breasts are cut in half, then in half again, it would serve quite a few.
Also could cut them like Rachels recipe in fingers and not bake them as long.
Author: Grammie

Title: Lemon Chicken with Artichoke Hearts and Mushrooms
Ingredients:
4 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves
1/2 tsp. crushed black peppercorns
1/2 cup butter, divided
1 (14 oz) can artichoke hearts, rinsed, drained and halved
3-4 TBS spoons fresh lemon juice
1 TBS chopped, fresh parsley
4 TBS dry white wine
2 TBS chicken broth
1/2 pound fresh mushrooms, sliced
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 300 degrees
Pound chicken to 1/4 inch thickness
Rub both sides of the chicken with crushed peppercorns and sprinkle with salt
Heat two TBS butter in heavy skillet over medium heat. Add chicken and saute 3-5 minutes each side. Transfer to baking pan and keep warm.
Add 2 TBS butter to same skillet. Stir in artichokes & mushrooms and saute 1 minute, Add lemon juice, wine, chicken broth and parsley. Saute 2-3 minutes.
You can either pour over chicken and heat thoroughly or return chicken to pan to heat thoroughly. Yields 4 servings
Author: Grammie

Title: Lady's Island Chicken Breasts
Ingredients:
1 cup dry breadcrumbs
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
6 chicken breasts cut in strips
7 tablespoons butter, divided
1/4 cup minced shallots or green onions
1/2 cup chicken broth
1/2 cup dry white wine
1'2 pound fresh mushrooms, sliced
2 cups red seedless grapes, halved
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 375
Combine breadcrumbs, salt, pepper blending well. Dredge chicken lightly in mixture
Melt 1/4 cup butter in large, heavy skillet over medium heat. Brown chicken on both sides.
Place chicken in single layer in shallow baking pan
Add shallots or green onions to skillet and saute 3 minutes. Stir in broth and wine and bring to boil. Pour over chicken and bake for 30 minutes.
Melt remaining 3 tablespoons of butter in same skillet. Saute mushrooms and grapes 3-4 minutes. Add to chicken in baking pan and bake an additional 8-10 minutes.
Yields 6-8 servings.
Author: Grammie

Title: Rachel's Apricot Chicken
Ingredients:
2 12-oz jars apricot preserves
1 8-oz jar dijon mustard
3 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a bowl combine the preserves and mustard 
(use more or less mustard to suit taste) Cut the chicken breasts into 
strips about 2 inches wide and add to the apricot mixture. Generously coat 
the chicken. Pour it all into a baking dish and cook for about 45 minutes, 
serves 8-10.
Author: Rachel Carter

Title: Thai Asparagus Chicken
Ingredients:
4 cups fresh asparagus, cut diagonally ½ inch pieces
2 cups chopped onions
Peanut oil
1 clove garlic
½ teas. salt.
½ cup chicken stock or broth
2 Tab. butter
2 cups raw chicken, cut in small chunks
2 cups fresh sliced mushrooms
4 Tab. soy sauce
Dash of pepper
Instructions:
First pan: large: Generously cover bottom of pan with peanut oil; add 1/2 tsp salt; drop in garlic clove; remove when brown. Add asparagus and onion, stirring constantly on high heat for 4 minutes. Cook underdone. Add chicken stock; set aside.
Second pan: In 2 Tab. butter, brown the chicken 5 minutes; add 4 Tab. soy sauce (more if you like) and a little dash of pepper. Add sliced mushrooms and cook 2 minutes longer. Add chicken mixture to asparagus. Heat and serve. Do not overcook.
Serve with rice and salad. Rolls too?
Author: Grammie

Title: Chicken Lo Mein
Ingredients:
2 t. instant chicken broth granules or cubes
2 cups boiling water
8 oz. boneless skinned chicken breast, cut in long thin slices
¼ cup dry white wine
¼ cup soy sauce
4 t. cornstarch
1 T. vegetable oil
3 cloves garlic, peeled and smashed
1 t. chopped fresh ginger
2 cups finely shredded cabbage
1 cup thinly sliced celery
1 cup frozen green peas, thawed and drained
1 carrot, shredded
8 oz. thin spaghetti, cooked and well drained
4 green onions
Instructions:
1. Dissolve ch. Granules in hot water
2. Pour ½ cup broth mixture into large skillet. Let remaining broth cool.
Bring mixture in skillet to boiling and add chicken. Simmer for 5 minutes
or until no pink remains. Remove chicken to platter and pour off that juice.
3. Stir wine, soy and corn starch in small bowl. Add to cooled 1 ½ c. broth.
4. Heat oil in skillet. Add garlic and ginger; cool 30 seconds, stirring. Add cabbage, celery, peas and carrot; cook, stirring 1-2 minutes until veg. are crisp tender. Add chicken and pasta; toss 2 minutes until heated through. Stir cornstarch mixture and add to skillet; cook stirring 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened. Top with onion.
Author: Grammie

Title: Amy's Broccoli Salad
Ingredients:
2 c. broccoli florettes (although I used the bagged broccoli/cabbage/carrot coleslaw it was delicious-I'll use it again)
1/4 c. green onions chopped(I didn't have any, so used walla walla sweet)
1/2 c. raisins (I used golden and may have used a bit more)
1 pound crisp, chopped bacon (I used 5 thick slices-don't know if it was a pound)
Sauce:
1 c. mayonnaise
1/3 c. sugar
2 T. red wine vinegar
1 t. curry
Instructions: Mix sauce together then add food ingredients. I found that I had to keep adding slaw mix b/c there was too much sauce. Top with sunflower seeds or slivered almonds.
Author: Amy Taylor

Title: Apple Cole Slaw
Ingredients:
10 cups finely sliced cabbage
2 granny smith apples, peeled and chopped
4 oz. blue cheese, crumbled
DRESSING 
¾ cups Hellmans mayo
1 teas. fresh lemon juice
2 teas. sugar
½ teas. salt
2 Tab. dry Italian salad dressing
Instructions: Mix all ingredients and add to cabbage mxiture
Author: Grammie

Title: Asian Vinaigrette
Ingredients:
¼ c.Rice Wine Vinegar
1 Tab. Soy sauce
¾ c. Canola Oil
2 teas. sugar
1-2 teas sesame oil
1/8 teas. ground red pepper
Can add: for Seattle dressing
Maui Onion - puréed or minced dried onions
Olive Oil Drizzle
Instructions:
Combine in jar; cover tightly and
Shake vigorously. Chill. Yield 1 ¼ cups
Author: Grammie

Title: Black Bean and Corn Salad
Ingredients:
1  15 oz. can black beans, drained and rinsed well
1 can white shoepeg corn, drained well
1 can Mexican style stewed tomatoes
1 chopped red bell pepper
¼ c. chopped fresh cilantro
8 green onions sliced, green and white parts
3 Tab. lime juice
2 Tab. balsamic vinegar
½ teas. cumin
¼ teas. salt
Instructions:
Combine all ingredients. Store in refrigerator up to
 3 days in airtight container. Yields 4 cups
Author: Grammie

Title: Corn and Black Bean Salad
Ingredients:
12 oz. drained kernal corn
15 oz. drained/rinsed black beans
1 red pepper, finely chopped
½ cup diagonally sliced green onions
½ cup chopped red onion
1 clove garlic minced
1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and chopped
cilantro or parsley for garnish

DRESSING
¾ cup Italian salad dressing
¾ teas. tobasco
½ teas. chili powder
1 Tab. lemon or lime juice
1 Tab. chopped parsley or cilantro
Instructions: Combine all vegetables, mix dressing and pour over vegetables. Stir, refrigerate, covered at least 6 hours or overnight
Author: Grammie

Title: Caesar Salad
Ingredients:
For the garlic croutons:
4 medium cloves of garlic
¼ cup olive oil 
2 cups packed ¾ bread cubes
from a bagette or Italian bread
Large pinch salt
For the salad:
3 heads romaine lettuce, hearts only
5 T. olive oil
Salt to taste
Freshly ground black pepper
2 T. freshly squeezed lemon juice
2 ½ T mayonnaise
¼ t. Worcestershire sauce
¼ cup (about 1 oz.) grated
Parmesan cheese, plus additional 
For garnish
Instructions:
For the croutons: heat a 10 skillet
over low heat.
In small chopper, process garlic until minced.
Slowly add oil and process for 30 seconds.
Strain-should have 3 T. oil
Increase heat to medium.
Place the bread cubes in a medium bowl,
Drizzle with 2 T of the oil. Sprinkle with salt
And toss to coat. Add remaining oil and toss again.
Transfer bread cubes to preheated skillet and cook, 
Shaking often until crisp and golden brown.
5-7 minutes. Return croutons to bowl and cool.
For the salad: Place lettuce in large bowl.
Drizzle with the oil and sprinkle with S&P
Toss lightly.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice,
Mayo, and Wor. Sauce. Drizzle over lettuce and
Toss again.
Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese over the salad and toss gently.
Sprinkle with croutons over the salad and toss gently.
Divide onto salad plates and garnish with more P cheese.
Serve immediately.
Author: Grammie

Title: Caesar Salad Blender Dressing
Ingredients:
clove garlic, cut up
2 T. lemon juice
2 1/2 T. mayonnaise 
¼ t. Worcestershire sauce
Parmesan, black pepper
slowly add 1/3 c. oil
Instructions: Blend above ingridients in blender.
Author: Grammie

Title: Carrot Pennies
Ingredients:
