5 cups carrots, sliced and cooked
1 medium onion, chopped
1 green pepper, chopped
1 can tomato soup
1/2 cup oil
3/4 cup sugar
3/4 cup vinegar
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon dry mustard
1/2 teaspoon pepper
1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce
Instructions: Mix first three ingredients. Blend all other ingredients into sauce. Pour sauce over vegetables. Place in covered jars. Refrigerate overnight. Makes three pints.
Author: Grammie

Title: Cheryl's Rice Salad
Ingredients:
1 ¼ cups Basmati rice
2 ½ cups water
Blend dressing:
1 t. cumin
1 T. lime juice
1/3 c. white wine vinegar
1/3 c. olive oil
½ t. pepper
1 t. salt
Add to rice:
1 jalepeno pepper, cut fine
2 c. corn kernels she used canned)
1 can drained and rinsed black beans
1 c. grape tomatoes cut in forths
½ c. green onions
½ c. shredded carrot
cilantro if desired
celery cut up fine if desired
Instructions:

Title: Chicken-Grape Salad

pepper

Title: Church Salad
Ingredients:
Dressing 1/2 cup sugar
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon dry mustard
1/4 cup vinegar (regular or wine vinegar)
1 teaspoon paprika
1 tablespoon grated onion (or dehydrated onion)
1 teaspoon celery seed

Title: Crunchy Romaine Toss Salad
Ingredients:
Sweet and Sour Dressing

1 cup vegetable oil

1 Tab. soy sauce
Salad

Title: Cucumber in Sour Cream
Ingredients:

Instructions:

Title: Chilled Vegetable Salad
Ingredients:
1 cup sugar
3/4 cup vinegar
1/2 cup oil (I use 1/4 cup)

Title: North Shore Chicken Salad
Ingredients:
Dressing: Put in blender or processor and blend together:
2 large cloves garlic minced

Title: Tossed Fruit Salad
Ingredients:
Dressing  combine in blender and chill

Title: Speedy Pickled Peaches
Ingredients:
Can be made with canned pears or apricots
1 29-ounce can peach halves
1/2 cup sugar
1/2 cup vinegar
1 short stick cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon whole cloves
(can add a few whole allspice)
Instructions:
Day before or up to 1 week ahead:
Drain peach halves, reserving 1 cup syrup.
In medium saucepan, combine reserved
syrup, sugar, vinegar and spices. Add fruit.
Over medium heat, bring to boil; reduce 
heat to low and simmer about 5 minutes.
Store, covered, in refrigerator at least one

Can be served warm but I like them best
cold.

Title: Rice Salad

Instructions:
In a large bowl, combine rice and vegetables. Combine, mayo, must. & salt. 
Pour over rice mixture and toss. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Yield: 12-14 servings
Author: Grammie

Title: Sheilas Orange Almond Salad

Title: Spinach salad with hot citrus dressing
Ingredients:
2 # fresh spinach

Hot Citrus Dressing

Salad:

Arrange spinach and next 5 ingred on 8 salad plates

Title: Spinach-Pear Salad
Ingredients:
1/2 cup olive oil 
1/4 small onion 
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
1 (10-ounce) package fresh spinach
2 tablespoons cider vinegar
1/2 to 1 teaspoon salt 
2 pears, peeled and thinly sliced

 Remove and discard stems from spinach. Wash spinach, and pat dry with paper towels. Combine spinach, pear, raisins, and pecans in a large bowl. Pour reserved dressing over salad, and toss gently. 
Serve immediately. Yield: 8 servings

Title: Marinade for Chicken on the Grill

2 lbs boneless chicken breasts
Instructions: Gently stir above three ingredients in a bowl. Use as a marinade for boneless chicken breasts. Place in a glass pan and cover. Let marinade for several hours, or over night. Grill chicken until done. Don not over cook.

Title: Nancy's Blueberry French Toast Bake
Ingredients:
½ c. flour
1 ½ c. milk
¼ c. sugar
½ t. vanilla
¼ t. salt
6 eggs
10 slices French bread (1 thick) cut into cubes
1-3 oz pkg. cream cheese
1 c. blueberries
½ c. chopped nuts if desired
Powdered sugar or maple syrup for topping after it is baked
Instructions:
Grease 2 ½ Qt. casserole or 9 x 13 dish.
Beat first 6 ingredients. With hand mixer.
Stir in bread cubes until well coated.
Pour into pan. Top evenly with cream cheese, blueberries (and nuts if desired)
Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.
Heat oven to 400 degrees. Uncover and bake 20-25 minutes.
Serve with powdered sugar and syrup
Serves 6 to 8 people
Author: Grammie

Title: Lemonade
Ingredients:
1 cup sugar
1 cup lemon juice (not bottled)
Instructions: Boil 1 cup water and 1 cup sugar until sugar dissolved, 4-5 min. Let cool. Combune syrup, 2 qt. ice water and 1 cup lemon juice. Add 4-5 thin slices lemon. Garnish with mint.

Title: Crispy Teton Treats
Ingredients:
2 10-oz. pkg. marshmallows 
1/2 cup butter 
12 cups crisp rice cereal 
1 cup coarsely chopped walnuts, toasted 
3 cups semisweet chocolate pieces 
1 Tbsp. shortening 
Small white decorative candies
Instructions:
1. Generously butter a 13x9x2-inch baking pan. Set aside. 
2. In a large saucepan or 6- to 8-quart Dutch oven combine marshmallows and butter; cook and stir over medium-low heat until melted. Stir in 6 cups of the cereal and the walnuts until combined. Stir in remaining cereal. Transfer mixture to prepared pan. Spread evenly in pan using a buttered spatula. Cool completely.

3. Cut bars into 12 squares. Cut each square in half diagonally to make 2 triangles. (Or cut into desired shape.) In a small saucepan cook and stir chocolate pieces and shortening over low heat until melted.

4. Dip tips of triangles into melted chocolate. Sprinkle with white decorative candies. Makes 24 crisps.
Author: Better Homes & Gardens

Title: Grilled Pork Rub
Ingredients:
3 tablespoons brown sugar 
2 teaspoons Garlic Powder 
2 teaspoons Chili Powder 
1/2 teaspoon Black Pepper 
1/2 teaspoon Oregano Leaves 
1/2 teaspoon salt 
4-6 pork chops
Instructions:
Combine seasonings. Coat pork evenly with the rub. Refrigerate 30 minutes or up to 3 hours for stronger flavor. 
Lightly grease grill rack. Preheat grill to medium heat or use indirect heat method. Grill 25-30 minutes or until pork registers 160 degrees F with meat thermometer, turning occasionally. 
Remove from grill, cover with aluminum foil. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting into thin slices.

2 cups milk
1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed 
16 ounces chocolate sandwich cookies with creme filling
Instructions:

Title: Italian Pasta Pie
Ingredients:
3/4 lbs angel hair pasta
4 eggs, beaten
1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated
1/2 cup cheddar cheese, shredded
4 T butter
1 cup green bell pepper, 1/4 inch diced
1 cup onion, 1/4 inch diced
2 cups sour cream
2 lbs. ground hamburger (or italian sausage)
2 cups tomato sauce
1/2 t dried basil, crushed
1/2 t dried oregano, crushed
1/2 t garlic salt
1/2 t ground black pepper
10 oz. mozzerella, shredded
Instructions:
Cook pasta in boiling water until al dente; drain well. Place in large mixing bowl. Combine beaten eggs and cheese. Toss with warm pasta until pasta is well-coated. Divide; turn into 2 well-greased 10-in. pie pans. Shape into pie crusts; 
Melt butter in skillet; saute bell pepper and onion until onion is transparent. Add sour cream; mix well. Divide; spread over pasta mixture; reserve. 
Cook hamburger in large skillet until browned; drain off fat. Stir in tomato sauce and seasonings; mix well. Divide; spoon sausage mixture over sour cream mixture in pie pans. 
Bake at 350F for 25 minutes. Remove pans from oven; sprinkle each pan with 5 oz. mozzerella cheese; return pans to oven; bake 6-8 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly. 
To serve, cut each pie into 6 wedges. (Freezes excellently)
Author: Karen Dietz

Title: Turkey Lattice Pie
Ingredients:
3 tubes (8 ounces each) refridgerated crescent rolls
4 cups cubed cooked turkey (chicken)
1 1/2 cups (6 ounces) shredded cheddar or swiss cheese
1 package (10 ounces) frozen chopped broccoli (or green beans), thawed and drained
1 can (10 3/4 ounces) condensed cream of chicken soup, undiluted
1 1/3 cups milk
2 T dijon mustard
1 T dried minced onion
1/2 t salt
dash pepper
1 egg, lightly beaten
Instructions:
Unroll two tubes of crescent roll dough; seperate into rectangles. Place rectangles in a greased 15 in. x 10 in. x 1 in. baking pan (or two pie pans). Press onto the bottom and 1/2 in. up the sides of pan to form a crust, sealing seams and perforations. Bake at 350 degrees for 5-7 minutes or until light golden brown. 
In a bowl, combine the turket, cheese, broccoli (green beans), soup, milk, mustand, onion, salt, and pepper; mix well. Spoon over crust. 
Unroll remaining dough; divide into rectangles. Seal perforations. Cut each rectangle into four 1 inch strips. Using strips, make a lattice design on top of turkey mixture. Brush with egg. 
Bake 17-22 minutes longer or until top crust is golden brown and filling is hot.
(Great to freeze and eat later)
Author: Unknown

Title: MONTEREY SPAGHETTI
Ingredients:
4 oz. spaghetti broken into 2 inch pieces
1 egg
1 cup (8 ounces) sour cream
¼ cup grated Parmesan cheese
¼ t. garlic powder
2 cups (8 ounces) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1 package (10 oz.) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (2.8 oz) french-fried onions, divided
Instructions:
Cook the spaghetti according to package directions. Meanwhile, in a medium bowl, beat the egg. Add the sour cream, Parmesan cheese and garlic powder. Drain the spaghetti; add to egg mixture with the M J cheese, spinach and half of the onions. Pour into a greased 2 quart baking dish.
Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until heated through. Top with the remaining onions; return to oven for 5 minutes or until onions are golden brown. Yield; 6-8 servings

Title: Aunt Eleanor's Torte
Ingredients:
1 stick (1/2 cup) softened butter or margarine
1 cup flour
½ cup chopped nuts
1 cup Cool Whip
1 cup powdered sugar
1 large (8 oz.) softened plain cream cheese

.

Title: Philly Oreo Cheesecake
Ingredients:
1 pkg. Oreos
1/4 C. butter, melted
4 pkg Cream Cheese, softened
1 C. Sugar
1 t Vanilla
1 C. Sour Cream
4 Eggs
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 degrees. Place cookies in food processor; cover. Process 30 to 45 seconds or until finely ground. Add butter; mix well. Press firmly onto bottom of 13 x 9 inch pan.
Beat cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla in large bowl with electirc mixer on medium speed until well blended. Add sour cream; mix well. Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating just until blended after each addition. Chop remaining cookies. Gently stir 1.5 cups of the chopped cookies into cream cheese batter. Pour over crust; sprinkle with remaining chopped cookies.
Bake 45 minutes or until center is almost set. Cool. Refridgerate 3 hours or overnight. Cut into 16 pieces. Store leftovers in fridge. Makes 16 servings.
TIP: for easy removal, line pan with foil, with ends extending over pans sides. Lift from pan, using foil handles.

Title: Raspberry Ring Mold
Ingredients:
2 cups of BOILING liquid (use water or fruit syrup)
1 large (6oz.) package raspberry-flavored gelatin
1 pint red raspberry sherbet 
1 can (11 ounces) drained mandarin oranges
 (drain all fruit between paper towels and squeeze lightly)
1 can drained pineapple chunks
(OPTIONAL) 1 cup flaked coconut
1½ cups miniature marshmellows
1 ½ cups COOL WHIP (can use more if desired)
Instructions:
NOTE: This first step is best done a day ahead or overnight
so the gelatin will be very firm.
2 cups of BOILING liquid (use water or fruit syrup)
1 large (6oz.) package raspberry-flavored gelatin
1 pint red raspberry sherbet 
 ** Pour the boiling water over the gelatin and stir thoroughly.
 Add the raspberry sherbet to the gelatin and stir.
 Pour into a 4-cup ring mold.

NEXT DAY: 
Three hours before serving the ring mold, combine the following:
1 can (11 ounces) drained mandarin oranges
 (drain all fruit between paper towels and squeeze lightly)

Title: Texas Sheet Cake

2 cups sugar
2 eggs
1/2 sour cream
2 cups sifted flour
1 tsp. soda
1/2 tsp. salt
2 sticks butter
1 cup water
1/4 cup cocoa

1/2 stick butter (1/4 cup)
1 1/2 T. milk
1 T. cocoa

2 tsp. vanilla. Optional: 1 cup chopped walnuts.

 2 cups sugar
 2 eggs

 2 cups sifted flour

Title: Sweet Potato Casserole
Ingredients:

 3 T. butter
1/2 cup walnuts.

Instructions:

9. Evenly sprinkle chopped walnuts over the yams. (I use a half a cup of chopped walnuts since I prefer this to one fourth a cup)

Title: Lofthouse Sugar Cookies
Ingredients:
For the Cookies:
 6 cups all-purpose flour
 1 teaspoon baking soda
 1 teaspoon baking powder
 ½ teaspoon salt
 1 cup unsalted butter, at room temperature
 2 cups granulated sugar
 3 eggs
 2 teaspoons vanilla extract
 1½ cups sour cream

For the Easy Buttercream Frosting:
 1 cup unsalted butter, room temperature
 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
 4 cups powdered sugar
 Pinch of salt
 6 tablespoons heavy cream
Instructions:
1. In a medium bowl whisk together the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt; set aside.

2. In the bowl of a stand mixer with the flat beater attached, cream the butter and granulated sugar at medium speed until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula as needed. Add the eggs, one at a time, beating until each is incorporated. Add the vanilla and sour cream and beat at low speed until combined.

3. Add the dry ingredients and beat at low speed until just combined, scraping down the bowl as needed. Dough will be a bit “sticky”. Divide dough into two sections. Flatten into rectangles about 1½ inches thick, then wrap with plastic wrap. Chill in the refrigerator overnight or at least two hours until firm.

4. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees F. Line large baking sheets with parchment paper; set aside.

5. Flour the countertop and the top of the dough. With a rolling pin, roll the dough out to ¼-inch thickness. Using a 2 1/2-inch round cookie cutter, cut out circles and transfer to a baking sheet. Bake for 7 minutes, until pale golden. Immediately transfer cookies to a wire rack to cool. Cook cookies completely before frosting.

6. To make the frosting, in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, cream together the butter and vanilla. Slowly beat in the powdered sugar and the pinch of salt. Once smooth and creamy, add in heavy cream, 1 tablespoon at a time, then beat at medium-high speed for a minute or two until light and fluffy. If desired, add food coloring and beat until combined.

7. Once cookies have cooled completely, frost and add sprinkles. Allow frosting to set, then store in an air-tight container. Let cookies sit for several hours before serving to allow the flavors to develop.

Title: Herb Rubbed Sirloin Tip Roast (Roast Beef)

Title: Super Easy Bread
Ingredients:
3/4 cup warm water
1 package active dry yeast
1 tsp salt
1-1/2 tbsp sugar
1 tbsp vegetable shortening
1/2 cup milk
3 cups all-purpose flour, approximately
Instructions:
Prep Time: 3 hours
Cook Time: 45 minutes

In large bowl, add the warm water. Slowly stir in dry yeast. Continue to stir until yeast is dissolved.

Add salt, sugar, shortening, and milk to bowl. Stir.

Mix in the first 2 cups of flour.

If needed, begin adding more flour, one tablespoon at a time, until the dough chases the spoon around the bowl.

You do not need to use up all the flour called for in this recipe, or you may need more flour than called for. The amounts vary depending on many factors, including weather, which is why most bread recipes only give an approximate amount of flour needed.

Turn dough out onto floured board and knead, adding small spoonfuls of flour as needed, until the dough is soft and smooth, not sticky to the touch.

Put dough in buttered bowl, turn dough over so that the top of dough is greased. Cover and let rise in warm spot for 1 hour.

Punch down dough. Turn out onto floured board and knead.

Preheat oven at 375 degrees F. 

Form dough into loaf and set in buttered bread pan. Cover and let rise for about 30 minutes.

Score dough by cutting three slashes across the top with a sharp knife. Put in oven and bake for about 45 minutes or until golden brown.

Turn out bread and let cool on a rack or clean dishtowel.

Title: Scott's Favorite Pancakes

Instructions:
Put the buttermilk, egg and melted butter in a mixing bowl. Stir briskly until the mixture is smooth and blended.

Stir the flour, salt and baking soda together in a small bowl. Stir into the buttermilk mixture only until the dry ingredients are moistened - leave the smaller lumps.

Heat a skillet or griddle to medium hot. Grease lightly and spoon out a 3 TBLS of batter per pancake. Cook until a few bubbles form on top and break. Flip the pancake over and cook until golden brown..not too long. 

These are the best pancakes and nothing else will compare after having these!!! Enjoy. 

Makes about 6-8 pancakes.

**To make your own buttermilk, add 2 tsp of lemon juice or vinegar to a scant cup of milk, stir, and let sit at room temp for 15-30 min. Stir again before adding to recipe.

Title: Autumn Risotto with Chicken & Cranberries
Ingredients:
1 cup (250 mL) sweetened dried cranberries
2 cups (500 mL) hot water
1 medium onion
1 cup (250 mL) uncooked Arborio rice (see Cook's Tip)
1 tbsp (15 mL) olive oil
2 3/4 cups (675 mL) chicken stock
3/4 cup (175 mL) dry white wine such as Chardonnay

Instructions:

Microwave, uncovered, on HIGH 2-4 minutes or until onion is translucent. Add stock, wine, salt and black pepper; microwave, covered, on HIGH 13 minutes or until rice is still slightly firm, stirring once halfway through.

2 Meanwhile, toast almonds in (8-in./20-cm) Sauté Pan over medium heat 5-7 minutes or until golden brown, stirring frequently. Remove from heat. Slice celery. Cut cream cheese into cubes using Utility Knife. Drain cranberries using (7-in./18-cm) Strainer; set aside. Carefully remove baker from microwave using Silicone Oven Mitts. Add chicken and celery to baker; stir. Microwave, covered, on HIGH 3-5 minutes or until rice is tender and risotto appears creamy.

3 Carefully remove baker from microwave. Add cream cheese and almonds; stir until cheese is fully incorporated. Fold in cranberries. Garnish with parsley, if desired.

about 6 1/2 cups (1.5 L),
6 servings of about 1 cup (250 mL)

Title: Toasted Garlic Mozerella Bread

Title: Loaded Mac N Cheese
Ingredients:
8 Oz. of Noodles
1 12 Oz. Turkey Kielbasa, Cut into Bite Sized Pieces (or chicken)
2 Tbsp of Butter
1/2 Cup of Half and Half
1/2 Cup of Lowfat Milk
1 tsp of Dijon Mustard
1 tsp of Chicken Base
2 Cloves of Garlic, Minced
11/3 Cups of Shredded Cheddar Cheese
8 Oz. of Frozen Spinach
Salt to Taste
Instructions:
Cook up your noodles in a large pot of salted water. While the noodles are boiling, heat up your kielbasa in a separate skillet on medium high heat for about 5 minutes or until heated through.

Remove the kielbasa from the pan and set aside. In the same skillet set to medium heat, melt up the two tablespoons of butter. Add the garlic to the skillet and saute up for a minute or two. Now add in the half and half, milk, mustard, and chicken base. Stir up well to combine and let it get hot for 2 to 3 minutes.

Now add in your cheese and let it melt and thicken the sauce; about 4 to 5 minutes.

Add the frozen spinach and stir it in, letting it heat up for a few minutes.

Add the sausage back in, stir, and let it heat back up.

Finally, add your cooked noodles back into the mix and give it one last good stir to meld it all together. Add salt if desired.

Title: Cinnamon Roll Pancakes
Ingredients:
Cinnamon Filling
     4 tablespoons (1/2 stick) unsalted butter, just melted (not boiling)
     1/4 cup + 2 tablespoons packed light brown sugar
     1/2 tablespoon ground cinnamon

Cream Cheese Glaze
     4 tablespoons (1/2 stick) unsalted butter
     2-ounces cream cheese, at room temperature
     3/4 cup powdered sugar
     1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

Pancakes
     1 cup all-purpose flour
     2 teaspoons baking powder
     1/2 teaspoon salt
     1 cup milk
     1 large egg, lightly beaten
     1 tablespoon canola or vegetable oil
Instructions:
Prepare the cinnamon filling: In a medium bowl, stir together the butter, brown sugar, and cinnamon. Scoop the filling into a quart-sized heavy zip baggie and set it aside.

Prepare the glaze: In a small pan, heat the butter over low heat until melted. Turn off the heat and whisk in the cream cheese until it is almost smooth. Sift the powdered sugar into the pan, stir and add in vanilla extract. Set the pan aside while you make the pancakes.

Prepare the pancake batter: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder and salt. Whisk in the milk, egg and oil, just until the batter is moistened (a few small lumps are fine).

Cook the pancakes: Heat a large, nonstick skillet over medium-heat and spray with nonstick spray. Use an ice cream scoop (or I used a 1/4 cup measuring cup) to add the batter to the pan. Use the bottom of the scoop or cup to spread the batter into a circle about 4-inches in diameter (I did not have to do this because my batter was thin enough to spread out by itself). Reduce the heat to medium low. Snip the corner of your baggie of cinnamon filling and squeeze the filling into the open corner (you may need to knead the cinnamon filling before clipping the bag, as the filling tends to separate a little). When your pancake begins to form bubbles, add the filling. Starting at the center of the pancake, squeeze the filling on top of the pancake batter in a swirl, just as you see in a regular cinnamon roll (be careful not to get the filling to close to the side. You want to keep it about a 1/4 of an inch away from the edge or it will bleed over). Cook the pancake 2 to 3 minutes, or until the bubbles begin popping on top of the pancake and it's golden brown on the bottom. Slide a thin, wide metal spatula underneath the pancake and gently but quickly flip it over. Cook an additional 2 to 3 minutes, until the other side is golden as well. When you flip the pancake onto a plate, you will see that the cinnamon filling has created a crater-swirl of cinnamon. Wipe out the pan with a paper towel, and repeat with the remaining pancake batter and cinnamon filling. Re-warm the glaze briefly, if needed. Serve pancakes topped with a drizzle of glaze.

Yields: Eight 4-inch pancakes

Title: Amazing Strawberry Cobbler

1 cup milk

Title: Cinnamon Apple Cake
Ingredients:
Ingredients
1 3/4 cups sugar, divided
1/2 cup stick margarine, softened
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
6 ounces block-style fat-free cream cheese, softened (about 3/4 cup)
2 large eggs
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder
1/4 teaspoon salt
2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
3 cups chopped peeled Rome apple (about 2 large)
Cooking spray
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350°.

Beat 1 1/2 cups sugar, margarine, vanilla, and cream cheese at medium speed of a mixer until well-blended (about 4 minutes). Add eggs, 1 at a time, beating well after each addition. Combine flour, baking powder, and salt. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture, beating at low speed until blended.

Combine 1/4 cup sugar and cinnamon. Combine 2 tablespoons cinnamon mixture and apple in a bowl, and stir apple mixture into batter. Pour batter into an 8-inch springform pan coated with cooking spray, and sprinkle with remaining cinnamon mixture.

Bake at 350° for 1 hour and 15 minutes or until the cake pulls away from the sides of the pan. Cool the cake completely on a wire rack, and cut using a serrated knife.

Note: You can also make this cake in a 9-inch square cake pan or a 9-inch springform pan; just reduce the cooking time by 5 minutes.

Title: Caramel Apple Dip

Title: Corn Bread Casserole
Ingredients:

Instructions:

Title: Lisas Yummy Chicken

Pour sauce over chicken and serve.

Title: Crock Pot Mac and Cheese
Ingredients:
3 cups UNCOOKED elbow macaroni pasta

6. Put the lid on top of the slow cooker, then set the slow cooker on low.
7. Let cook for 3 hours.

Title: Classic French Crepes
Ingredients:
1¼ cup milk
3 large eggs
2T melted butter
3T sugar 
½t  kosher salt
1C flour
Instructions:
COOKING THE CREPES
1.	Preheat a griddle to medium-high (err on the side of high).
2.	Brush a layer of butter on the heated pan. 
3.	Always mix the batter first, before you make each crepe, as the butter may harden. 
4.	Pour ¼ cup of the batter onto the griddle.  Allow it to cook 10-20 seconds, then use the spreader in a circular motion.
5.	Cook the crepes until the edges are starting to brown and become a little crisp (about 60 seconds). Flip the crepes over and cook for a further 30 seconds on the other side until the crepes have caramelized spots.

SOME HINTS FROM THE CHEF
•	You can also just dump all ingredients in a blender.  If using this method, make sure to allow it to rest 10-20 minutes
•	If crepes are coming out rubbery, turn up the heat.
•	For crispier edges, add butter or oil to the pan.  If the butter is burning, switch to oil.
•	If topping with chocolate chips, you can add the chips to the crepe while it’s still on the pan for more melty goodness.
•	Some of our favorite toppings (select one): chocolate chips and bananas, raspberry jam, squeeze of lemon, Nutella, berries

Title: Creamy Cajun Pasta Sauce
Ingredients:

2 tablespoon minced garlic
1 cup white wine
1 pint heavy cream

2t tablespoon smoked sweet paprika seasoning
1 teaspoon salt
3 tablespoons tomato paste
Instructions:
In a large sauté pan, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat. When shimmering, add onions. Cook for 2 minutes. Add garlic, cook additional 30 seconds until fragrant. 
Add the white wine. Let the wine reduce to half – about 3 minutes. 
Add cajun seasoning, salt, paprika and tomato paste. Stir.
Add heavy cream. When the cream mixture is almost bubbling, turn heat to low. Let the cream mixture reduce to half – about 2 minutes.

Title: Salmon Honey Soy Marinade
Ingredients:
4 cloves garlic, minced
2 teaspoons ginger, minced
½ teaspoon red pepper
1 tablespoon olive oil
⅓ cup less sodium soy sauce
⅓ cup honey
Instructions:
Place salmon in a sealable bag or medium bowl.

In a small bowl or measuring cup, mix marinade ingredients.

Pour half of the marinade on the salmon. Save the other half for later.

Let the salmon marinate in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.

In a medium pan, heat oil. Add salmon to the pan, but discard the used marinade. Cook salmon on one side for about 2-3 minutes, then flip over and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.

Title: Jina's Meatballs
Ingredients:
1 can cranberry jelly
1 bottle heinz chili sauce
about 1 T lemon juice (I just squeeze half a lemon even if I double the sauce)
1 T brown sugar
Costco meatballs (approx 40 large or 80 mini)
Instructions:
In crockpot, combine the first 4 ingredients until all melted together.
Add meatballs and mix into sauce sauce, so meatballs are evenly coated.
Cook on HIGH for at least 3 hours

If you are pressed for time, you could use a really big pan to make the sauce and add in the meatballs, because it takes some time in the crockpot for the meatballs to defrost.  Then you could transfer to the crockpot for a shorter amount of time.

Title: Cinnamon Roll Monkey Bread
Ingredients:

2 teaspoons cinnamon
35 ounces Grands Cinnamon Rolls with Icing , (2 packages)

1/2  cup unsalted butter , melted
Instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease a large bundt pan.

Add cinnamon and sugar to a large bowl and stir.

Cut each cinnamon roll into six pieces.

Add the pieces to the bowl and gently coat them in the cinnamon sugar mixture.

Add half the dough balls and arrange them in your bundt pan.

In a medium bowl, mix the brown sugar and melted butter.

Pour half the butter mixture over the first layer.
Arrange the rest of the cinnamon roll pieces in a second layer.

Pour the rest of the melted butter mixture over the top and put it in the oven.

Bake for 40-45 minutes until it's cooked through and golden brown.

Let cool for five minutes then place a large plate or cake pedestal upside down over the top of your bundt pan and carefully and quickly flip it over to remove the monkey bread from the pan.

Top with icing packets drizzled over the top (best if you warm these in a bowl first).

Title: Chocolate Maple Pecan Pie
Ingredients:
Filling:
4 T unsalted butter, melted
1 Cup semisweet chocolate chips
3/4 Cup dark brown sugar packed
2 1/2 T flour ( I use GF flour)
1/4 tsp salt
3 large eggs
2/3 Cup maple syrup
3 T bourbon - you can swap this for more maple syrup 
2 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 Cup chopped pecans
1/2 Cup pecan halves
Instructions:
In a large bowl pour the butter over the chocolate chips. Let the mixture sit for 2-3 min to allow the hot butter to melt the chocolate. It does not need to melt completely.
Stir in the brown sugar, flour and salt to make a thick paste. Whisk the eggs, maple syrup, bourbon and vanilla in a small bowl. Pour the egg mixture into the chocolate mixture and stir until the ingredients are combined. 

Sprinkle the pecans on the bottom of an unbaked pie crust. Pour filling over the nuts and mix carefully with a fork so all the pecans are covered with the mixture. 

Bake 350 for 55 minutes or until the filling has set.

Title: Maple Pecan Pie
Ingredients:

Instructions: Whisk sugar, syrup, eggs, butter, vanilla, and salt together in bowl. Add pecans. Pour into crust. Bake in 400 degree oven for 10 minutes. Title: Teriyaki Chicken
Ingredients:

1 Tbsp olive oil
1/4 cup low-sodium soy sauce
1/4 cup water
2 Tbsp honey
1 1/2 Tbsp packed light brown sugar
1 Tbsp rice vinegar
1/4 tsp toasted sesame oil
2 tsp peeled and minced fresh ginger
2 tsp peeled and minced fresh garlic (2 cloves)
2 tsp cornstarch
Sesame seeds and chopped green onions, for serving (optional)
Instructions:
Heat olive oil in a 12-inch non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.

Add in chicken and let brown on bottom about 3 - 4 minutes then flip and continue to cook until center registers about 160 degrees, about 3 minutes longer.

While chicken is cooking, in a small mixing bowl (or liquid measuring cup) whisk together soy sauce, water, honey, brown sugar, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, garlic and cornstarch.

Stir the sauce in with the cooked chicken and continue to cook and toss until sauce has thickened, about 30 - 60 seconds longer. 

Serve over rice garnished with green onions and sesame seeds if desired.

15 minutes cooking and prep.
Serves 4.
